# Qinao Dual-Space Automation Controlled Convergence Implementation Plan

> **Forward development status (2026-08-29):** Superseded by [Qinao single-developer Git and lightweight PR design](../specs/2026-08-29-qinao-single-developer-git-and-lightweight-pr-design.md). External authority closure was never completed, and no historical authority is retroactively claimed. The single developer selected ordinary Git plus lightweight PR review; former source-admission, controlled-document, signer/trust-root, controller/CAS, authority-receipt, registry, and quorum gates are retired for forward development. Historical facts and hashes remain evidence; a historical non-authority limitation remains a forward gate only when the superseding design explicitly restates it.

> **QINAO-PLAN-REGISTRY-V1: ACTIVE_TASKS_0_2_ANNEX**

> **For agentic workers:** REQUIRED SUB-SKILL: Use superpowers:subagent-driven-development (recommended) or superpowers:executing-plans to implement this plan task-by-task. Steps use checkbox (`- [ ]`) syntax for tracking.

**Goal:** Atomically reconcile the approved Work Space, Automation Space,
fine-grained interaction evidence, 72-hour governed retention, independent
Agent contexts, interruption recovery, model/user adaptation, biomimetic
sovereign control weave, and Apple ecosystem boundaries into Qinao's existing
seven controlled documents and Owner Ledger, with non-vacuous gates, a risk-proportional,
zero-routine-administration internal-SDK delivery posture, and implementation-ready
domain-task payloads, without creating a second store, scheduler, event log,
compiler, Agent authority, wave plan, or completion authority.

**Architecture:** The existing 2026-07-15 convergence master remains the only
W0-W6 order and completion authority. Only Tasks 0-2 of this document are
executable: C0 selects an externally admitted committed predecessor; W0 makes
admission non-vacuous and atomically writes the adopted delta into the seven
controlled documents and Owner Ledger. Sections 3-10 are exact transplant
payloads for those controlled documents, not independently executable tasks.
No W1-W6 payload is complete or admitted by this annex; every payload remains
future governed work until its owning controlled plan executes it.
The approved 2026-08-02 biomimetic sovereign design is a second exact design
input, not a second plan or controlled document: Task 0 admits/reopens its
single file through the incumbent design-edge receipt, and Task 2 distributes
its requirements into the same master/domain owners before any payload may use
them.
Once Task 2 passes, this file is a non-authoritative traceability annex and all
production work executes only from the updated master/domain plans. Work Space
and Automation Space remain product projections over the same
Event/Artifact/Task/receipt authorities. Managed admission and recovery are
likewise projections over incumbent policies, owners, controllers, and
receipts; their five risk tiers create no additional architecture layer,
wave, owner, or state authority.

**Tech Stack:** Swift 6, Swift Package Manager, SQLite, Rust, Core AI,
Foundation Models, App Intents, BackgroundTasks, WidgetKit where a real target
exists, CloudKit only behind the manual governed profile, Python 3.14.5
standard-library gate tooling, Git candidate-tree admission, Xcode 27, iOS 27.

### Managed internal-SDK admission and recovery posture

**Decision status and product boundary.** The first Qinao release is an SDK
used only by the operator's own controlled projects. It is not a public SDK,
third-party distribution, or permission for an unknown consumer to extend an
authority surface. This subsection records the approved product design for
Tasks 1-2; it is not an admission receipt, protected-operation wire, release
approval, or proof that any external condition has cleared. Until the exact
controlled-document and Owner Ledger transaction is admitted, the branch and
every result described here remain unadmitted. Public or third-party
distribution requires a separate controlled decision and the high-assurance
profile described below; it cannot be inferred from an internal release.

**One policy and control plane.** After Task 2's admitted in-place V1-to-V2
migration, “Managed admission” is a deterministic projection over the sole
Owner Ledger's `authority_entity_inventory.protectedCommandPolicy`, its one
protected controller, the one owner checker, and the two incumbent workflows.
The current V1 Ledger does not yet contain that object; this paragraph is a
controlled target, not evidence that the migration ran. V1 and V2 never
coexist as two Ledgers, and no second policy registry is introduced. Managed
admission is not a new owner, gate, scheduler, state store, signer, controller,
workflow, receipt family, recovery authority, or completion authority. The
trusted controller derives the required risk tier from the exact candidate tree,
closed path list, Owner Ledger ownership/classification delta, requested
operation, and current admitted policy. Candidate content, a branch name, the
host app, an Agent, a model, or a caller-supplied manifest cannot select,
downgrade, skip, or self-approve a tier. An ambiguous or uncovered change
escalates to the next safe tier and yields a typed missing-policy result; it
never falls back to a weaker path.

The five entries below are **execution-risk tiers**, not additional L1-L14
semantic layers, W0-W6 waves, capability-cutover states, or Agent roles:

| Risk tier | Existing governed route | Permitted result | Required isolation and authority |
|---|---|---|---|
| Development | the operator-pinned development overlay and sole checker | local TDD, simulation, performance work, deterministic unsigned evidence | no signer, production credential, admission, or release claim |
| Ordinary CI | `ordinary.fixture-report` with `admissionKind == "ordinaryReportOnly"` | complete fixed-corpus checks and an `admissionStatus == "unadmitted"` report | no secret, OIDC provider, production trust root, state mutation, or authority |
| Protected read-only | `bootstrap.amendment3-protected-review` with `admissionKind == "bootstrapReviewOnly"`, `waveAdmissionEligible == false`, and `stateMutationEligible == false` | the pending Amendment-3 Phase-C stabilization derivation and immutable review evidence only | trusted tools treat the candidate tree as data; independent Python/native derivation runs in a clean ephemeral security subject; target state, repository, Ledger, registry, admission, publication, and production state remain read-only |
| Authority transition | operations whose binding has `admissionKind == "waveAdmission"`, plus the sole `w6.runtime-receipt-chain` binding with `admissionKind == "runtimeChainPublication"` | a role-scoped externally signed transition bound to the exact predecessor, commit/tree or closed receipt chain as applicable, B0, tools, policy, path list, challenge, and durable nonce | candidate and authority execution remain different security subjects; the authority runner never executes candidate-supplied code; replay and self-signing fail closed; runtime-chain publication is non-Wave and cannot move a ref or mutate target state |
| Internal SDK release | owner `runtime.certification` followed by owner `production.cutover` | reproducible SDK artifact, artifact digest, SBOM, compatibility manifest, format-required platform/package signature, rollback evidence, and controlled-project cutover | the existing final-Wave admission and runtime-chain signatures remain mandatory; certification evidence cannot itself perform cutover, and no generic release signer is created |

Task 1 may only prepare candidate-independent checker/controller/workflow code,
reviewed test-only fixture bytes, and RED tests capable of validating the
future row; it cannot mutate the Ledger, install a policy object, or grant an
operation. Task 2 alone closes the first protected-policy installation and
installs the in-place V2 Ledger, the seven
controlled-document delta, and the `bootstrapReviewOnly` row in one admitted
transaction. The exact row additionally requires
`waveSliceID == ""` and
`entrypointID == "amendment3-protected-review-controller"`. It is a distinct
read-only operation, never a relabelled migration, ordinary-report, or Wave
operation. The phrase “Phase C” in this plan means only that exact Amendment-3
protected review; it does not create a third workflow or a new generic
lifecycle stage. The ignored Amendment 3 remains
`DRAFT; STABILIZATION BLOCKED; GRANTS NO AUTHORITY`; it cannot install or
authorize this wire. Phase C independently rederives from the immutable
review tree and never accepts a Phase-A/B render intermediate, historical
seal, or checkpoint as canonical input.

The Ordinary-CI binding is exactly
`operationID == "ordinary.fixture-report"`,
`admissionKind == "ordinaryReportOnly"`,
`waveSliceID == "w0.gates"`,
`entrypointID == "ordinary-fixture-reporter"`, and
`waveAdmissionEligible == false`. It consumes only commands declared
`ordinaryEligible == true` and cannot sign, admit, or promote a real
candidate. Until the Task 1/2 wiring passes, this exact binding remains a
controlled target and current Ordinary CI remains unsigned evidence. Each
Wave Authority-transition binding instead requires
`admissionKind == "waveAdmission"`, `waveSliceID == operationID`,
`entrypointID == "wave-admission-controller"`, and
`waveAdmissionEligible == true`. The sole non-Wave
`runtimeChainPublication` binding is the exact six-field row frozen in the
closed post-migration registry; it has empty `waveSliceID`, uses the incumbent
external verifier, and has both eligibility booleans false. An `operationID` identifies one protected
operation, an execution profile constrains how it runs, and an `owner_id`
identifies semantic/write/storage/recovery authority; the three identities
are never interchangeable.

Independent Python/native calculation, immutable inputs, separate
candidate/control security subjects, complete comparison, and fail-closed
evidence remain mandatory. `stateMutationEligible == false` still permits the
protected controller's bounded one-use challenge/claim, prelaunch and terminal
receipts, evidence-retention lease, and finalization records; those are
execution-control evidence, not target-state authority. The protected command
itself holds no signing credential or admission authority, while the admitted
trust scope must independently verify its controller-receipt chain. External
signing and physical-host multiplicity are orthogonal: Authority transition
retains the external `wave-admission-signer`; Internal SDK release must consume
that final-Wave receipt, its Apple-Wave predecessor, and the existing
`runtime-chain-signer` chain. It does not invent a general `release-signer`
role.

When eventually installed, Protected read-only binds only the closed
`qinao-owner-ledger-bootstrap-closure` and
`qinao-amendment3-remediation` commands. It references the unchanged closed
`QinaoProtectedRuntimeProfileV1` plus separately governed
`QinaoProtectedReviewExecutionPolicyV1` and
`QinaoProtectedReviewExecutionRuntimeV1` roots; it cannot add
implementation-chosen fields to the base profile or inherit a generic
production-Wave command.

Two different physical hosts are not a default hard requirement for this
internal read-only tier. A separately admitted high-assurance profile adds distinct
physical hosts and stronger ceremony for root-key rotation, first public
release, future third-party distribution, or a threat model that explicitly
includes host/hypervisor compromise. Requesting either shipping performance
claim also invokes that claim's exact dual-physical-device measurement
protocol. These conditional profiles do not weaken or replace external
admission/runtime-chain signing on Authority transition or Internal SDK
release.

The current Owner Ledger records `runtime.certification` as
`approved_missing` and `production.cutover` as `converging`; therefore this
route is a planned owner sequence, not current release readiness. The
`production.cutover` manifest binds typed, reopenable references to the
verified six-entry runtime chain, Apple-Wave receipt, final certification-Wave
receipt, reproducible artifact/SBOM/compatibility payloads, rollback target
and compatibility proof, plus the exact format-signature policy and—if that
policy requires it—the already configured Apple/deployment code-signing
identity/signature. That platform identity proves
artifact authenticity only; it cannot admit a tree or authorize cutover. A
missing admitted identity blocks that format's release instead of causing the
controller to generate a key or extend the trust-root role set.

**Zero-routine-administration experience.** The controller classifies the
change, chooses the operation, prepares bounded manifests, activates the
eligible incumbent workflow/event lane, validates outputs, retains evidence,
and performs safe retry or reconciliation automatically. This creates no
daemon, keepalive, polling authority, or background scheduler;
`AppleBGTaskSchedulerBridge` remains the sole Apple background adapter. The
operator never chooses a risk tier, tracks runner cleanup, copies a nonce,
operates B0, or decides whether a result is authoritative. A non-authoritative
UI projection may collapse the detailed
states to “checking”, “can continue”, “automatically recovering”, “waiting for
an external condition”, or “needs confirmation”; those labels are not stored
wire states and grant no authority. Operator interaction is limited to facts
that cannot honestly be delegated: initial authorization of an external
identity/custody service, an explicitly irreversible release/cutover, and
lost-key or trust-root recovery. If an external service is absent, ordinary
development and CI continue while the affected Authority transition or
release remains queued and visibly unadmitted.

**Interruption and effect semantics.** Repository/protected-command recovery
reuses the protected controller's existing claim, challenge, result,
retention, finalization, and quarantine evidence. Product/runtime recovery
reuses the one K3 path, `BASAutomationRunState`,
`ContextContinuityManifest`, nested `WorkUnitRecoveryCursor`, L11/L14
`ContinuationPolicy`, and `BASWorkUnitRecoveryDisposition` matrix specified by Payloads
8A-8F. A shared convenience view may correlate those two scopes, but no shared
mutable recovery registry, second checkpoint store, or cross-authority resume
manager is permitted.

Every resumable operation binds its immutable operation identity, exact input
digests, candidate commit/tree where applicable, policy/tool/B0 roots,
predecessor, challenge/nonce, completed receipts, remaining budget/rights, and
next legal transition. A checkpoint becomes resumable only after its bytes and
referenced owner receipts are durably stored and reopened. Resume never
restores a process stack, Swift task, shell memory, closure, raw prompt,
Provider-private KV, secret, or ambient handle. Pure work may restart;
idempotent work may replay with the same identity; a possibly crossed
Provider/tool/effect/publication/release boundary first queries its owning
authority and reconciles. It is never blindly reissued.

The controlled documents must converge on the honest
`BASProviderAttemptExecutor.executeAtMostOnce` physical-dispatch name.
Exactly-once **terminal outcome** is obtained by idempotency, owner query, and
reconciliation, not by claiming exactly-once physical execution. The
seven-document symbol flip and Owner Ledger update occur atomically in Task
2; until then the old spelling is legacy input, not a competing contract.
Only the fresh, non-copyable K3 permit winner may make the one physical call;
an idempotent recovery returns the already owned receipt and never recreates
call capability. `sent_or_unknown`, `publication_indeterminate`, or any other
possible-start state is query/reconcile-only until the same identity reaches a
terminal result or a separately authorized compensation is created. A
Python/native mismatch, stale or replayed receipt, changed input, uncertain
side effect, cleanup failure, repeated state, no progress, exhausted budget,
or retry cycle produces a typed blocked/quarantined/indeterminate result and
a bounded diagnostic. It cannot be converted into success by choosing one
calculator, increasing retries without bound, or asking a model to judge
itself.

**Three-day governed data posture.** EventLog remains content-free: it stores
only bounded structured facts, blinded digests, references, epochs, causal
slots, and receipts. Raw user/Agent/tool/model content enters only the
encrypted, content-addressed Artifact path after its decision gate, with exact
Work Space/App Agent scope, purpose, authorization, erasure domain, and
retention receipt. Four distinct horizons must never be conflated:

1. An ordinary, consented `eligibleLearning72Hours` admission starts at the
   committed K3 receipt and has an exact minimum of 72 hours plus a finite
   purpose-specific maximum. It is only an eligibility class, never an
   authorization to learn.
2. Committed bytes needed for recovery use `recovery72Hours`. Their exact
   minimum is 72 hours from the same trusted K3 retention commit and their
   finite purpose maximum is strictly later. Terminal completion, routine
   pruning, archive, reboot, clock rollback, or disk pressure cannot delete
   them early. The class grants no learning, long-term memory, cross-Agent
   sharing, or Provider disclosure right.
3. Conversation plans, committed ordinary conversation content, and inquiry
   transcripts use `userDurable`; time passage alone never deletes them.
4. Protected Phase-C control evidence follows its own challenge-bound rule:
   its retention end is no earlier than challenge expiry plus 259,200 seconds.
   That rule is not a user-content retention policy.

Explicit deletion, consent withdrawal, legal deletion, secret detection, and
privacy/security reclassification override the two 72-hour minimums
immediately. They synchronously fence all reads and make the body/key
unreachable while preserving only the bounded content-free proof permitted by
policy. At or after a finite recovery maximum, structured replay may continue
but exact content recovery returns a typed `contentExpired` result.

The protected workflow's current one-day uploaded artifacts are a
non-authoritative transport cache and cannot satisfy that three-day external
evidence lease. Protected review remains blocked until the independently
controlled evidence store proves the complete required horizon.

Explicit `userDurable` content follows its separately authorized deletion and
erasure disposition; no recovery maximum can silently shorten or create it.
Process-local uncommitted `ephemeral` observations, secrets, hidden reasoning,
Provider-private KV, and `neverPersist` material are never promoted merely to
satisfy a retention counter. Rebuildable projections/caches are evicted before
admitted recovery or durable content, and insufficient capacity blocks new
heavy work instead of violating an existing minimum.

This approval records the product intent to support encrypted 72-hour
continuity; it does not silently clear W2's named security/operator
disposition or enable durable capture. Long-term memory, Self, reward, and
training/dataset truth accept only cleaned, provenance-bound, grounded,
conflict-resolved proposals that pass the existing eligibility and State
Commit gates. Main/Sub/Provider output cannot directly modify an App Agent,
another App Agent, authoritative memory, or learning truth. Cross-Agent or
cross-Space access uses an explicit attenuated share/capability Artifact and
never creates mutual write authority.

**Proof and rollout.** Implementation is accepted only through four validation
families, all reusing existing Task/Payload owners. They are not additional
ControlRings, semantic layers, or certification-gate identities:

1. Structural proof extends Task 1's non-vacuous gates: every named path and
   scan set exists and is non-empty; scanner exit `0`, `1`, and `2+` remain
   distinct; every test filter discovers a positive count; the candidate
   manifest is non-empty when candidate validation is required; iOS/Rust
   deployment floors equal iOS 27; Owner Ledger cardinality and one-owner
   invariants do not drift.
2. Recovery proof extends Payloads 8E-8F and 10B by injecting interruption
   before and after every stable boundary, including session/process/device
   termination, timeout, duplicate delivery, stale evidence, unavailable
   signer, and unknown external outcome. It proves safe resume, bounded
   reconciliation, deterministic fallback, and no duplicate Provider call,
   state write, effect, publication, or release.
3. Security proof mutates candidate/checker/corpus/B0/policy/receipt/nonce and
   runner-cleanup assumptions. It proves candidate data is observation only,
   ordinary CI has no secret, models cannot grant authority, trusted runners
   execute no candidate code, and every unavailable external fact remains an
   explicit blocker rather than fabricated evidence.
4. Device/model proof extends Payloads 10C-10F across local and API models,
   context-window geometries, cold/warm starts, memory pressure, thermal
   states, foreground/background transitions, and real supported Apple
   targets. `cold40` and `sustained30` are optional,
   workload-qualified, shipping-identity-bound claims, never unconditional
   structural or internal-SDK release gates. When requested, both run their
   frozen dual-physical-device protocol; `sustained30` requires each device's
   uninterrupted 1,800-second cohort and frozen final-quarter statistic, never
   a cross-device average. When not requested they remain `.notRequested`.
   Failure denies only that claim/profile; an admitted, identity- and
   quality-preserving Pareto fallback may be selected without reducing output,
   retrieval, verification, or policy requirements.

Rollout order is fixed as local shadow, Ordinary CI, Protected read-only,
internal SDK candidate, then internal SDK release. No global enable switch
exists. This subsection remains inside this sole Convergence Plan; its exact
requirements are transplanted into the incumbent seven controlled documents
and Owner Ledger by Task 2. Amendments remain non-authoritative generated
mirrors. No additional master plan, domain plan, design authority, Gate,
controller, registry, workflow, or receipt family may be created to implement
this posture.

The following capabilities remain disabled until their named stop condition clears:

| Capability | Stop condition |
|---|---|
| Durable `eligibleLearning72Hours` raw-content capture | encrypted Artifact content, erasure-domain custody, EventLog migration, WAL/checkpoint/backup deletion closure, and operator/security disposition pass |
| General scheduled execution | recurrence owner map, logical-fire CAS, L14 admission, device-affinity fencing, duplicate/offline/DST tests pass |
| Real local notifications or APNs | W5 publication/effect mouth and sole broker-authorized Apple mutation caller pass |
| Calendar/Reminders writes | W5 effect permit, exact confirmation, Zone-C dispatch, and reconciliation pass |
| CloudKit | private/shared manual profile, exact subscription, K3 state serialization, deletion/conflict/recovery proof pass |
| Watch/Handoff/Live Activity | real signed targets and lifecycle evidence exist; initial Watch profile stays read/capture/request-review only |
| HealthKit/HomeKit/high-sensitivity profiles | separate product, privacy, security, legal/entitlement review passes |
| Multi-device active automation execution | a separately approved linearizable lease/idempotency authority exists |

### Approved 2026-08-02 design coverage map

The supplemental design spans several subsystems, but they are not independent
projects: they share the same seven controlled documents, Owner Ledger,
W0-W6 receipt chain, state/effect/publication boundaries, and cutover. Splitting
them into sibling plans would violate the closed plan registry and permit
partial authority flips. The following rows therefore extend existing
Tasks/Payloads only; each row still ends in an independently reviewable Wave
slice and test bundle.

### Closed no-language-model survival delta

This delta closes the approved design's distinction between a concrete-model-
independent SDK and a system that remains honestly useful when no language
model is present. No new owner, authority, store, manager, registry, scheduler,
compiler, or wave is created. Owner Ledger and architecture cardinalities
remain exactly `29/14/14/7` and `14/10/4/4/7`; the fourteen semantic layers,
ten observable supersteps, four kernels, four bounded rings, and seven planes
are unchanged.

The stable proposal contract has exactly six closed
`BASProposalCandidateKind` values: `rule`, `search`, `classicML`, `human`,
`tool`, and `model`. A model is one candidate kind, not the definition of an
Agent, Proposal, context, Automation, or completion and receives no wider
authority. Every kind emits the same `BASStructuredProposal`, including the
operation/task root, exact producer kind and identity, requested disposition,
typed output schema, claims, assumptions, uncertainty, source spans/evidence
references, correlation roots, bounded resource-use evidence, and completion
receipt. Candidate-specific opaque bytes remain inert Artifact content. They
cannot mint identity, capability, state truth, effect authority, or a second
commit path.

`BASStructuredContextPacket` is the canonical context for every proposal kind.
It binds Agent/Session/Attempt, current semantic snapshot and requirements,
selected evidence/source spans, conflicts/open obligations, policy/consent/
deletion epochs, capability/budget ceilings, output schema, and the current R6
receipt. It contains no rendered prompt, token IDs, Provider/model/material
identity, raw CoT, mutable scratch, live handle, credential, or Provider-private
KV. `BASContextCompiler` remains the sole compiler and first produces this
packet. A prompt/tokenized form is an ephemeral model-materialization adapter
output derived only after a `model` proposal plan wins; it is never canonical
State, a cache-crossing identity, or an input required by non-model kinds.

The following central block freezes the exact cross-Wave shapes. Ownership and
declaration paths remain split by the immediately following owner table: W1
`state.snapshot-contracts` owns capability/lane/cost shapes, the incumbent
`runtime.semantic-dag` owns superstep observation, and W4
`execution.plan-provider-router` owns candidate selection/plan and post-model-
election accounting while the same W4 candidate extends the incumbent
`state.context-compiler` owner with runtime-only materialization through the
sole compiler. The block creates no second compiler, router, store,
governed payload family, registry row, or execution authority:

```swift

public struct BASProposalMechanismEvidence:
    Codable, Sendable, Equatable {
    public let mechanismArtifactID: BASArtifactID
    public let mechanismID: String
    public let mechanismVersion: String
    public let codeOrModelDigest: String
    public let determinismClass: BASProposalMechanismDeterminismClass

    public let usesLearnedInference: Bool

    public let resourceClosureRoot: String

        mechanismArtifactID: BASArtifactID,

        usesLanguageInference: Bool,
        usesLearnedInference: Bool,
        mayOpenGenerate: Bool,
        resourceClosureRoot: String,
        certificationReceiptArtifactID: BASArtifactID
    ) throws {
        guard !mechanismID.isEmpty, !mechanismVersion.isEmpty,
              codeOrModelDigest.count == 64,
              resourceClosureRoot.count == 64

            throw BASContractWireError.invalidState(
                "proposalMechanismEvidence")
        }
        self.mechanismArtifactID = mechanismArtifactID
        self.mechanismID = mechanismID
        self.mechanismVersion = mechanismVersion
        self.codeOrModelDigest = codeOrModelDigest

        self.mayOpenGenerate = mayOpenGenerate
        self.resourceClosureRoot = resourceClosureRoot
        self.certificationReceiptArtifactID =
            certificationReceiptArtifactID
    }

    private enum CodingKeys: String, CodingKey, CaseIterable {
        case mechanismArtifactID
        case mechanismID
        case mechanismVersion
        case codeOrModelDigest
        case determinismClass
        case usesLanguageInference
        case usesLearnedInference
        case mayOpenGenerate
        case resourceClosureRoot
        case certificationReceiptArtifactID
    }

    public init(from decoder: Decoder) throws {
        try BASContractWireValidation.exactKeySet(
            decoder, Set(CodingKeys.allCases.map(\.rawValue)))
        let c = try decoder.container(keyedBy: CodingKeys.self)
        try self.init(
            mechanismArtifactID: c.decode(
                BASArtifactID.self, forKey: .mechanismArtifactID),
            mechanismID: c.decode(String.self, forKey: .mechanismID),
            mechanismVersion: c.decode(
                String.self, forKey: .mechanismVersion),
            codeOrModelDigest: c.decode(
                String.self, forKey: .codeOrModelDigest),
            determinismClass: c.decode(

                String.self, forKey: .resourceClosureRoot),

                BASArtifactID.self,
                forKey: .certificationReceiptArtifactID))

}

extension BASProposalMechanismProof: Codable {
    private enum CodingKeys: String, CodingKey, CaseIterable {
        case kind, evidence
    }

    private enum Kind: String, Codable {
        case deterministic
        case boundedNonLanguageLearned
        case boundedLanguageLearned
        case structuredHuman
        case languageHuman
        case structuredTool
        case languageTool
        case deterministicTool
        case openGenerativeProvider
        case boundedNonLanguageWorldModelSearch

        init(from decoder: Decoder) throws {
            let c = try decoder.singleValueContainer()
            guard let value = Self(rawValue: try c.decode(String.self)) else {
                throw BASContractWireError.invalidState(
                    "proposalMechanismProofKind")
            }
            self = value
        }

        func encode(to encoder: Encoder) throws {
            var c = encoder.singleValueContainer()
            try c.encode(rawValue)
        }
    }

    public init(from decoder: Decoder) throws {
        try BASContractWireValidation.exactKeySet(
            decoder, Set(CodingKeys.allCases.map(\.rawValue)))
        let c = try decoder.container(keyedBy: CodingKeys.self)
        switch try c.decode(Kind.self, forKey: .kind) {
        case .deterministic:
            self = .deterministic(try c.decode(
                BASProposalMechanismEvidence.self, forKey: .evidence))
        case .boundedNonLanguageLearned:
            self = .boundedNonLanguageLearned(try c.decode(
                BASProposalMechanismEvidence.self, forKey: .evidence))
        case .boundedLanguageLearned:
            self = .boundedLanguageLearned(try c.decode(
                BASProposalMechanismEvidence.self, forKey: .evidence))
        case .structuredHuman:
            self = .structuredHuman(try c.decode(
                BASProposalMechanismEvidence.self, forKey: .evidence))
        case .languageHuman:
            self = .languageHuman(try c.decode(
                BASProposalMechanismEvidence.self, forKey: .evidence))
        case .structuredTool:
            self = .structuredTool(try c.decode(
                BASProposalMechanismEvidence.self, forKey: .evidence))
        case .languageTool:
            self = .languageTool(try c.decode(
                BASProposalMechanismEvidence.self, forKey: .evidence))
        case .deterministicTool:
            self = .deterministicTool(try c.decode(
                BASProposalMechanismEvidence.self, forKey: .evidence))
        case .openGenerativeProvider:
            self = .openGenerativeProvider(try c.decode(
                BASProposalMechanismEvidence.self, forKey: .evidence))
        case .boundedNonLanguageWorldModelSearch:
            self = .boundedNonLanguageWorldModelSearch(try c.decode(
                BASWorldModelSearchCausalProof.self, forKey: .evidence))
        }
    }

    public func encode(to encoder: Encoder) throws {
        var c = encoder.container(keyedBy: CodingKeys.self)
        switch self {
        case .deterministic(let evidence):
            try c.encode(Kind.deterministic, forKey: .kind)
            try c.encode(evidence, forKey: .evidence)
        case .boundedNonLanguageLearned(let evidence):
            try c.encode(Kind.boundedNonLanguageLearned, forKey: .kind)
            try c.encode(evidence, forKey: .evidence)
        case .boundedLanguageLearned(let evidence):
            try c.encode(Kind.boundedLanguageLearned, forKey: .kind)
            try c.encode(evidence, forKey: .evidence)
        case .structuredHuman(let evidence):
            try c.encode(Kind.structuredHuman, forKey: .kind)
            try c.encode(evidence, forKey: .evidence)
        case .languageHuman(let evidence):
            try c.encode(Kind.languageHuman, forKey: .kind)
            try c.encode(evidence, forKey: .evidence)
        case .structuredTool(let evidence):
            try c.encode(Kind.structuredTool, forKey: .kind)
            try c.encode(evidence, forKey: .evidence)
        case .languageTool(let evidence):
            try c.encode(Kind.languageTool, forKey: .kind)
            try c.encode(evidence, forKey: .evidence)
        case .deterministicTool(let evidence):
            try c.encode(Kind.deterministicTool, forKey: .kind)
            try c.encode(evidence, forKey: .evidence)
        case .openGenerativeProvider(let evidence):
            try c.encode(Kind.openGenerativeProvider, forKey: .kind)
            try c.encode(evidence, forKey: .evidence)
        case .boundedNonLanguageWorldModelSearch(let evidence):
            try c.encode(
                Kind.boundedNonLanguageWorldModelSearch, forKey: .kind)
            try c.encode(evidence, forKey: .evidence)
        }
    }
}

extension BASProposalMechanismProof {
    package func validateExactFactsCandidateAndProfile(
        candidateKind: BASProposalCandidateKind,
        capabilityProfile: BASCapabilityExecutionProfile? = nil
    ) throws {
        let factsAreExact: Bool
        switch self {
        case .deterministic(let e), .deterministicTool(let e):
            factsAreExact = e.determinismClass == .deterministic &&
                !e.usesLanguageInference && !e.usesLearnedInference &&
                !e.mayOpenGenerate
        case .boundedNonLanguageLearned(let e):
            factsAreExact = e.determinismClass == .boundedNondeterministic &&
                !e.usesLanguageInference && e.usesLearnedInference &&
                !e.mayOpenGenerate
        case .boundedLanguageLearned(let e):
            factsAreExact = e.determinismClass == .boundedNondeterministic &&
                e.usesLanguageInference && e.usesLearnedInference &&
                !e.mayOpenGenerate
        case .structuredHuman(let e), .structuredTool(let e):
            factsAreExact = e.determinismClass == .externallySupplied &&
                !e.usesLanguageInference && !e.usesLearnedInference &&
                !e.mayOpenGenerate
        case .languageHuman(let e), .languageTool(let e):
            factsAreExact = e.determinismClass == .externallySupplied &&
                e.usesLanguageInference && !e.usesLearnedInference &&
                !e.mayOpenGenerate
        case .openGenerativeProvider(let e):
            factsAreExact = e.determinismClass == .providerOpaque &&
                e.usesLanguageInference && e.usesLearnedInference &&
                e.mayOpenGenerate
        case .boundedNonLanguageWorldModelSearch(let causal):
            let e = causal.mechanismEvidence
            factsAreExact = e.determinismClass == .boundedNondeterministic &&
                !e.usesLanguageInference && e.usesLearnedInference &&
                !e.mayOpenGenerate
        }
        guard factsAreExact else {
            throw BASContractWireError.invalidState(
                "proposalMechanismProofFacts")
        }

        let candidateIsExact: Bool
        switch (candidateKind, self) {
        case (.rule, .deterministic), (.search, .deterministic),
             (.search, .boundedNonLanguageWorldModelSearch),
             (.classicML, .boundedNonLanguageLearned),
             (.classicML, .boundedLanguageLearned),
             (.human, .structuredHuman), (.human, .languageHuman),
             (.tool, .structuredTool), (.tool, .languageTool),
             (.tool, .deterministicTool),
             (.model, .openGenerativeProvider):
            candidateIsExact = true
        default:
            candidateIsExact = false
        }
        guard candidateIsExact else {
            throw BASContractWireError.invalidState(
                "proposalCandidateMechanismProof")
        }

        guard let capabilityProfile else { return }
        let profileIsExact: Bool
        switch (capabilityProfile, self) {
        case (.fullProvider, _),
             (.noGenerativeProvider, .deterministic),
             (.noGenerativeProvider, .boundedNonLanguageLearned),
             (.noGenerativeProvider, .boundedLanguageLearned),
             (.noGenerativeProvider, .structuredHuman),
             (.noGenerativeProvider, .languageHuman),
             (.noGenerativeProvider, .structuredTool),
             (.noGenerativeProvider, .languageTool),
             (.noGenerativeProvider, .deterministicTool),
             (.noGenerativeProvider, .boundedNonLanguageWorldModelSearch),
             (.noLanguageInference, .deterministic),
             (.noLanguageInference, .boundedNonLanguageLearned),
             (.noLanguageInference, .structuredHuman),
             (.noLanguageInference, .structuredTool),
             (.noLanguageInference, .deterministicTool),
             (.noLanguageInference, .boundedNonLanguageWorldModelSearch),
             (.noLearnedInference, .deterministic),
             (.noLearnedInference, .structuredHuman),
             (.noLearnedInference, .structuredTool),
             (.noLearnedInference, .deterministicTool):
            profileIsExact = true
        default:
            profileIsExact = false
        }
        guard profileIsExact else {
            throw BASContractWireError.invalidState(
                "proposalProfileMechanismProof")
        }
    }
}

public struct BASNonModelProposalPlan: Codable, Sendable, Equatable {
    public let candidateKind:
        BASProposalCandidateKind
    public let mechanismProof: BASProposalMechanismProof
    public let planDigest: String
    public let algorithmOrCapabilityArtifactID: BASArtifactID
    public let boundedResourcePolicyArtifactID: BASArtifactID
    public let expectedOutputSchemaArtifactID: BASArtifactID
    public let orderedCausalParentArtifactIDs: [BASArtifactID]

    public init(
        candidateKind: BASProposalCandidateKind,
        mechanismProof: BASProposalMechanismProof,
        planDigest: String,
        algorithmOrCapabilityArtifactID: BASArtifactID,
        boundedResourcePolicyArtifactID: BASArtifactID,
        expectedOutputSchemaArtifactID: BASArtifactID,
        orderedCausalParentArtifactIDs: [BASArtifactID]
    ) throws {
        try mechanismProof.validateExactFactsCandidateAndProfile(
            candidateKind: candidateKind)
        let worldCausalBindingIsExact: Bool
        if case .boundedNonLanguageWorldModelSearch(let causalProof) =
            mechanismProof {
            worldCausalBindingIsExact =
                candidateKind == .search &&
                algorithmOrCapabilityArtifactID ==
                    causalProof.searchPlanArtifactID &&
                orderedCausalParentArtifactIDs ==
                    [causalProof.predictionEvidenceArtifactID]
        } else {
            worldCausalBindingIsExact = true
        }
        guard candidateKind != .model,
              worldCausalBindingIsExact, planDigest.count == 64,
              Set(orderedCausalParentArtifactIDs).count ==
                orderedCausalParentArtifactIDs.count
        else {
            throw BASContractWireError.invalidState("nonModelProposalPlan")
        }
        self.candidateKind = candidateKind
        self.mechanismProof = mechanismProof
        self.planDigest = planDigest
        self.algorithmOrCapabilityArtifactID =
            algorithmOrCapabilityArtifactID
        self.boundedResourcePolicyArtifactID =
            boundedResourcePolicyArtifactID
        self.expectedOutputSchemaArtifactID =
            expectedOutputSchemaArtifactID
        self.orderedCausalParentArtifactIDs =
            orderedCausalParentArtifactIDs
    }

    private enum CodingKeys: String, CodingKey, CaseIterable {
        case candidateKind, mechanismProof, planDigest
        case algorithmOrCapabilityArtifactID
        case boundedResourcePolicyArtifactID
        case expectedOutputSchemaArtifactID
        case orderedCausalParentArtifactIDs
    }

    public init(from decoder: Decoder) throws {
        try BASContractWireValidation.exactKeySet(
            decoder, Set(CodingKeys.allCases.map(\.rawValue)))
        let c = try decoder.container(keyedBy: CodingKeys.self)
        try self.init(
            candidateKind: c.decode(
                BASProposalCandidateKind.self, forKey: .candidateKind),
            mechanismProof: c.decode(
                BASProposalMechanismProof.self, forKey: .mechanismProof),
            planDigest: c.decode(String.self, forKey: .planDigest),
            algorithmOrCapabilityArtifactID: c.decode(
                BASArtifactID.self,
                forKey: .algorithmOrCapabilityArtifactID),
            boundedResourcePolicyArtifactID: c.decode(
                BASArtifactID.self,
                forKey: .boundedResourcePolicyArtifactID),
            expectedOutputSchemaArtifactID: c.decode(
                BASArtifactID.self,
                forKey: .expectedOutputSchemaArtifactID),
            orderedCausalParentArtifactIDs: c.decode(
                [BASArtifactID].self,
                forKey: .orderedCausalParentArtifactIDs))
    }
}

public enum BASNonModelProposalInputProfile: String, Codable, Sendable {
    case structuredPacketDirect
    case tensorState

public struct BASNonModelProposalInput: Codable, Sendable, Equatable {
    public let profile: BASNonModelProposalInputProfile
    public let structuredContextPacketDigest:
        String
    public let selectedPlan: BASNonModelProposalPlan

    public init(
        profile: BASNonModelProposalInputProfile,
        structuredContextPacketDigest: String,
        selectedPlan: BASNonModelProposalPlan
    ) throws {
        let expectedProfile: BASNonModelProposalInputProfile
        switch selectedPlan.candidateKind {
        case .rule: expectedProfile = .policyState
        case .search: expectedProfile = .constraintGraph
        case .classicML: expectedProfile = .tensorState
        case .human: expectedProfile = .structuredPacketDirect
        case .tool: expectedProfile = .programIR
        case .model:
            throw BASContractWireError.invalidState("nonModelInputModelKind")
        }
        guard !structuredContextPacketDigest.isEmpty,
              selectedPlan.candidateKind != .model,
              profile == expectedProfile
        else {
            throw BASContractWireError.invalidState("nonModelProposalInput")
        }
        self.profile = profile
        self.structuredContextPacketDigest = structuredContextPacketDigest
        self.selectedPlan = selectedPlan
    }

    package func validateCapabilityProfile(
        _ capabilityProfile: BASCapabilityExecutionProfile
    ) throws {
        try selectedPlan.mechanismProof
            .validateExactFactsCandidateAndProfile(
                candidateKind: selectedPlan.candidateKind,
                capabilityProfile: capabilityProfile)
    }

    private enum CodingKeys: String, CodingKey, CaseIterable {
        case profile, structuredContextPacketDigest, selectedPlan
    }

    public init(from decoder: Decoder) throws {
        try BASContractWireValidation.exactKeySet(
            decoder, Set(CodingKeys.allCases.map(\.rawValue)))
        let c = try decoder.container(keyedBy: CodingKeys.self)
        try self.init(
            profile: c.decode(
                BASNonModelProposalInputProfile.self, forKey: .profile),
            structuredContextPacketDigest: c.decode(
                String.self, forKey: .structuredContextPacketDigest),
            selectedPlan: c.decode(
                BASNonModelProposalPlan.self, forKey: .selectedPlan))
    }
}

extension BASGroundingProposalBranch: Codable {

    public init(from decoder: Decoder) throws {

        let c = try decoder.container(keyedBy: CodingKeys.self)
        let evidence = try c.decode(BASArtifactID.self, forKey: .evidence)
        switch try c.decode(Kind.self, forKey: .kind) {
        case .model: self = .model(evidence)
        case .boundedInference: self = .boundedInference(evidence)

        case .model(let id): (kind, evidence) = (.model, id)

            (kind, evidence) = (.boundedInference, id)

        case .humanOrTool(let id): (kind, evidence) = (.humanOrTool, id)
        case .notRequired(let id): (kind, evidence) = (.notRequired, id)
        }
        try c.encode(kind, forKey: .kind)

public struct BASGroundingReceipt: Codable, Sendable, Equatable {
    public let turnOperationRef: BASTurnOperationRef
    public let attemptRefArtifactID: BASArtifactID
    public let structuredContextPacketDigest: String
    public let capabilityProfile: BASCapabilityExecutionProfile
    public let candidateKind: BASProposalCandidateKind?
    public let mechanismProof: BASProposalMechanismProof?
    public let branch: BASGroundingProposalBranch

    public init(
        turnOperationRef: BASTurnOperationRef,
        attemptRefArtifactID: BASArtifactID,
        structuredContextPacketDigest: String,
        capabilityProfile: BASCapabilityExecutionProfile,
        candidateKind: BASProposalCandidateKind?,
        mechanismProof: BASProposalMechanismProof?,
        branch: BASGroundingProposalBranch
    ) throws {
        guard !structuredContextPacketDigest.isEmpty else {
            throw BASContractWireError.invalidState("groundingPacketDigest")
        }
        try Self.validateWireCompatibility(
            capabilityProfile: capabilityProfile,
            candidateKind: candidateKind,
            mechanismProof: mechanismProof,
            branch: branch)
        self.turnOperationRef = turnOperationRef
        self.attemptRefArtifactID = attemptRefArtifactID
        self.structuredContextPacketDigest = structuredContextPacketDigest
        self.capabilityProfile = capabilityProfile
        self.candidateKind = candidateKind
        self.mechanismProof = mechanismProof
        self.branch = branch
    }

    private static func validateWireCompatibility(
        capabilityProfile: BASCapabilityExecutionProfile,
        candidateKind: BASProposalCandidateKind?,
        mechanismProof: BASProposalMechanismProof?,
        branch: BASGroundingProposalBranch
    ) throws {
        if case .notRequired = branch {
            guard candidateKind == nil, mechanismProof == nil else {
                throw BASContractWireError.invalidState(
                    "groundingNotRequiredPresence")
            }
            return
        }
        guard let candidateKind, let mechanismProof else {
            throw BASContractWireError.invalidState(
                "groundingCandidateProofPresence")
        }
        try mechanismProof.validateExactFactsCandidateAndProfile(
            candidateKind: candidateKind,
            capabilityProfile: capabilityProfile)
        let compatible: Bool
        switch (capabilityProfile, candidateKind, mechanismProof, branch) {
        case (.fullProvider, .model, .openGenerativeProvider, .model):
            compatible = true
        case (.fullProvider, .classicML, .boundedNonLanguageLearned,
              .boundedInference),
             (.fullProvider, .classicML, .boundedLanguageLearned,
              .boundedInference),
             (.noGenerativeProvider, .classicML,
              .boundedNonLanguageLearned, .boundedInference),
             (.noGenerativeProvider, .classicML,
              .boundedLanguageLearned, .boundedInference),
             (.noLanguageInference, .classicML,
              .boundedNonLanguageLearned, .boundedInference),
             (.fullProvider, .search,
              .boundedNonLanguageWorldModelSearch, .boundedInference),
             (.noGenerativeProvider, .search,
              .boundedNonLanguageWorldModelSearch, .boundedInference),
             (.noLanguageInference, .search,
              .boundedNonLanguageWorldModelSearch, .boundedInference):
            compatible = true
        case (_, .rule, .deterministic, .deterministic),
             (_, .search, .deterministic, .deterministic):
            compatible = true
        case (.fullProvider, .human, .structuredHuman, .humanOrTool),
             (.fullProvider, .human, .languageHuman, .humanOrTool),
             (.fullProvider, .tool, .structuredTool, .humanOrTool),
             (.fullProvider, .tool, .languageTool, .humanOrTool),
             (.fullProvider, .tool, .deterministicTool, .humanOrTool),
             (.noGenerativeProvider, .human, .structuredHuman, .humanOrTool),
             (.noGenerativeProvider, .human, .languageHuman, .humanOrTool),
             (.noGenerativeProvider, .tool, .structuredTool, .humanOrTool),
             (.noGenerativeProvider, .tool, .languageTool, .humanOrTool),
             (.noGenerativeProvider, .tool, .deterministicTool, .humanOrTool),
             (.noLanguageInference, .human, .structuredHuman, .humanOrTool),
             (.noLanguageInference, .tool, .structuredTool, .humanOrTool),
             (.noLanguageInference, .tool, .deterministicTool, .humanOrTool),
             (.noLearnedInference, .human, .structuredHuman, .humanOrTool),
             (.noLearnedInference, .tool, .structuredTool, .humanOrTool),
             (.noLearnedInference, .tool, .deterministicTool, .humanOrTool):
            compatible = true
        default:
            compatible = false
        }
        guard compatible else {
            throw BASContractWireError.invalidState(
                "groundingProfileCandidateProofBranch")
        }
    }

    private enum CodingKeys: String, CodingKey, CaseIterable {
        case turnOperationRef, attemptRefArtifactID
        case structuredContextPacketDigest, capabilityProfile
        case candidateKind, mechanismProof, branch
    }

    public init(from decoder: Decoder) throws {
        try BASContractWireValidation.exactKeySet(
            decoder, Set(CodingKeys.allCases.map(\.rawValue)))
        let c = try decoder.container(keyedBy: CodingKeys.self)
        guard c.contains(.candidateKind), c.contains(.mechanismProof) else {
            throw BASContractWireError.invalidState(
                "groundingOptionalPresence")
        }
        try self.init(
            turnOperationRef: c.decode(
                BASTurnOperationRef.self, forKey: .turnOperationRef),
            attemptRefArtifactID: c.decode(
                BASArtifactID.self, forKey: .attemptRefArtifactID),
            structuredContextPacketDigest: c.decode(
                String.self, forKey: .structuredContextPacketDigest),
            capabilityProfile: c.decode(
                BASCapabilityExecutionProfile.self,
                forKey: .capabilityProfile),
            candidateKind: c.decodeIfPresent(
                BASProposalCandidateKind.self, forKey: .candidateKind),
            mechanismProof: c.decodeIfPresent(
                BASProposalMechanismProof.self, forKey: .mechanismProof),
            branch: c.decode(
                BASGroundingProposalBranch.self, forKey: .branch))
    }

    public func encode(to encoder: Encoder) throws {
        var c = encoder.container(keyedBy: CodingKeys.self)
        try c.encode(turnOperationRef, forKey: .turnOperationRef)
        try c.encode(attemptRefArtifactID, forKey: .attemptRefArtifactID)
        try c.encode(
            structuredContextPacketDigest,
            forKey: .structuredContextPacketDigest)
        try c.encode(capabilityProfile, forKey: .capabilityProfile)
        if let candidateKind {
            try c.encode(candidateKind, forKey: .candidateKind)
        } else {
            try c.encodeNil(forKey: .candidateKind)
        }
        if let mechanismProof {
            try c.encode(mechanismProof, forKey: .mechanismProof)
        } else {
            try c.encodeNil(forKey: .mechanismProof)
        }
        try c.encode(branch, forKey: .branch)
    }
}

public enum BASSuperstepSevenExecutionKind: Sendable, Equatable {
    case providerPrefillDecode(BASSuperstepSevenProviderWork)
    case boundedInference(BASSuperstepSevenNonProviderWork)
    case deterministicProposal(BASSuperstepSevenNonProviderWork)
    case humanOrTool(BASSuperstepSevenNonProviderWork)
    case noWork(BASSuperstepSevenNoWorkEvidence)
}

extension BASSuperstepSevenExecutionKind: Codable {
    private enum CodingKeys: String, CodingKey, CaseIterable {
        case kind, evidence
    }

    private enum Kind: String, Codable {
        case providerPrefillDecode
        case boundedInference
        case deterministicProposal
        case humanOrTool
        case noWork

        init(from decoder: Decoder) throws {
            let c = try decoder.singleValueContainer()
            guard let value = Self(rawValue: try c.decode(String.self)) else {
                throw BASContractWireError.invalidState(
                    "superstepSevenExecutionKind")
            }
            self = value
        }

        func encode(to encoder: Encoder) throws {
            var c = encoder.singleValueContainer()
            try c.encode(rawValue)
        }
    }

    public init(from decoder: Decoder) throws {
        try BASContractWireValidation.exactKeySet(
            decoder, Set(CodingKeys.allCases.map(\.rawValue)))
        let c = try decoder.container(keyedBy: CodingKeys.self)
        switch try c.decode(Kind.self, forKey: .kind) {
        case .providerPrefillDecode:
            self = .providerPrefillDecode(try c.decode(
                BASSuperstepSevenProviderWork.self, forKey: .evidence))
        case .boundedInference:
            self = .boundedInference(try c.decode(
                BASSuperstepSevenNonProviderWork.self, forKey: .evidence))
        case .deterministicProposal:
            self = .deterministicProposal(try c.decode(
                BASSuperstepSevenNonProviderWork.self, forKey: .evidence))
        case .humanOrTool:
            self = .humanOrTool(try c.decode(
                BASSuperstepSevenNonProviderWork.self, forKey: .evidence))
        case .noWork:
            self = .noWork(try c.decode(
                BASSuperstepSevenNoWorkEvidence.self, forKey: .evidence))
        }
    }

    public func encode(to encoder: Encoder) throws {
        var c = encoder.container(keyedBy: CodingKeys.self)
        switch self {
        case .providerPrefillDecode(let work):
            try c.encode(Kind.providerPrefillDecode, forKey: .kind)
            try c.encode(work, forKey: .evidence)
        case .boundedInference(let work):
            try c.encode(Kind.boundedInference, forKey: .kind)
            try c.encode(work, forKey: .evidence)
        case .deterministicProposal(let work):
            try c.encode(Kind.deterministicProposal, forKey: .kind)
            try c.encode(work, forKey: .evidence)
        case .humanOrTool(let work):
            try c.encode(Kind.humanOrTool, forKey: .kind)
            try c.encode(work, forKey: .evidence)
        case .noWork(let work):
            try c.encode(Kind.noWork, forKey: .kind)
            try c.encode(work, forKey: .evidence)
        }
    }
}

public struct BASSuperstepSevenObservationReceipt:
    Codable, Sendable, Equatable {
    public static let compatibilityName = "Prefill and Decode"
    public let turnOperationRef: BASTurnOperationRef
    public let attemptRefArtifactID: BASArtifactID
    public let structuredContextPacketDigest: String
    public let capabilityProfile: BASCapabilityExecutionProfile
    public let superstepOrdinal: UInt8

        structuredContextPacketDigest: String,
        capabilityProfile: BASCapabilityExecutionProfile,
        superstepOrdinal: UInt8,
        work: BASSuperstepSevenExecutionKind
    ) throws {
        guard superstepOrdinal == 7 else {
            throw BASContractWireError.invalidState("superstepSevenOrdinal")
        }
        try Self.validateProfileWorkCompatibility(
            capabilityProfile: capabilityProfile, work: work)
        self.turnOperationRef = turnOperationRef
        self.attemptRefArtifactID = attemptRefArtifactID
        self.structuredContextPacketDigest = structuredContextPacketDigest
        self.capabilityProfile = capabilityProfile
        self.superstepOrdinal = superstepOrdinal
        self.work = work
    }

    package static func validateProfileWorkCompatibility(
        capabilityProfile: BASCapabilityExecutionProfile,
        work: BASSuperstepSevenExecutionKind
    ) throws {
        switch work {
        case .providerPrefillDecode(let evidence):
            try evidence.mechanismProof
                .validateExactFactsCandidateAndProfile(
                    candidateKind: .model,
                    capabilityProfile: capabilityProfile)
        case .boundedInference(let evidence),
             .deterministicProposal(let evidence),
             .humanOrTool(let evidence):
            try evidence.mechanismProof
                .validateExactFactsCandidateAndProfile(
                    candidateKind: evidence.candidateKind,
                    capabilityProfile: capabilityProfile)
        case .noWork:
            break
        }
        let compatible: Bool
        switch (capabilityProfile, work) {
        case (.fullProvider, .providerPrefillDecode(let evidence)):
            switch evidence.mechanismProof {
            case .openGenerativeProvider:
                compatible = true
            default:
                compatible = false
            }
        case (.fullProvider, .boundedInference(let evidence)),
             (.noGenerativeProvider, .boundedInference(let evidence)):
            switch (evidence.candidateKind, evidence.mechanismProof) {
            case (.classicML, .boundedNonLanguageLearned),
                 (.classicML, .boundedLanguageLearned),
                 (.search, .boundedNonLanguageWorldModelSearch):
                compatible = true
            default:
                compatible = false
            }
        case (.noLanguageInference, .boundedInference(let evidence)):
            switch (evidence.candidateKind, evidence.mechanismProof) {
            case (.classicML, .boundedNonLanguageLearned),
                 (.search, .boundedNonLanguageWorldModelSearch):
                compatible = true
            default:
                compatible = false
            }
        case (.fullProvider, .deterministicProposal(let evidence)),
             (.noGenerativeProvider, .deterministicProposal(let evidence)),
             (.noLanguageInference, .deterministicProposal(let evidence)),
             (.noLearnedInference, .deterministicProposal(let evidence)):
            switch (evidence.candidateKind, evidence.mechanismProof) {
            case (.rule, .deterministic), (.search, .deterministic):
                compatible = true
            default:
                compatible = false
            }
        case (.fullProvider, .humanOrTool(let evidence)),
             (.noGenerativeProvider, .humanOrTool(let evidence)):
            switch (evidence.candidateKind, evidence.mechanismProof) {
            case (.human, .structuredHuman), (.human, .languageHuman),
                 (.tool, .structuredTool), (.tool, .languageTool),
                 (.tool, .deterministicTool):
                compatible = true
            default:
                compatible = false
            }
        case (.noLanguageInference, .humanOrTool(let evidence)),
             (.noLearnedInference, .humanOrTool(let evidence)):
            switch (evidence.candidateKind, evidence.mechanismProof) {
            case (.human, .structuredHuman), (.tool, .structuredTool),
                 (.tool, .deterministicTool):
                compatible = true
            default:
                compatible = false
            }
        case (_, .noWork):
            compatible = true
        default:
            compatible = false
        }
        guard compatible else {
            throw BASContractWireError.invalidState(
                "superstepSevenProfileWorkMechanism")
        }
    }

    private enum CodingKeys: String, CodingKey, CaseIterable {
        case turnOperationRef, attemptRefArtifactID
        case structuredContextPacketDigest, capabilityProfile
        case superstepOrdinal, work
    }

    public init(from decoder: Decoder) throws {
        try BASContractWireValidation.exactKeySet(
            decoder, Set(CodingKeys.allCases.map(\.rawValue)))
        let c = try decoder.container(keyedBy: CodingKeys.self)
        let turnOperationRef = try c.decode(
            BASTurnOperationRef.self, forKey: .turnOperationRef)
        let attemptRefArtifactID = try c.decode(
            BASArtifactID.self, forKey: .attemptRefArtifactID)
        let structuredContextPacketDigest = try c.decode(
            String.self, forKey: .structuredContextPacketDigest)
        let capabilityProfile = try c.decode(
            BASCapabilityExecutionProfile.self, forKey: .capabilityProfile)
        let superstepOrdinal = try c.decode(
            UInt8.self, forKey: .superstepOrdinal)
        let work = try c.decode(
            BASSuperstepSevenExecutionKind.self, forKey: .work)
        guard superstepOrdinal == UInt8(7) else {
            throw BASContractWireError.invalidState("superstepSevenOrdinal")
        }
        try Self.validateProfileWorkCompatibility(
            capabilityProfile: capabilityProfile, work: work)
        self.turnOperationRef = turnOperationRef
        self.attemptRefArtifactID = attemptRefArtifactID
        self.structuredContextPacketDigest = structuredContextPacketDigest
        self.capabilityProfile = capabilityProfile
        self.superstepOrdinal = superstepOrdinal
        self.work = work
    }
}

public struct BASModelNeutralMarketCost: Codable, Sendable, Equatable {
    public let schemaVersion: String
    public let structuredContextPacketDigest:
        String
    public let resourceInventoryDigest: String
    public let canonicalByteCount: UInt64
    public let canonicalSectionCount: UInt64
    public let resourceUnitCount: UInt64
    public let conservativeTokenCost: UInt64
    public let derivationRuleID: String

    package init(
        schemaVersion: String,
        structuredContextPacketDigest: String,
        resourceInventoryDigest: String,
        canonicalByteCount: UInt64,
        canonicalSectionCount: UInt64,
        resourceUnitCount: UInt64,
        conservativeTokenCost: UInt64,
        derivationRuleID: String
    ) throws {
        let byteUnits = canonicalByteCount
        let (sectionUnits, sectionOverflow) =
            canonicalSectionCount.multipliedReportingOverflow(by: 8)
        let (resourceUnits, resourceOverflow) =
            resourceUnitCount.multipliedReportingOverflow(by: 32)
        let (partialCost, partialOverflow) =
            byteUnits.addingReportingOverflow(sectionUnits)
        let (derivedCost, totalOverflow) =
            partialCost.addingReportingOverflow(resourceUnits)
        guard schemaVersion == "1.0.0",
              derivationRuleID == "qinao.market-token-units.v1",
              !sectionOverflow, !resourceOverflow,
              !partialOverflow, !totalOverflow,
              conservativeTokenCost == derivedCost
        else {
            throw BASContractWireError.invalidState("marketCostDerivationRule")
        }
        self.schemaVersion = schemaVersion
        self.structuredContextPacketDigest = structuredContextPacketDigest
        self.resourceInventoryDigest = resourceInventoryDigest
        self.canonicalByteCount = canonicalByteCount
        self.canonicalSectionCount = canonicalSectionCount
        self.resourceUnitCount = resourceUnitCount
        self.conservativeTokenCost = conservativeTokenCost
        self.derivationRuleID = derivationRuleID
    }

    private enum CodingKeys: String, CodingKey, CaseIterable {
        case schemaVersion, structuredContextPacketDigest
        case resourceInventoryDigest, canonicalByteCount, canonicalSectionCount
        case resourceUnitCount, conservativeTokenCost, derivationRuleID
    }

    public init(from decoder: Decoder) throws {
        try BASContractWireValidation.exactKeySet(
            decoder, Set(CodingKeys.allCases.map(\.rawValue)))
        let c = try decoder.container(keyedBy: CodingKeys.self)
        try self.init(
            schemaVersion: c.decode(String.self, forKey: .schemaVersion),
            structuredContextPacketDigest: c.decode(
                String.self, forKey: .structuredContextPacketDigest),
            resourceInventoryDigest: c.decode(
                String.self, forKey: .resourceInventoryDigest),
            canonicalByteCount: c.decode(
                UInt64.self, forKey: .canonicalByteCount),
            canonicalSectionCount: c.decode(
                UInt64.self, forKey: .canonicalSectionCount),
            resourceUnitCount: c.decode(
                UInt64.self, forKey: .resourceUnitCount),
            conservativeTokenCost: c.decode(
                UInt64.self, forKey: .conservativeTokenCost),
            derivationRuleID: c.decode(String.self, forKey: .derivationRuleID))
    }
}
```
