    public let purposeID: String
    public let minimumDelayMs: UInt64
    public let maximumDelayMs: UInt64

    public init(
        outcomeSchemaArtifactID: BASArtifactID,
        outcomeSchemaDigest: String,
        sourceOwnerID: String,
        evidenceClass: BASInteractionEvidenceClass,
        independentEvidenceRequirementArtifactID: BASArtifactID,
        purposeID: String,
        minimumDelayMs: UInt64,
        maximumDelayMs: UInt64
    ) throws {
        try BASContractWireValidation.artifact(
            outcomeSchemaArtifactID, field: "outcomeSchemaArtifactID")
        try BASContractWireValidation.digest(
            outcomeSchemaDigest, field: "outcomeSchemaDigest")
        try BASContractWireValidation.identifier(
            sourceOwnerID, field: "sourceOwnerID")
        try BASContractWireValidation.artifact(
            independentEvidenceRequirementArtifactID,
            field: "independentEvidenceRequirementArtifactID")
        try BASContractWireValidation.identifier(
            purposeID, field: "purposeID")
        guard evidenceClass == .experienceSource
                || evidenceClass == .derivedOutcomeFeature,
              minimumDelayMs <= maximumDelayMs,
              maximumDelayMs > 0
        else {
            throw BASContractWireError.invalidState(
                "outcomeSourceClassOrWindow")
        }
        self.outcomeSchemaArtifactID = outcomeSchemaArtifactID
        self.outcomeSchemaDigest = outcomeSchemaDigest
        self.sourceOwnerID = sourceOwnerID
        self.evidenceClass = evidenceClass
        self.independentEvidenceRequirementArtifactID =
            independentEvidenceRequirementArtifactID
        self.purposeID = purposeID
        self.minimumDelayMs = minimumDelayMs
        self.maximumDelayMs = maximumDelayMs
    }

    private enum CodingKeys: String, CodingKey, CaseIterable {
        case outcomeSchemaArtifactID, outcomeSchemaDigest, sourceOwnerID
        case evidenceClass, independentEvidenceRequirementArtifactID
        case purposeID, minimumDelayMs, maximumDelayMs
    }

    public init(from decoder: Decoder) throws {
        try BASContractWireValidation.exactKeys(
            decoder, Set(CodingKeys.allCases.map(\.rawValue)))
        let c = try decoder.container(keyedBy: CodingKeys.self)
        try self.init(
            outcomeSchemaArtifactID: c.decode(
                BASArtifactID.self, forKey: .outcomeSchemaArtifactID),
            outcomeSchemaDigest: c.decode(
                String.self, forKey: .outcomeSchemaDigest),
            sourceOwnerID: c.decode(String.self, forKey: .sourceOwnerID),
            evidenceClass: c.decode(
                BASInteractionEvidenceClass.self, forKey: .evidenceClass),
            independentEvidenceRequirementArtifactID: c.decode(
                BASArtifactID.self,
                forKey: .independentEvidenceRequirementArtifactID),
            purposeID: c.decode(String.self, forKey: .purposeID),
            minimumDelayMs: c.decode(UInt64.self, forKey: .minimumDelayMs),
            maximumDelayMs: c.decode(UInt64.self, forKey: .maximumDelayMs))
    }
}

public struct BASExperienceExposureContract:
    BASSchemaVersioned, Codable, Sendable, Equatable {
    public static let currentSchemaVersion = "1.0.0"
    public let schemaVersion: String
    public let exposureContractID: String
    public let semanticSnapshotArtifactID: BASArtifactID
    public let orderedCandidateActions: [BASExperienceActionCandidate]
    public let selectedActionID: String
    public let behaviorPolicyID: String
    public let behaviorPolicyDigest: String
    public let decisionMarker: BASExperienceDecisionMarker
    public let exposureID: String
    public let cohortID: String
    public let exposedAtTrustedWallMs: Int64
    public let correlationClasses: BASExperienceCorrelationClasses
    public let outcomeWindowStartMs: Int64
    public let outcomeWindowEndMs: Int64
    public let censoringPolicy: BASExperienceCensoringPolicy
    public let missingnessPolicy: BASExperienceMissingnessPolicy
    public let outcomeSourceContract: BASExperienceOutcomeSourceContract

    public init(
        schemaVersion: String = Self.currentSchemaVersion,
        exposureContractID: String,
        semanticSnapshotArtifactID: BASArtifactID,
        orderedCandidateActions: [BASExperienceActionCandidate],
        selectedActionID: String,
        behaviorPolicyID: String,
        behaviorPolicyDigest: String,
        decisionMarker: BASExperienceDecisionMarker,
        exposureID: String,
        cohortID: String,
        exposedAtTrustedWallMs: Int64,
        correlationClasses: BASExperienceCorrelationClasses,
        outcomeWindowStartMs: Int64,
        outcomeWindowEndMs: Int64,
        censoringPolicy: BASExperienceCensoringPolicy,
        missingnessPolicy: BASExperienceMissingnessPolicy,
        outcomeSourceContract: BASExperienceOutcomeSourceContract
    ) throws {
        try BASContractWireValidation.schema(
            schemaVersion, current: Self.currentSchemaVersion)
        for (field, value) in [
            ("exposureContractID", exposureContractID),
            ("selectedActionID", selectedActionID),
            ("behaviorPolicyID", behaviorPolicyID),
            ("exposureID", exposureID),
            ("cohortID", cohortID),
        ] {
            try BASContractWireValidation.identifier(value, field: field)
        }
        try BASContractWireValidation.artifact(
            semanticSnapshotArtifactID,
            field: "semanticSnapshotArtifactID")
        try BASContractWireValidation.digest(
            behaviorPolicyDigest, field: "behaviorPolicyDigest")
        let actionIDs = orderedCandidateActions.map(\.actionID)
        guard !actionIDs.isEmpty,
              Set(actionIDs).count == actionIDs.count,
              actionIDs.contains(selectedActionID),
              exposedAtTrustedWallMs > 0,
              outcomeWindowStartMs >= exposedAtTrustedWallMs,
              outcomeWindowStartMs < outcomeWindowEndMs,
              UInt64(outcomeWindowEndMs - outcomeWindowStartMs)
                <= outcomeSourceContract.maximumDelayMs
        else {
            throw BASContractWireError.invalidState(
                "exposureActionSetOrOutcomeWindow")
        }
        self.schemaVersion = schemaVersion
        self.exposureContractID = exposureContractID
        self.semanticSnapshotArtifactID = semanticSnapshotArtifactID
        self.orderedCandidateActions = orderedCandidateActions
        self.selectedActionID = selectedActionID
        self.behaviorPolicyID = behaviorPolicyID
        self.behaviorPolicyDigest = behaviorPolicyDigest
        self.decisionMarker = decisionMarker
        self.exposureID = exposureID
        self.cohortID = cohortID
        self.exposedAtTrustedWallMs = exposedAtTrustedWallMs
        self.correlationClasses = correlationClasses
        self.outcomeWindowStartMs = outcomeWindowStartMs
        self.outcomeWindowEndMs = outcomeWindowEndMs
        self.censoringPolicy = censoringPolicy
        self.missingnessPolicy = missingnessPolicy
        self.outcomeSourceContract = outcomeSourceContract
    }

    private enum CodingKeys: String, CodingKey, CaseIterable {
        case schemaVersion, exposureContractID, semanticSnapshotArtifactID
        case orderedCandidateActions, selectedActionID
        case behaviorPolicyID, behaviorPolicyDigest, decisionMarker
        case exposureID, cohortID, exposedAtTrustedWallMs
        case correlationClasses, outcomeWindowStartMs, outcomeWindowEndMs
        case censoringPolicy, missingnessPolicy, outcomeSourceContract
    }

    public init(from decoder: Decoder) throws {
        try BASContractWireValidation.exactKeys(
            decoder, Set(CodingKeys.allCases.map(\.rawValue)))
        let c = try decoder.container(keyedBy: CodingKeys.self)
        try self.init(
            schemaVersion: c.decode(String.self, forKey: .schemaVersion),
            exposureContractID: c.decode(
                String.self, forKey: .exposureContractID),
            semanticSnapshotArtifactID: c.decode(
                BASArtifactID.self, forKey: .semanticSnapshotArtifactID),
            orderedCandidateActions: c.decode(
                [BASExperienceActionCandidate].self,
                forKey: .orderedCandidateActions),
            selectedActionID: c.decode(
                String.self, forKey: .selectedActionID),
            behaviorPolicyID: c.decode(
                String.self, forKey: .behaviorPolicyID),
            behaviorPolicyDigest: c.decode(
                String.self, forKey: .behaviorPolicyDigest),
            decisionMarker: c.decode(
                BASExperienceDecisionMarker.self, forKey: .decisionMarker),
            exposureID: c.decode(String.self, forKey: .exposureID),
            cohortID: c.decode(String.self, forKey: .cohortID),
            exposedAtTrustedWallMs: c.decode(
                Int64.self, forKey: .exposedAtTrustedWallMs),
            correlationClasses: c.decode(
                BASExperienceCorrelationClasses.self,
                forKey: .correlationClasses),
            outcomeWindowStartMs: c.decode(
                Int64.self, forKey: .outcomeWindowStartMs),
            outcomeWindowEndMs: c.decode(
                Int64.self, forKey: .outcomeWindowEndMs),
            censoringPolicy: c.decode(
                BASExperienceCensoringPolicy.self,
                forKey: .censoringPolicy),
            missingnessPolicy: c.decode(
                BASExperienceMissingnessPolicy.self,
                forKey: .missingnessPolicy),
            outcomeSourceContract: c.decode(
                BASExperienceOutcomeSourceContract.self,
                forKey: .outcomeSourceContract))
    }
}

public struct BASAutomationRunReduction: Sendable, Equatable {
    public let nextState: BASAutomationRunState
    public let nextBoundaryDispositionProof:
        BASAutomationBoundaryDispositionProof
    public let canonicalEventPayloadBytes: Data
}

public enum BASAutomationRunReducer {
    public static func validate(
        current: BASAutomationRunState,
        currentBoundaryDispositionProof:
            BASAutomationBoundaryDispositionProof,
        expectedBoundarySlotCoverageDigest: String,
        transition: BASAutomationRunTransition
    ) throws {
        try BASContractWireValidation.digest(
            expectedBoundarySlotCoverageDigest,
            field: "expectedBoundarySlotCoverageDigest")
        guard current == transition.fromState,
              !isTerminal(current),
              isValidPersistedProof(
                  for: current,
                  proof: currentBoundaryDispositionProof),
              isBoundToExpectedCoverage(
                  currentBoundaryDispositionProof,
                  expectedBoundarySlotCoverageDigest:
                      expectedBoundarySlotCoverageDigest),
              isBoundToExpectedCoverage(
                  transition.boundaryDispositionProof,
                  expectedBoundarySlotCoverageDigest:
                      expectedBoundarySlotCoverageDigest),
              isAllowedEdge(
                  transition,
                  currentBoundaryDispositionProof:
                      currentBoundaryDispositionProof)
        else {
            throw BASContractWireError.invalidState("runReducerEdge")
        }
        let predecessorRequired = transition.fromState != .observed
        guard predecessorRequired
                == (transition.predecessorEventArtifactID != nil),
              !transition.orderedGuardReceiptArtifactIDs.isEmpty
        else {
            throw BASContractWireError.invalidPresence(
                "runTransitionPredecessorOrGuard")
        }
        if transition.reason == .dependencyUnavailable
            || transition.reason == .boundaryOutcomeUncertain
            || transition.reason == .boundaryReconciled
            || transition.reason == .terminalReceiptCommitted {
            guard !transition.orderedSourceReceiptArtifactIDs.isEmpty else {
                throw BASContractWireError.emptyArtifactVector(
                    "orderedSourceReceiptArtifactIDs")
            }
        }
    }

    public static func apply(
        current: BASAutomationRunState,
        currentBoundaryDispositionProof:
            BASAutomationBoundaryDispositionProof,
        expectedBoundarySlotCoverageDigest: String,
        transition: BASAutomationRunTransition
    ) throws -> BASAutomationRunReduction {
        try validate(
            current: current,
            currentBoundaryDispositionProof:
                currentBoundaryDispositionProof,
            expectedBoundarySlotCoverageDigest:
                expectedBoundarySlotCoverageDigest,
            transition: transition)
        let event = try BASAutomationRunEvent(transition: transition)
        return BASAutomationRunReduction(
            nextState: transition.toState,
            nextBoundaryDispositionProof:
                nextPersistedProof(for: transition),
            canonicalEventPayloadBytes:
                try BASGovernedArtifactPayloadCodec.canonicalBytes(for: event))
    }

    private static func isWaiting(_ state: BASAutomationRunState) -> Bool {
        switch state {
        case .waitingForConfirmation, .waitingForNetwork,
             .waitingForModel, .waitingForTool:
            return true
        default:
            return false
        }
    }

    private static func isCancellableNonterminal(
        _ state: BASAutomationRunState
    ) -> Bool {
        if isWaiting(state) {
            return true
        }
        switch state {
        case .admitted, .allocated, .executing,
             .checkpointed, .degraded:
            return true
        default:
            return false
        }
    }

    private static func isReconciliationEligibleNonterminal(
        _ state: BASAutomationRunState
    ) -> Bool {
        if isWaiting(state) || state == .checkpointed {
            return true
        }
        switch state {
        case .executing, .cancelRequested, .degraded:
            return true
        default:
            return false
        }
    }

    private static func hasProvedPreBoundary(
        _ proof: BASAutomationBoundaryDispositionProof
    ) -> Bool {
        if case .provedPreBoundary = proof { return true }
        return false
    }

    private static func hasPossibleOrUnknownBoundary(
        _ proof: BASAutomationBoundaryDispositionProof
    ) -> Bool {
        if case .possibleOrUnknown = proof { return true }
        return false
    }

    private static func hasReconciledNoEffect(
        _ proof: BASAutomationBoundaryDispositionProof
    ) -> Bool {
        if case .reconciledNoEffect = proof { return true }
        return false
    }

    private static func hasTerminalResolution(
        _ proof: BASAutomationBoundaryDispositionProof
    ) -> Bool {
        if case .terminalResolution = proof { return true }
        return false
    }

    private static func isTerminalClosureProof(
        _ proof: BASAutomationBoundaryDispositionProof
    ) -> Bool {
        hasProvedPreBoundary(proof) || hasTerminalResolution(proof)
    }

    private static func evidence(
        of proof: BASAutomationBoundaryDispositionProof
    ) -> BASAutomationBoundaryDispositionEvidence? {
        switch proof {
        case .notRequired:
            return nil
        case .provedPreBoundary(let evidence),
             .possibleOrUnknown(let evidence),
             .reconciledNoEffect(let evidence),
             .terminalResolution(let evidence):
            return evidence
        }
    }

    private static func isGenesisProof(
        _ proof: BASAutomationBoundaryDispositionProof
    ) -> Bool {
        guard let evidence = evidence(of: proof) else { return false }
        return evidence.proofRevision == 0
            && evidence.predecessorDispositionProofDigest == nil
    }

    private static func isBoundToExpectedCoverage(
        _ proof: BASAutomationBoundaryDispositionProof,
        expectedBoundarySlotCoverageDigest: String
    ) -> Bool {
        guard let evidence = evidence(of: proof) else {
            return proof == .notRequired
        }
        return evidence.boundarySlotCoverageDigest
            == expectedBoundarySlotCoverageDigest
    }

    private static func canonicalDispositionProofDigest(
        _ proof: BASAutomationBoundaryDispositionProof
    ) -> String? {
        guard let bytes = try? BASCanonicalPayloadValidator
            .canonicalBytes(for: proof)
        else { return nil }
        return SHA256.hash(data: bytes)
            .map { String(format: "%02x", $0) }
            .joined()
    }

    private static func isDirectProofSuccessor(
        current: BASAutomationBoundaryDispositionProof,
        next: BASAutomationBoundaryDispositionProof
    ) -> Bool {
        guard let currentEvidence = evidence(of: current),
              let nextEvidence = evidence(of: next),
              currentEvidence.boundarySlotCoverageDigest
                == nextEvidence.boundarySlotCoverageDigest,
              let predecessorDigest =
                canonicalDispositionProofDigest(current),
              nextEvidence.predecessorDispositionProofDigest
                == predecessorDigest,
              nextEvidence.orderedBoundaryEvidenceArtifactIDs.count
                > currentEvidence.orderedBoundaryEvidenceArtifactIDs.count,
              Array(nextEvidence.orderedBoundaryEvidenceArtifactIDs.prefix(
                  currentEvidence.orderedBoundaryEvidenceArtifactIDs.count))
                == currentEvidence.orderedBoundaryEvidenceArtifactIDs
        else { return false }
        let (expectedRevision, overflow) =
            currentEvidence.proofRevision.addingReportingOverflow(1)
        return !overflow && nextEvidence.proofRevision == expectedRevision
    }

    private static func isExactOrDirectProofSuccessor(
        current: BASAutomationBoundaryDispositionProof,
        next: BASAutomationBoundaryDispositionProof
    ) -> Bool {
        next == current || isDirectProofSuccessor(current: current, next: next)
    }

    private static func isValidPersistedProof(
        for state: BASAutomationRunState,
        proof: BASAutomationBoundaryDispositionProof
    ) -> Bool {
        switch state {
        case .degraded:
            return hasProvedPreBoundary(proof)
                || hasPossibleOrUnknownBoundary(proof)
        case .cancelRequested:
            return hasProvedPreBoundary(proof)
        case .reconciling:
            return hasPossibleOrUnknownBoundary(proof)
        default:
            return proof == .notRequired
        }
    }

    private static func nextPersistedProof(
        for transition: BASAutomationRunTransition
    ) -> BASAutomationBoundaryDispositionProof {
        switch transition.toState {
        case .degraded, .cancelRequested, .reconciling:
            return transition.boundaryDispositionProof
        default:
            return .notRequired
        }
    }

    private static func isValidDegradationProof(
        from: BASAutomationRunState,
        currentBoundaryDispositionProof:
            BASAutomationBoundaryDispositionProof,
        proof: BASAutomationBoundaryDispositionProof
    ) -> Bool {
        if from == .observed {
            return false
        }
        if from == .admitted || from == .allocated {
            return hasProvedPreBoundary(proof) && isGenesisProof(proof)
        }
        if from == .reconciling {
            return hasPossibleOrUnknownBoundary(proof)
                && isDirectProofSuccessor(
                    current: currentBoundaryDispositionProof,
                    next: proof)
        }
        if from == .cancelRequested {
            return (hasProvedPreBoundary(proof)
                    && proof == currentBoundaryDispositionProof)
                || (hasPossibleOrUnknownBoundary(proof)
                    && isDirectProofSuccessor(
                        current: currentBoundaryDispositionProof,
                        next: proof))
        }
        if currentBoundaryDispositionProof == .notRequired {
            return (hasProvedPreBoundary(proof)
                    || hasPossibleOrUnknownBoundary(proof))
                && isGenesisProof(proof)
        }
        return false
    }

    private static func isTerminal(_ state: BASAutomationRunState) -> Bool {
        switch state {
        case .denied, .succeeded, .failed, .cancelled,
             .quarantined, .indeterminate:
            return true
        default:
            return false
        }
    }

    private static func isDirectTerminalEdge(
        from: BASAutomationRunState,
        to: BASAutomationRunState
    ) -> Bool {
        if from == .admitted || from == .allocated {
            return to == .failed || to == .quarantined
        }
        if from == .executing || isWaiting(from)
            || from == .checkpointed || from == .degraded {
            return to == .succeeded || to == .failed
                || to == .quarantined || to == .indeterminate
        }
        return false
    }

    private static func isValidDirectTerminalProof(
        from: BASAutomationRunState,
        currentBoundaryDispositionProof:
            BASAutomationBoundaryDispositionProof,
        transitionBoundaryDispositionProof:
            BASAutomationBoundaryDispositionProof
    ) -> Bool {
        if from != .degraded {
            return isTerminalClosureProof(
                transitionBoundaryDispositionProof)
                && isGenesisProof(transitionBoundaryDispositionProof)
        }
        if hasPossibleOrUnknownBoundary(
            currentBoundaryDispositionProof) {
            return hasTerminalResolution(
                transitionBoundaryDispositionProof)
                && isDirectProofSuccessor(
                    current: currentBoundaryDispositionProof,
                    next: transitionBoundaryDispositionProof)
        }
        if hasProvedPreBoundary(currentBoundaryDispositionProof),
           hasProvedPreBoundary(transitionBoundaryDispositionProof) {
            return transitionBoundaryDispositionProof
                == currentBoundaryDispositionProof
        }
        return hasProvedPreBoundary(currentBoundaryDispositionProof)
            && hasTerminalResolution(transitionBoundaryDispositionProof)
            && isDirectProofSuccessor(
                current: currentBoundaryDispositionProof,
                next: transitionBoundaryDispositionProof)
    }

    private static func isAllowedEdge(
        _ transition: BASAutomationRunTransition,
        currentBoundaryDispositionProof:
            BASAutomationBoundaryDispositionProof
    ) -> Bool {
        let from = transition.fromState
        let to = transition.toState
        let reason = transition.reason
        let boundaryDispositionProof = transition.boundaryDispositionProof
        if from == .observed,
           (to == .admitted || to == .denied) {
            return boundaryDispositionProof == .notRequired
                && reason == .admissionDecision
        }
        if from == .admitted, to == .allocated {
            return boundaryDispositionProof == .notRequired
                && reason == .allocationCommitted
        }
        if from == .allocated, to == .executing {
            return boundaryDispositionProof == .notRequired
                && reason == .executionBindingsCurrent
        }
        if from == .executing, isWaiting(to) {
            return boundaryDispositionProof == .notRequired
                && reason == .dependencyUnavailable
        }
        if isWaiting(from), to == .executing {
            return boundaryDispositionProof == .notRequired
                && reason == .resumeCurrent
        }
        if (from == .executing || isWaiting(from)), to == .checkpointed {
            return boundaryDispositionProof == .notRequired
                && reason == .checkpointCommitted
        }
        if from == .checkpointed,
           (to == .executing || isWaiting(to)) {
            return boundaryDispositionProof == .notRequired
                && reason == .resumeCurrent
        }
        if isCancellableNonterminal(from), to == .cancelRequested {
            return hasProvedPreBoundary(
                transition.boundaryDispositionProof)
                && (from == .degraded
                    ? transition.boundaryDispositionProof
                        == currentBoundaryDispositionProof
                    : isGenesisProof(
                        transition.boundaryDispositionProof))
                && reason == .cancellationRequested
        }
        if from == .cancelRequested, to == .cancelled {
            return hasProvedPreBoundary(currentBoundaryDispositionProof)
                && transition.boundaryDispositionProof
                    == currentBoundaryDispositionProof
                && reason == .cancellationSettled
        }
        if isReconciliationEligibleNonterminal(from),
           to == .reconciling {
            guard hasPossibleOrUnknownBoundary(
                transition.boundaryDispositionProof)
            else { return false }
            let proofAdvances = currentBoundaryDispositionProof == .notRequired
                ? isGenesisProof(transition.boundaryDispositionProof)
                : isExactOrDirectProofSuccessor(
                    current: currentBoundaryDispositionProof,
                    next: transition.boundaryDispositionProof)
            return proofAdvances
                && reason == .boundaryOutcomeUncertain
        }
        if from == .reconciling, to == .executing {
            return hasPossibleOrUnknownBoundary(
                currentBoundaryDispositionProof)
                && hasReconciledNoEffect(boundaryDispositionProof)
                && isDirectProofSuccessor(
                    current: currentBoundaryDispositionProof,
                    next: boundaryDispositionProof)
                && reason == .boundaryReconciled
        }
        if from == .reconciling,
           (to == .succeeded || to == .failed
            || to == .quarantined || to == .indeterminate) {
            return hasPossibleOrUnknownBoundary(
                currentBoundaryDispositionProof)
                && hasTerminalResolution(boundaryDispositionProof)
                && isDirectProofSuccessor(
                    current: currentBoundaryDispositionProof,
                    next: boundaryDispositionProof)
                && reason == .boundaryReconciled
        }
        if to == .degraded {
            return isValidDegradationProof(
                from: from,
                currentBoundaryDispositionProof:
                    currentBoundaryDispositionProof,
                proof: transition.boundaryDispositionProof)
                && reason == .boundedDegradation
        }
        if isDirectTerminalEdge(from: from, to: to) {
            return isValidDirectTerminalProof(
                from: from,
                currentBoundaryDispositionProof:
                    currentBoundaryDispositionProof,
                transitionBoundaryDispositionProof:
                    boundaryDispositionProof)
                && reason == .terminalReceiptCommitted
        }
        return false
    }
}

// The remaining W1 shapes below receive the same explicit stored-field,
// CodingKeys, validating-initializer and decoder discipline:
// BASApplicationGovernanceContainerBootstrapKey/Request,
// BASApplicationGovernanceContainerAnchorPayload/Ref/Stored,
// BASAppAgentChildScopeAllocationKey/Request/Receipt/Stored,
// BASApplicationGovernanceContainerAnchorRef,
// BASAppAgentAuthorityScopeRef/RootRef/ScopeCurrentnessEvidence,
// BASAppAgentCreationBindingRequest/Binding/GenesisPayload,
// BASAppAgentSelfManifest/Ref and its closed unions,
// BASAppAgentSessionSelectionRequest/LifetimeDisposition/Binding/
// CASReceipt/Evidence,
// BASStoredAppAgentSessionSelection,
// BASAppAgentRootLifecycleOperationKind/State,
// BASAppAgentScopeCurrentnessCASFacts, SemanticKey/OperationKey,
// BASAppAgentRootLifecycleOperation/Request/Receipt/Result,
// BASDelegationSlotClaimRequest/Receipt/Result,
// BASAutomationCheckpointInstallRequest/Receipt,
// BASAutomationCheckpointReopenRequest/Receipt,
// BASMissionTaskGraphRootAdvanceRequest/Receipt,
// BASLearningCandidateHeadAdvanceRequest/Receipt,
// BASRetentionDispositionRequest/Receipt,
// BASProjectorCursorAdvanceRequest/Receipt,
// BASProjectorCursorSnapshotRequest/Snapshot.
```

The literal declarations above are the authority for the Automation run,
recurrence, checkpoint, inspection, exposure, delegation and capsule wires;
the table below summarizes only the still-separately-declared W1 values:

| Value | Required canonical fields |
|---|---|
| W1 `ContextContinuityManifest` / nested `WorkUnitRecoveryCursor` | exact first-governed immutable continuity/recovery projection owned by `state.snapshot-contracts`; the cursor references nonterminal boundary identities and the L11/L14-produced `ContinuationPolicy` decision but copies no mutable counter or boundary state |
| `BASAutomationCheckpointInstallRequest` / `Receipt` | run/version/checkpoint Artifact/continuity-manifest Artifact/cursor digest; exact `recovery72Hours` retention-admission receipt Artifact/digest, expected head/row version, all currentness epochs and idempotency key / committed head, new row version, canonical checkpoint digest, reopened trusted retention decision and post-state root; no copied expiry clock |
| `BASAutomationCheckpointReopenRequest` / `Receipt` | run/checkpoint/continuity-manifest/generation, expected currentness, trusted reopen time, and lookup identity / exact stored install receipt, reopened payload/manifest/cursor digests, referenced-owner receipt currentness, and one of `compatible`, `contentExpired`, `incompatible`, or `corrupt` |
| `BASMissionTaskGraphRootAdvanceRequest` / `Receipt` | Workspace/WorkUnit/Attempt, prior-or-absent active graph root, next immutable mission/task graph Artifact ID/digest, expected K3 head/row version, current epochs and idempotency / exact request digest, committed active graph root, K3 head/row version, post-state root and replay disposition |
| `BASLearningCandidateHeadAdvanceRequest` / `Receipt` | completed predecessor Attempt, prior-or-absent candidate head, immutable candidate plus Policy-A/Evidence-B/deletion/taint/eligibility refs, expected K3 head/row version, current epochs and idempotency / exact request digest, committed candidate head, K3 head/row version, post-state root and replay disposition; no training, certification or cutover authority |
| `BASRetentionDispositionRequest` / `Receipt` | retention admission identity, expected head/row version, exact disposition and authorization Artifact, all epochs, idempotency / committed head, terminal or finite next window, post-state digest |
| `BASProjectorCursorAdvanceRequest` / `Receipt` | projector/lane identity, prior snapshot/cursor, next `semanticSnapshotArtifactID`, expected head/row version, epochs, idempotency / committed head, row version and canonical cursor digest |
| `BASProjectorCursorSnapshotRequest` / `Snapshot` | projector/lane plus currentness scope / current cursor, semantic snapshot Artifact, K3 head/row version and epochs |

The three declarations that earlier designs named without defining are now
closed, not implementation placeholders. `ContextWorkspaceRef` has exactly
the twelve fields frozen by controlled design §14.4: one strict lowercase
64-hex `authorityScopeDigest`; the Workspace, Window, and Session stable IDs
and their generations; the fresh Workspace incarnation; and the four
restoration/capability/policy/deletion epochs. Stable IDs are non-empty NFC
strings without controls and generations/epochs are canonical `UInt64`.
The whole value—not an embedded Artifact ID/digest pair—receives one Artifact
Mesh identity after validation. It contains no application-container object,
selection/CAS back-pointer, mutable snapshot/head, Provider state, or future
evidence identity. Its explicit public initializer, `CodingKeys`, canonical
fixture and round-trip/currentness tests freeze this exact wire; matching
numeric generations with a different incarnation or restoration epoch is
stale.
`BASDelegationBranchRef` contains only the proposal Artifact ID and cannot
embed `BASAgentRole`, proposal bytes or mutable slot state across the
RuntimeCore→BASMemory boundary. `BASAutomationRunTransition` has exactly the
listed coding keys; both receipt arrays are order-preserving, duplicate-free
and nonempty when their guard family requires them, while absent predecessor
is encoded only as JSON null. IDs/reason/idempotency are nonempty NFC without
controls, digests use their existing strict codecs, epochs and row version are
canonical unsigned values, and `fromState != toState`.
`BASAutomationBoundaryDispositionProof` uses an explicit discriminator and
strict per-tag `CodingKeys`: `notRequired` carries no fields;
`provedPreBoundary` carries a complete frozen-DAG slot-coverage digest and the
canonical terminal-or-proved-never-started owner receipts; and
`possibleOrUnknown` carries the same coverage digest plus at least one exact
possibly-crossed owner receipt. `reconciledNoEffect` and
`terminalResolution` each require nonempty authenticated resolution receipts;
the former alone permits `reconciling→executing`, while the latter permits only
the explicit terminal targets. Construction is possible only through the
throwing factories; decoding enforces the tag-specific exact key set and
vector cardinality. Each evidence-bearing tag also carries `proofRevision` and
nullable `predecessorDispositionProofDigest`. Genesis is exactly revision zero
with null predecessor. A successor is exactly checked predecessor revision +
one, has the same `boundarySlotCoverageDigest`, commits to the lowercase
SHA-256 of the predecessor's
`BASCanonicalPayloadValidator.canonicalBytes(for:)`, retains every predecessor
receipt ID, and appends at least one new authenticated owner/resolution receipt.
The coverage digest itself commits run, Attempt, frozen-DAG Artifact/digest and
the complete canonical boundary-slot domain. Missing, extra, duplicate,
foreign-Workspace, stale-epoch, older/subset/same-revision substitution or
incomplete-slot evidence rejects. W1 adds `CryptoKit` only to hash these
existing canonical proof bytes; it creates no second codec or digest authority.
W1 freezes only this value and pure reducer matrix. Every reducer call also
receives `expectedBoundarySlotCoverageDigest`; every evidence-bearing current
or proposed proof must equal it, while `.notRequired` carries no coverage.
W2 alone derives that argument from the same K3 run row, Attempt and frozen-DAG
binding after reopening and byte-equality-checking every typed owner receipt
and current epoch before its CAS. The transition request cannot supply or
override it, so a caller-provided tag, foreign coverage digest or generic
nonempty Artifact vector proves nothing.

The four automation K3 values declared under W1's existing
`state.snapshot-contracts` owner at
`BASSemanticStateLakeContracts.swift` close the persisted reducer ABI; they are
not W2 placeholders. The transition request's
nested `transition` is the sole copy of expected EventLog head, row version,
currentness epochs and idempotency key. `expectedState` must equal
`transition.fromState`, and `expectedBoundaryDispositionProof` must byte-equal
the proof reopened from the same K3 run row. The request cannot carry a caller-
computed next state, next proof or event payload. Inside the W2 transaction,
K3 reopens that row, invokes the pure reducer once, canonicalizes the returned
event bytes once, appends them, and compare-and-swaps state + persisted proof +
head + row version atomically.

`BASAutomationK3TransitionReceipt` repeats the exact previous/next state and
proof returned by that reducer, binds the request and canonical event digests,
committed event Artifact, head, row version, currentness and post-state root.
A changed request under one idempotency key is corruption; a lost reply returns
the byte-identical stored receipt. `BASAutomationK3SnapshotRequest` binds
Workspace/run/Attempt/currentness, and `BASAutomationK3Snapshot` returns that
same identity plus the current state, exact persisted proof, latest committed
event, head, row, epochs and state root. Snapshot and transition reject a
foreign Workspace/Attempt, stale epoch/head/row, a state/proof invalid pair, a
proof not equal to the K3 row, or any digest/root mismatch before reducer use.
All four are strict `1.0.0` governed values with exact `CodingKeys`, throwing
initializers/decoders, one declaration, current/future-rejection fixtures and
no fabricated backward fixture.

`BASDualSpaceContractTests.testContextWorkspaceRefHasOneDeclarationAndExactFields`,
`BASTurnOperationRefTests.testDelegationBranchRefIsTheSoleArtifactReference`,
and
`BASSemanticTurnDAGTests.testAutomationRunTransitionHasExactCanonicalWire`
compile the public signatures and source-scan the candidate tree for exactly
one declaration at the frozen path. Missing declarations, a typealias/shadow,
extra stored field, alternate coding key or second owner fail W1.

The definition lifecycle allowed edges are exactly:
`draft→candidate`; `candidate→validating|rejected|quarantined`;
`validating→shadow|rejected|quarantined`;
`shadow→awaitingApproval|rejected|quarantined`;
`awaitingApproval→approved|rejected|quarantined`;
`approved→superseded|quarantined|retiring`;
`superseded|rejected|quarantined→retiring`; `retiring→retired`.
The operational edges are exactly: `disabled→enabled`; `enabled↔paused`;
`disabled|enabled|paused→quarantined|retiring`; `quarantined→retiring`;
`retiring→retired`. No implicit self/back edge exists and `retired` is
terminal.

`BASAutomationRunReducer.validate` and
`BASAutomationRunReducer.apply` freeze the run families exactly:
`observed→admitted|denied`; `admitted→allocated`;
`allocated→executing`; `admitted|allocated|executing|waiting*|checkpointed|
degraded→cancelRequested` only with complete `provedPreBoundary` evidence;
`executing|waiting*|checkpointed|cancelRequested|degraded→reconciling` only
with complete `possibleOrUnknown` evidence;
`executing→waiting*|checkpointed|degraded|terminal`;
`waiting*→executing|checkpointed|degraded|terminal`;
`checkpointed→executing|waiting*|degraded|terminal`;
`cancelRequested→cancelled|reconciling`;
`reconciling→executing|succeeded|failed|quarantined|indeterminate`;
`admitted|allocated|executing|waiting*|checkpointed|cancelRequested|
reconciling→degraded` under the proof rules below; `observed` and a degraded
self-edge cannot enter that family. Direct terminal edges are closed to
`admitted|allocated→failed|quarantined` and
`executing|waiting*|checkpointed|degraded→succeeded|failed|quarantined|
indeterminate`, each with either complete pre-boundary proof or authenticated
terminal resolution. `denied` is reachable only from `observed`, `cancelled`
only from `cancelRequested`, and terminal states have no outgoing edge.
`BASAutomationRunReduction` persists the proof beside `degraded`,
`cancelRequested`, and `reconciling`; the next transition receives that exact
K3-reopened value as `currentBoundaryDispositionProof`. A pre-boundary degraded
run may cancel, a possible/unknown one may only reconcile, and neither can
erase the evidence by changing reason. A degraded possible/unknown proof may
remain byte-identical while entering reconciliation, or advance only through
the direct-successor relation to newer possible/unknown evidence or an
authenticated resolution; it can never be replaced by pre-boundary proof. A
degraded pre-boundary proof may advance only through that same direct-successor
relation to possible/unknown evidence when a previously unresolved boundary is
discovered. `reconciledNoEffect`/`terminalResolution` must directly succeed the
persisted unknown proof over the identical coverage domain. `observed` has only the
explicit admission/denial family and cannot enter `degraded`; degradation
begins only after an admitted Attempt has a frozen slot-coverage domain. An
impossible `admitted`/`allocated` plus possible-boundary combination is an
invariant failure and fails closed rather than pretending it is pre-boundary.
The W1 table-driven suite crosses the complete
`state × current-persisted-proof-tag × transition-proof-tag × target × reason`
matrix: all eighteen states, both cancellation targets and all five proof tags
in both proof dimensions, including state-invalid current proof and
wrong/empty/foreign-coverage transition proof, terminal-outgoing zero and
`cancelRequested`/`reconciling` non-self edges. W2 adds K3
reopen/CAS/lost-reply fixtures. Each edge consumes
`BASAutomationRunTransition`, validates the design §4.7 guard family, and
returns a new immutable run state plus canonical precommit event payload
bytes. It cannot construct K3 receipt bytes.

The controlled-document fixture must freeze exact coding keys and enum wire
bytes. Initializers validate non-empty normalized IDs, strict digests, finite
bounds, and all cross-field invariants. Zero cannot construct either positive
count wrapper. `eligibleLearning72Hours` requires a content reference plus a
precommit `BASRetentionAdmissionRequest` containing the complete typed,
head-free `BASInteractionExperienceEnvelope`. That envelope must already
contain a non-empty `retentionAdmissionID`,
`.eligibleLearning72Hours`, and the governed content Artifact reference; its
purpose and event identity are not duplicated as independent request fields.
The sole K3 transaction computes and stores canonical
`BASRetentionAdmissionReceipt` bytes after the commit head exists; the final
interaction envelope references only `retentionAdmissionID`.
`retentionAdmissionID` is independently allocated before append and is bound
to the envelope's `eventID + idempotencyKey + expectedHead`; it is never
derived from the postcommit receipt bytes, receipt digest, or committed head.
K3 canonicalizes the complete request, atomically appends that envelope and
writes the retention row, then constructs the receipt with the resulting
committed head. A lost reply with byte-identical complete request bytes
returns that receipt; same admission ID with any changed envelope/request byte
is corruption. No precommit payload embeds or predicts its own committed
head. Other retention classes cannot carry that admission identity.

The application-container anchor has one executable bootstrap producer. After
Payload 3A-0's Artifact-Mesh open protocol has reopened a committed
`applicationContainerID + storeIdentity + storeLineageID + anchor floor`, the
W1 outer composition passes its exact store object and facts into the sole HostKit K3
assembly, together with a preexisting Host-bootstrap authorization. K3
expected-absent commits the bootstrap
row and row-pinned identity-factory inputs, then the same Artifact store
historically materializes `BASApplicationGovernanceContainerAnchorPayload`
under `.publicArtifact`. This use of the root scope exposes no user content and
grants no public read: the payload is content-free, non-writer namespace
evidence, while all access remains capability-gated. Byte-identical reopen
returns `BASStoredApplicationGovernanceContainerAnchor`; another app identity,
stable store lineage, incarnation, authorization or request byte is a binding
conflict. The moving committed-anchor digest is checked as currentness during
the transaction but is never part of the stable container primary key. No
UI/model/caller can manufacture the ref, and the anchor
contains no roster, mutable member list or `currentAppAgent`.

Child-scope allocation is likewise a governed K3 operation, not construction
of a ref from caller bytes. `allocateAppAgentChildScope` accepts the typed
request only after reopening the container anchor, normalized creation Input
Event and exact preexisting L14/K4 allocation authorization. The first request
for `(applicationContainer, creationInputEventID)` commits the one inert
candidate row and its complete historical Artifact factory; the returned
`BASAppAgentChildScopeAllocationReceipt` is materialized under
`.applicationGovernanceContainer(containerAnchorArtifactID:)`, and its Artifact
ID is the child-scope anchor. A changed retry conflicts. `bindCreation` accepts
only `BASAppAgentCreationBindingRequest`, reopens that exact receipt, and
constructs the binding inside K3. First it canonicalizes the winning request
plus reopened container, child-scope-allocation receipt, subject-nonce
commitment, authority scope, and `creationGeneration == birthGeneration`, with
both derived IDs absent. It derives
`creationBindingID = SHA256("qinao.app-agent.creation-binding.v1" ||
canonicalBindingSeed)`, then
`quotaReservationRequestID = SHA256("qinao.app-agent.quota-reservation.v1" ||
creationBindingID || canonicalAuthorityScope || quotaClassID)`. Only afterward
does it encode the complete binding and its digest. Neither ID includes itself
or the later binding digest. Thus a caller-supplied `candidateAuthorityScope`, arbitrary anchor
ID or receipt-shaped bytes can never enter the winning binding. An allocated
but unbound scope is an inert orphan and never appears in selectable inventory.

`BASAppAgentRootLifecycleOperationKey` has a throwing validating initializer:
`operationID` is NFC, non-empty, content-free and at most 128 UTF-8 bytes; the
closed legal pairs are `bindCreation + creationBinding`,
`reserveQuota|releaseBeforeActivation + quotaReservation`, and
`activateRoot|advanceSelf|fenceAndDelete + activeRoot`. Every other pair is
invalid. K3 persists and reopens only by
`(operation_kind, semantic_key_digest, operation_id)` plus byte-equal canonical
request digest. The free `operationID` is never a lookup key by itself.

The stable App-Agent identity is the tuple
`application container + child authority scope + root evidence`; it is not an
Artifact payload revision counter. `BASAppAgentAuthorityScopeRef` never changes
when Self, relationship, memory, expression, policy, consent, deletion, or
authorization heads change. `BASAppAgentScopeCurrentnessEvidence` carries the
separate mutable head fact. `BASAppAgentGenesisPayload` is an immutable birth
seed only: its `derivedAppAgentID` is domain-separated from the winning subject
nonce, container, child anchor, and immutable-core/template digest; neither a
caller nor a model chooses it, and the payload never embeds or predicts its own
`genesisArtifactID` or a later receipt.

`BASAppAgentSelfManifest` is the only durable Self payload. Its predecessor
and rollback unions obey exactly `genesis + notApplicable` or
`successor + governed clean-ancestor target`; cross-root, sibling, descendant,
tainted, deleted, quarantined, wrong-scope, wrong-key-lineage, or provenance-gap
targets fail. Relationship, memory/narrative, task/Workspace, Host preference,
consent, disclosure, policy, deletion, revocation, grant, and external effect
heads never become fields whose ordinary change advances Self. The incumbent
`runtime.turn-operation` composer reopens these orthogonal heads into one
transient, read-only Attempt projection; it is not ordinary-put as combined
truth and cannot write upstream.

In W1 the existing `BASArtifactScopeBinding` gains exactly
`.applicationGovernanceContainer(containerAnchorArtifactID: BASArtifactID)`
and `.appAgentAuthority(childScopeAnchorArtifactID: BASArtifactID)`, with wire
tags `application-governance-container` and `app-agent-authority`. The first
carries only the committed parent anchor; the second only the committed child
anchor. Neither carries `appAgentID`, Workspace, mutable head, profile or
currentness. `publicArtifact` is legal only for the self-ID-free content-free
container-root payload; it cannot scope a child or private App-Agent payload.
`workspaceAuthority`, `attempt`, and `durableWarrant` cannot substitute. W1
modifies the enum codec, canonical-identity switch and fixtures before its
GREEN filter. W2 first uses the admitted cases for production materialization.
If any proof is absent, production create/select/update/delete is typed
disabled. The gate mapping is closed and non-interchangeable. Every
`w1.state.*`, `w1.semantics.*`, `w1.artifact.*` and `w1.fixture.*` value below
is an authority-candidate/gate-row ID only—never a `waveSliceID` or
`operationID`. Every W1 category/fixture row carries
`authorizedWaveSliceID == "w1.artifact-mesh-contract-freeze"` and
`authorizedSequenceOrdinal == 1`; every W2 row analogously carries the sole

The Session request is precommit and contains no caller-selected Main ID or
selection generation. K3 chooses the one winner keyed by
`(applicationContainer, sessionCreationInputEventID)`, historically
materializes the exact postcommit evidence through the governed codec after
the SQL commit, and
returns `BASStoredAppAgentSessionSelection`. The logical Main is derived only
from `SHA256("qinao.session-main.v1" || canonicalWinningEvidenceDigest ||
canonicalContextWorkspaceRef || canonicalSelectedRootRef)`. A different App
Agent requires a fresh Session creation Input Event, session incarnation, and
Workspace ref. Every downstream value carries the evidence Artifact ID,
reopens it, recomputes the Main ID, and checks the selected root/currentness;
no ambient UI choice, String, display name, persona, Provider, or model can
substitute.

This convergence resolves the 2026-07-22 design-candidate label
`CASReceiptRef` exactly once as the content-free nested
`BASAppAgentSessionSelectionCASReceipt` inside the evidence. Its
`committedHead` is the design's EventLog/K3-current-head fact. It is not an
Artifact, top-level governed payload, registry object, or independently
writable row; there is no separate CAS-receipt Artifact ID, evidence
back-pointer, or self-ID cycle. Request, binding, and evidence all freeze the exact closed
`nonExpiringWithinSessionIncarnation` disposition. It introduces no wall-clock
expiry and remains valid only for that immutable Session incarnation; Session
termination or selected-root revocation, deletion, quarantine, or currentness
failure fences use immediately. A future expiring mode requires a new governed
schema version rather than an optional clock field.

Exactly seven App-Agent top-level Artifact payloads are independently put:
`BASApplicationGovernanceContainerAnchorPayload`,
`BASAppAgentChildScopeAllocationReceipt`, `BASAppAgentGenesisPayload`,
`BASAppAgentSelfManifest`, `BASAppAgentSessionSelectionEvidence`,
`BASAppAgentRootLifecycleReceipt`, and `BASDelegationSlotClaimReceipt`.
Each conforms to `BASSchemaVersioned`, has an explicit validating initializer,
and is encoded only through `BASGovernedArtifactPayloadCodec`. The incumbent
`BASEBrainSchemaGovernanceRegistry` contains exactly one object ID for each of
those seven top-level payloads, with current and future-rejection fixtures.
They are new `1.0.0`-only wires and have no fictional backward fixture.
Bindings, keys, refs, closed inline enums, the nested Session CAS receipt,
currentness CAS facts, and transient stored-result wrappers are validated by
their containing wire; none is an independently put object or registry row.

All seven owner factories fix
`canonicalizationVersion == "bas-governed-artifact-payload-v1"`, `schemaID ==`
the exact Swift type basename, the payload's exact schema version, canonical
bytes from `BASGovernedArtifactPayloadCodec`, byte-exact `payloadLength`, empty
`provenanceArtifactIDs`, nil `snapshotRootArtifactID`, and
`headUpdate == nil`. No production API accepts a caller-built
`BASArtifactIdentityCore`. Ordered parent vectors preserve every semantic slot
in the order below—never sort, deduplicate, or accept a caller vector. Define
the exact helper expansions:

- `R(rootEvidence)` is `[genesisArtifactID]` for `originalGenesis`, or
  `[currentRootArtifactID] + continuityBindingArtifactIDs in wire order +
  [externalMonotonicAnchorReceiptArtifactID]` for `continuedRoot`;
- `C(currentness)` is `[absentProof.artifactID]`, or

- `P(predecessor)` is `[genesis.absentProofArtifactID]`, or
  `[successor.parentSelfArtifactID,
  successor.expectedActiveSelfHeadArtifactID]`;
- `RB(rollback)` is `[]` for `notApplicable`, or `[target.artifactID]`.

`BASAppAgentRootLifecycleReceipt.committedCurrentnessFacts` is deliberately
self-ID-free. It may contain only the prior evidence digest and committed
state/generation/root digest; it cannot name or predict the outer lifecycle
receipt. A later read projection may pair the already materialized receipt ID
with those facts. K3 derives the delegation scope's exact Attempt Artifact by
reopening the TurnOperation/branch authority chain; if it cannot derive one
unique Attempt, production claim remains disabled rather than accepting an
ambient ID. No bare `Codable`, self-referential Artifact ID, mutable identity
super-record, or second identity registry is legal.

`BASInteractionNormalizationProfile` is frozen in

`BASInteractionSignalNormalizer` consumes this value; it owns no threshold,
policy, consent, or retention decisions.

The initial profile is exact: submit/save/approve/reject/undo/redo,
permission, effect, automation, deletion, correction, and terminal boundaries
each emit their own semantic event; edit transactions flush at save/submit,
undo/redo, focus loss, two seconds idle, 64 raw changes, or 16 KiB normalized
delta metadata; noncritical diagnostics cap at 32 per actor/surface/second and
overflow produces one bounded aggregate/drop receipt; authorization, effect,
deletion, correction, and terminal events are never dropped; structured
EventLog metadata caps at 4 KiB and larger authorized content becomes an
Artifact reference. Raw pointer/touch/key/render observations remain
process-local `ephemeral` data.

### W1 resilience first-wire supplement — durable inquiry, recovery truth, and attention reconstruction

The six-case retention wire and both strict horizon tags above are completed in
this same W1 candidate. `recovery72Hours`, `eligibleLearning72Hours`, and
finite `auditProof` require a finite trusted minimum and a strictly later
maximum; `userDurable` requires `.untilExplicitDeletion`; `neverPersist` and
uncommitted `ephemeral` bytes receive no Artifact admission. There is one
governed `BASRetentionAdmissionReceipt` type and three distinct receipt
instances for local continuation bodies, with exact purposes
`qinao.continuation.accepted-token-prefix`,
`qinao.continuation.accepted-output-prefix`, and
`qinao.continuation.cache-image`. Each receipt binds its own admission ID,
request/envelope digest, retention class, content Artifact ID/digest,
committed head/row/revision, horizon, purpose, privacy/consent/policy/deletion/
revocation epochs and erasure domain. The sole schema registry adds the type
once with `schema.BASRetentionAdmissionReceipt.current` and
`schema.BASRetentionAdmissionReceipt.future_rejection`; no fictional backward
fixture or role-specific receipt type is created. W2 adds that one object ID to
the existing row-pinned historical-put allowlist.

The same W1 `state.snapshot-contracts` candidate declares the durable inquiry
values in `BASSemanticStateLakeContracts.swift`; they are not an inquiry Store,
Agent, manager or mutable main-line branch:

```swift

The same W1 candidate declares these strict, self-ID-free operation values;

```text
BASInquiryBranchCreateRequest = {branchRefArtifactID,branchRefDigest,branchRetentionAdmissionID,branchRetentionAdmissionReceiptArtifactID,branchRetentionAdmissionReceiptDigest,expectedK3Head,expectedAbsentTranscriptHead,policyEpoch,consentEpoch,deletionEpoch,revocationEpoch,idempotencyKey}

```

Each branch body and each later message body has a different `userDurable`
admission/receipt. The branch receipt never pre-authorizes a future message.
Create and append require exact head, predecessor, branch, Workspace/App-Agent,
read-set and epoch equality. A changed retry is corruption; a lost reply
reopens the byte-identical receipt; only the matching branch transcript head
may advance. The branch contains no tool, effect, publication, state, memory,
learning, Automation or Sub-Agent-spawn grant.

The W1 candidate also places all independently-put pure checkpoint wires in
`BASRuntimeCore/ProviderExecutionCore.swift`, where the incumbent registry can
see them without importing a model adapter. Logical ownership remains split:
identity facts belong to `cache.scope`, continuation refs to
`execution.plan-provider-router`, and Provider verification receipts to
`provider.package-boundary`. MLX owns only physical codec behavior.

These three independently-put checkpoint values join the governed registry
once each; sampler, encoding and exactness are contained. The three continuation body admissions
have pairwise-distinct admission/content/purpose/receipt identities. The only
legal chain is three inert body puts → three independent K3 admissions → three
postcommit receipt puts/reopens → Identity put → Ref put. No body names a later
Identity/Ref/receipt parent, and no metadata receipt recursively requires a
body-retention receipt; accepted tokens and the accepted output prefix are the
only continuation truth. FP16 KV is optional acceleration and maps to
`.exactNative`;
Q4/lossy KV, MTP drafts, hidden reasoning, and unaccepted tokens are never
recovery truth.
The stochastic sampler value carries only configuration and RNG-state digests;
stochastic RNG physical state is part of the cache body. The corresponding
RNG/grammar/logit-processor bytes are sealed inside the one
cache-image body and are covered by that body's distinct retention receipt.
It cannot create a fourth independently retained checkpoint body.
The sole `BASEBrainSchemaGovernanceRegistry` registers the three checkpoint
payloads exactly once with fixtures
`schema.BASCacheCheckpointIdentity.current`,
`schema.BASCacheCheckpointIdentity.future_rejection`,
`schema.BASContinuationCheckpointRef.current`,
`schema.BASContinuationCheckpointRef.future_rejection`,
`schema.BASProviderCheckpointReceipt.current`, and
`schema.BASProviderCheckpointReceipt.future_rejection`. These are first
`1.0.0` wires, so none receives a fictional backward fixture.

**Approved-history K3 closure in this Wave:** extend only the class-bound
`BASK3ControlNucleusStorage` implementation on the same
`BASSQLiteEventLogStorage.swift` actor. `advanceMissionTaskGraphRoot` performs
expected-root CAS for the immutable mission/task graph. Every executable
Provider/tool/state/effect/publication/release allocation reopens that current
root and its exact predecessor receipts first; a missing, stale, foreign or
unplanned root is non-executable. `createInquiryBranch`,
`appendInquiryMessage`, and `reopenInquiryBranch` create/reopen the immutable
branch ref and advance only the matching branch's transcript head. For every
append, the body ordinary put is inert; admission precedes envelope put. The
envelope's `bodyRetentionAdmissionReceiptArtifactID` and digest must reopen the
exact encrypted body with `.userDurable`. The append transaction reopens the
current admission row and receipt, body and envelope, then CAS-advances only
the matching branch's transcript head. no transcript head can commit without
that complete current evidence. A crash before append leaves only an
unpublished, collectable orphan; it never exposes an unadmitted message.
Their content-free K3 rows cannot create a main-line
state/effect/publication transition. `installAutomationCheckpoint`
and its reopen companion store/recover the W1 checkpoint ABI and its exact
postcommit `BASBudgetUseEvidence`. Three inert continuation bodies are admitted
and their postcommit historical receipt Artifacts are reopened before Identity
and Ref are put. The checkpoint install is a later K3 transaction: it reopens
all three retention admission rows and their postcommit receipt Artifacts,
reopens `BASCacheCheckpointIdentity` and `BASContinuationCheckpointRef`, the
three bodies, continuity manifest and current budget evidence, and only then
publishes the checkpoint head. A crash at
any earlier cut leaves only an invisible, collectable orphan; no SQL transaction
is claimed to span Artifact Mesh. The already-approved
`claimBudgetUse(BASBudgetUseRequest) -> BASBudgetUseClaimOutcome` seam atomically
advances the stable dispute episode's lane, round, progress witness, budget
receipt and visited-state root without reset; no dispute-specific K3 method or
value family is permitted. `advanceProjectorCursor` commits the
throwing sequence-read HWM plus immutable projection root in one cursor CAS.
`advanceLearningCandidateHead` orders post-Attempt candidate, Policy-A,
Evidence-B, deletion/taint epoch and eligibility refs without training or
cutover authority. The existing `BASAutomationK3LifecycleTests`,
`BASAutomationCheckpointStorageTests`, `BASBudgetLeaseControlTests`,
`BASEventLogSemanticSnapshotTests`, and crash/race suites cover lost replies,
two writers, stale heads, cross-Workspace/Attempt substitution, zero-use/used
transitions and synchronous invalidation fanout. None adds a K3 port, database,
cursor store, learning queue or recovery writer.

The remaining custody values are frozen as follows:

| Value | Required canonical fields/invariant |
|---|---|
| `BASErasureDomainKeyCreateRequest` | erasure domain, custody profile, Artifact scope/classification, purpose, policy/consent/deletion/revocation epochs, idempotency key, creation expiry |
| `BASErasureDomainKeyUseAuthorization` | existing `BASCapabilityGrant`, `BASCapabilityUseReceipt`, generic attestation, and caller-authentication receipt Artifact IDs; exact Artifact identity/scope, operation/resource, erasure domain, purpose/audience/destination, semantic snapshot, field/row/byte/token/time limits, required key generation, all currentness epochs, monotonic/wall expiry |
| `BASErasureDomainKeyHandle` | opaque in-memory custody token plus exact key-reference identity/generation; non-`Codable`, non-`Hashable`, non-loggable, non-exportable, no public raw-key accessor |
| `BASErasureDomainKeyRevocationAuthorization` | key reference/domain/generation, deletion or revocation authority Artifact, expected epochs, reason, idempotency key |
| `BASErasureDomainKeyRevocationReceipt` | key reference/domain/generation, terminal revoked/already-revoked/indeterminate status, custody evidence digest, committed deletion/revocation epoch, no key bytes |

`BASErasureDomainKeyHandle` is non-`Codable`, non-loggable, non-exportable, and
has no public raw-key accessor. The production custody mechanism is
exactly `BASKeychainErasureDomainKeyCustody`; the production AEAD mechanism is
exactly `BASCryptoKitArtifactContentAEAD`. `BASArtifactSQLiteStore` receives
the one custody actor and AEAD implementation through the frozen ports; a
composition test proves the custody object identity with `===` across create,
open, and revoke. Keychain/CryptoKit are mechanisms, while
`state.memory-content-erasure` alone owns classification, key lifecycle,
revocation, deletion outcome, and policy. Signing, ledger commitment, Provider,
and Artifact-content keys are separate profiles and may never be reused.

`BASArtifactSQLiteStore` is the sole canonical AAD factory. AAD bytes are the
RFC-8949 deterministic-CBOR encoding of the complete Artifact identity
preimage, sealed-content profile/cipher, key-reference identity/generation,
and governing epochs. Callers cannot provide arbitrary AAD. Seal/open recompute
the same bytes; a missing, reordered, widened, or stale field fails before
plaintext release.

The Artifact identity preimage is frozen as canonical bytes over
`schemaVersion + scope + contentClassification + erasureDomainID +
plaintextDigest + purpose + governing epochs`; therefore identical plaintext
in different erasure domains cannot share a row, body, or key fate.

`readAuthorized` extends the same class-bound `BASArtifactStorePort`; it is not
a second store, read authority, or K4 RPC. `BASArtifactSQLiteStore` reopens and
validates the incumbent grant/use-receipt/attestation graph, caller
authentication, subject, scope, operation/resource, purpose, audience,
destination, snapshot, limits, expiry, revocation, and epochs before it asks
the same custody actor for a handle and invokes the same AEAD mechanism. The
authorization value is a transient adapter over those already authoritative
receipts and cannot mint or widen them. Bare `read(_:)` may expose governed
metadata and sealed bytes but rejects plaintext access for encrypted content.
Lost-reply recovery uses only the incumbent
`lookupCapabilityUseReceipt`; there is no domain-specific capability or
Artifact-open authority.

The protocol requirement has one fail-closed default implementation returning
the typed `authorizedOpenUnavailable` error so existing read-only/test
conformers remain source-compatible without gaining plaintext access.
`BASArtifactSQLiteStore` is the only production override; composition and
dispatch tests prove the authorized reader reaches that override and never
the default or bare `read(_:)`.

`BASAutomationK3Snapshot` are declared in

retention-disposition, and projector-cursor request/receipt values frozen in
W1. The W2 E candidate creates exactly one composite port and no parallel K3

```swift
public protocol BASK3ControlNucleusStorage:

The same `BASK3ControlNucleusStorage` and sole
`BASSQLiteEventLogStorage` actor own all three rebase methods. The W2-created
`BASStateCommitContracts.swift` declares their exact self-ID-free values:

```swift
public enum BASRebaseInheritedBudgetProof:
    Codable, Sendable, Equatable {
    case zeroUse(
        predecessorLeaseRevision: UInt64,
        zeroUseSourceK3Root: String,
        zeroUseSourceWatermark: Int64,
        checkedRemainder: BASRebaseCeilingVector)
    case used(
        latestBudgetUseReceiptArtifactID: BASArtifactID,
        checkedRemainder: BASRebaseCeilingVector)
}
```

`BASRebaseInheritedBudgetProof` is an embedded receipt value, never a separate
Artifact or budget authority. Its explicit `zeroUse|used` discriminator,
per-tag exact `CodingKeys`, throwing factories and custom decoder reject
unknown, missing, duplicate, wrong-tag, negative-watermark, malformed-root and
zero Artifact-ID fields. `checkedRemainder` reuses the W1
`BASRebaseCeilingVector`; no third budget-vector type is introduced. K3 derives
that vector with checked subtraction from the reopened predecessor lease and
private cumulative-use row. `zeroUse` requires a nonnegative EventLog-domain
watermark and the exact root/revision of the private zero-use proof;
`used` equality-reopens the referenced latest `BASBudgetUseReceipt`. Both tags
must equal the request's reduced ceiling or be strictly wider than it, and
neither lets the caller supply a mutable remaining counter.

```text
BASK3AttemptRebasePendingReceipt = {schemaVersion,rebaseRequestID,rebaseRequestDigest,pendingRowRoot,pendingSourceWatermark,expectedOldActiveHeadArtifactID,predecessorAttemptArtifactID,predecessorGeneration,successorAttemptArtifactID,successorGeneration,bootSessionID,monotonicDeadlineNanos,policyEpoch,deletionEpoch,revocationEpoch}
BASK3AttemptRebaseCommitRequest = {schemaVersion,rebaseRequest,pendingReceiptArtifactID,grantReservationReceiptArtifactID,currentContextContinuityManifestArtifactID,currentL10CoverageReceiptArtifactID,currentSourceSnapshotArtifactID,currentSourceEventHighWatermark,currentSourceEventHead,currentBoundaryTerminalRefs,currentBoundarySlotCoverageDigest,currentBoundaryTerminalSetDigest,currentBudgetUseEvidence,currentVisitedStateCommitmentArtifactID,expectedOldActiveHeadArtifactID,currentPolicyEpoch,currentDeletionEpoch,currentRevocationEpoch}
BASRebaseInheritedBudgetProof = zeroUse(predecessorLeaseRevision,zeroUseSourceK3Root,zeroUseSourceWatermark,checkedRemainder) | used(latestBudgetUseReceiptArtifactID,checkedRemainder)
BASAttemptRebaseReceipt = {schemaVersion,rebaseRequestID,rebaseRequestDigest,pendingReceiptArtifactID,grantReservationReceiptArtifactID,successorAuthorizationGrantArtifactID,oldActiveHeadArtifactID,newActiveHeadArtifactID,predecessorAttemptArtifactID,predecessorGeneration,successorAttemptArtifactID,successorGeneration,inheritedBudgetProof,inheritedVisitedStateCommitmentArtifactID,bootSessionID,monotonicDeadlineNanos,committedK3Root,committedK3Watermark,policyEpoch,deletionEpoch,revocationEpoch}
BASK3AttemptRebaseReopenRequest = {schemaVersion,rebaseRequestID,rebaseRequestDigest,expectedOldActiveHeadArtifactID,predecessorAttemptArtifactID,successorAttemptArtifactID,bootSessionID,currentEpochs}
BASK3AttemptRebaseRecoverySnapshot = pending(BASK3AttemptRebasePendingReceipt) | committed(BASAttemptRebaseReceipt) | superseded(winningRebaseReceiptArtifactID) | corrupt(reason)
```

Every rebase field named `pendingSourceWatermark`,
`currentSourceEventHighWatermark`, `zeroUseSourceWatermark`,
`committedK3Watermark`, `k4CoveringWatermark`, or `winningK3Watermark` is a
nonnegative `Int64` in the incumbent EventLog sequence domain. None is a
`UInt64`, a wall/monotonic time, or a second watermark authority.

`beginAttemptRebase` commits only the private, non-runnable pending row.
`commitAttemptRebase` verifies the byte-identical W1 request, pending receipt,
signed reserved-inactive K4 receipt Artifact, every current continuity/boundary/
budget/visited-state fact, checked attenuation, same boot and non-extended
deadline inside the one active-head transaction. `reopenAttemptRebase` is
read-only and may return only the same operation's typed state. The
`BASAttemptRebaseRecoveryTests.swift` matrix faults before/after pending,
reservation-reference verification, active-head CAS, receipt publication and
reply; it races two writers and proves one head, inherited use/visited state,
byte-identical replay, and no usable grant or semantic work from pending data.
The `zeroUse` variant is itself part of the K3-authored rebase receipt: it binds
the exact predecessor lease revision, source K3 root/watermark and checked
remainder, and is legal only when that same transaction proves every private
cumulative-use and visited-update counter is zero. It does not reference or
create a separate caller-supplied proof Artifact ID. The `used` variant must equality-reopen the
private row's latest `BASBudgetUseReceipt` and checked remainder.

chooses the first canonical `(slotOrdinal, slotID)`, binds proposal digest to

The same incumbent K3 actor also conforms to the already controlled

Creation binding/subject nonce/scope/quota reservation is established before
any seed is active. Genesis and first Self ordinary puts are inert orphans;
only the existing L13 candidate → K3 invisible stage → L14/K4 decision/seal

existing erasure closure purge body/key/index/cache/KV descendants. At-cap,

Every transition request binds the canonical precommit transition/event

If Task 0 selects a predecessor whose K3 schema is already above v2, execution

### Payload 4A — Write RED tests for Artifact content authority

  Prove:

  - `eligibleLearning72Hours`/`userDurable` content uses a non-nil erasure-domain key reference;
  - authorized open requires the same scope, purpose, current epochs, and
    unrevoked key generation;
  - encrypted plaintext cannot be obtained through bare `read(_:)`;
    `readAuthorized` rejects a wrong grant/use receipt, caller, operation,
    audience/destination, snapshot, limit, expiry, or attestation;
  - EventLog receives only blinded Artifact identity and classification;
  - identical plaintext in different erasure domains cannot silently share a deletable body/key fate;
  - secret detection before write yields zero durable bytes;
  - post-write secret detection fences reads before asynchronous cleanup;
  - key revocation plus body/WAL/index cleanup has an honest closure receipt;
  - legacy plaintext rows migrate to SQL `025` ciphertext or remain
    `indeterminateBlocked` and unreadable;
  - signing/commitment keys cannot satisfy the content-key profile;
  - `.completed` from the existing value-only forget cascade is insufficient without physical-owner evidence.

### Payload 4B — Write RED tests for K3 invariants and races

  Cover:

  - active version selects at most one approved immutable version;
  - one Session CAS-selects exactly one typed App-Agent identity and frozen
    logical Main, and byte-identical lost reply returns the same receipt;
  - a mid-Session identity/Main change, stale generation/epoch, bare string,
    ambient UI selection, revoked identity, or mismatched downstream receipt
    fails before context compilation, join, state, effect, or publication;
  - a delegation proposal can claim only the first complete matching free slot
    in canonical ordinal/ID order under one allocation-head CAS;
  - identical slot-claim replay reopens one governed receipt, changed bytes are
    corruption, a CAS loser reopens/recomputes, and caller-selected/dynamic/
    duplicate/depth-two/Sub-delegated slots fail;
  - invalidating a selected version atomically replaces or clears it and disables/quarantines operation;
  - no observer can see `enabled` pointing at a non-approved version;
  - invalidation advances one epoch and covers every nonterminal Attempt;
  - a stale allocated/executing/waiting/checkpointed Attempt fails before materialization, Provider claim, publication, effect, and commit;
  - ordinary safe supersede may continue only when its pre-bound continuation policy and all epochs remain current;
  - quarantine, deletion, and revocation never use that exception;
  - logical-fire duplicate bytes return the prior disposition;
  - same event/idempotency identity with different bytes is corruption;
  - crash before commit has no visible partial row; crash after commit reopens the exact receipt;
  - checksum/schema/page/open corruption fences the K3 profile query-only,
    emits a minimized operator incident through its mapped domain owner, and
    never creates/falls back to a shared recovery registry/store;
  - authenticated restore/rebuild either reproduces the exact last admitted
    head/root or remains `indeterminateBlocked`;
  - two concurrent writers cannot both win.
  - each RSI continuation wins exactly one durable K3 budget-use receipt and
    inserts one new canonical state/decision digest with one phase-valid
    progress witness;
  - a lost budget-use reply reopens byte-identical evidence with no second
    spend; changed bytes, repeated/A↔B digest, false/missing witness, stale
    epoch, illegal remand, no progress, or exhausted budget returns the exact
    proposal-only terminal pair;
  - only `.converged + .convergedVerified` with current committed K3 evidence
    can leave the control loop toward state/publication/effect;
  - every production K3 facet shares one object identity;
  - checkpoint install/reopen uses expected-head, expected-row-version, and
    invalidation/currentness CAS;
  - an admitted `eligibleLearning72Hours` row cannot be pruned at 259,199,999 ms and becomes
    disposition-eligible only at the exact 259,200,000 ms boundary;
  - wall-clock rollback, reboot ambiguity, caller-supplied early cutoff, and
    terminal completion cannot shorten either finite 72-hour minimum;
  - caller `requestedAtTrustedWallMs` cannot choose `trustedStart`; the latter
    is the sole K3 transaction's verified commit-time reading;
  - deletion request, consent withdrawal, post-write secret detection, and
    privacy/security reclassification synchronously fence reads and revoke the
    content key/body before the 72-hour minimum while retaining only a
    content-free tombstone/audit disposition;
  - checkpoint commit lost reply reopens byte-identical install and retention
    evidence; the 259,199,999-ms boundary and terminal-before-minimum cases
    remain unreadable to pruning, while a later finite maximum returns
    `contentExpired` and requires fresh materialization rather than blind
    continuation.

  Pin at least these exact cases in the incumbent suites:

  BASEventLogSemanticSnapshotTests.testEligibleLearning72HoursBoundaryAndClockRollbackFailClosed
