### Payload 4C — Extend Artifact Mesh under one content authority

  Add erasure-domain, encryption-key reference, content classification, purpose,
  and governing epoch metadata to the existing Artifact storage envelope.
  Preserve SQL `024` byte-for-byte and add the forward-only SQL `025`
  migration. Preserve content-address validation and head CAS.

  The implementation must use the admitted cryptographic/key-custody owner. Do not place raw keys in SQLite, EventLog, logs, fixtures, App Groups, or model contexts.

  SQL `025` creates the v2 encrypted-body/key-reference schema, migrates every
  legacy v1 plaintext row transactionally, and records a typed fence for rows
  that cannot be classified, encrypted, or verified. No read path falls back
  to the v1 plaintext column after migration. Tests cover fresh database,
  legacy migration, interrupted migration/reopen, authorized decrypt, wrong
  domain/purpose/epoch, tampered AEAD bytes, and revoked key.

### Payload 4D — Migrate atom content to Artifact references

  Introduce a one-way migration:

  1. read legacy atom content;
  2. classify and reject/quarantine secrets or unknown sensitivity;
  3. write encrypted Artifact content;
  4. verify reopened digest and scope;
  5. commit the K3 reference/tombstone atomically;
  6. destroy or make legacy content provably unreachable;
  7. rebuild indexes from authorized references.

  Migration failure leaves the legacy item fenced and typed `indeterminateBlocked`; it never silently falls back to dual authority.

### Payload 4E — Implement K3 schema v3 and transitions

  Put schema creation/migration and all automation rows in `BASSQLiteEventLogStorage.swift`. Use one `BEGIN IMMEDIATE` transaction for row CAS, EventLog append, cursor update, invalidation dispositions, and post-state receipt material.

  Alternate EventLog implementations may remain test/read adapters but cannot advertise production automation-write authority.

  Implement `bootstrapApplicationGovernanceContainer`,
  `reopenApplicationGovernanceContainer`, `allocateAppAgentChildScope`, and
  `reopenAppAgentChildScopeAllocation` first, using the exact typed keys,
  Task-0 lineage proof, expected-absent rows, W1 identity factories, and
  historical-put seam above. No later App-Agent operation may accept a raw
  container/scope ref that these methods cannot reopen byte-exactly.

  Implement the closed `transactAppAgentRoot` operations and reopen path in the
  same actor/schema. Fresh creation first commits the container-wide
  creation-binding winner and finite quota reservation. Only then may the
  `.appAgentAuthority`-scoped genesis and first Self payloads be ordinary-put
  as inert candidates and traverse the existing L13/K3/L14/K4 seal path. Root
  activation and quota consumption share one `BEGIN IMMEDIATE`/`FULL`
  transaction; Self revision CASes only the active Self head; deletion first
  installs root/Session/share fences and releases consumed quota atomically,
  then invokes the existing erasure closure. These K3 rows are facets of the
  incumbent state owner, not an identity table/database, Agent registry,
  preference store, or mutation port. Main, Sub, Provider, persona, and UI
  inputs may propose inert candidates only.

  Implement `selectAppAgentForSession` and
  `reopenAppAgentSessionSelection` in this same actor/schema. The selection row
  is insert-once by `(applicationContainer, sessionCreationInputEventID)`,
  binds the precreated Workspace ref, fresh session incarnation, selected
  stable root plus exact selection-time currentness/eligibility/deletion facts,
  and accepts no Main ID. Before CAS, K3 reopens the `.appAgentAuthority` scope,
  genesis/root evidence and current active root; after commit, it historically
  materializes governed selection evidence through the same store object's
  package-only historical facet and
  derives Main ID only from the winning evidence digest + Workspace ref + root.
  It rejects stale, superseded, revoked, deleted, quarantined, wrong-scope or
  bare-locator selection.

  Implement `claimDelegationSlot` and `reopenDelegationSlotClaim` in the same
  K3 database/transaction domain. The single
  `qinao_delegation_slot_allocation` table stores only frozen identities,
  canonical allocation head, selected slot, canonical request/receipt bytes,
  full identity factory and row-pinned key epoch. It cannot schedule work or
  interpret model content. Register the receipt and historically materialize
  it through the same governance codec/store before W3 can consume it.

  Implement checkpoint install/reopen on the same transaction seam before W6
  runtime behavior exists. The checkpoint payload is an Artifact reference;
  K3 stores only content-free identities, expected head/row version,
  generation, invalidation/currentness epochs and canonical install receipt
  bytes. The three body puts and their three retention admissions precede
  Identity/Ref materialization. The checkpoint install is a later K3
  transaction that reopens all three retention admission rows and their
  postcommit receipt Artifacts, all bodies, `BASCacheCheckpointIdentity`,
  `BASContinuationCheckpointRef`, the continuity manifest and budget evidence;
  only then publishes the checkpoint head under one install idempotency key.
  K3 neither copies a second retention clock nor interprets recovery policy or
  mutable child-boundary state. Earlier crashes leave invisible, collectable
  orphans. A lost install reply returns the prior byte-identical receipt for
  the same complete request; any changed byte under that identity is corruption.

### Payload 4E.1 — Normalize and fence EventLog payloads before eligible-learning capture

  Implement the W1-frozen `BASInteractionNormalizationProfile` in the L6
  adapter before any `eligibleLearning72Hours` producer is enabled. `scripts/check_eventlog_typed_payloads.py`
  lexically enumerates every production `BASEventLogEntry` constructor and
  append caller from the candidate tree; its committed manifest must equal the
  derived set in both directions.

  Migrate each producer to a registered bounded payload kind whose canonical
  bytes contain only structured facts, digests, refs, epochs, and causal slots.
  At the storage append boundary, reject any new free-form `payloadJson`
  generation even if a producer bypasses the normalizer. Historical rows are
  decoded through a versioned typed migrator or fenced query-only with an
  explicit corruption/incompatibility result. W3 may project the normalized
  evidence but must not be the first place that enforces content freedom.

### Payload 4F — Implement both minimum-72-hour clocks and disposition

  Both `recovery72Hours` and `eligibleLearning72Hours` finite admissions
  compute independently from their own exact committed K3 receipt:

  ```text
  minimumRetainUntilMs = trustedStart + 72 * 60 * 60 * 1000
  maximumRetainUntilMs > minimumRetainUntilMs
  ```

  `trustedStart` is the trusted wall-clock reading captured by the sole K3
  transaction at the instant that exact retention-admission row commits. It is not
  `requestedAtTrustedWallMs`, event time, model time, UI time, checkpoint time,
  or a caller value. The request timestamp is audit input only; a future,
  backdated, missing, rollback-ambiguous, or reboot-ambiguous value cannot
  move either retention bound.

  Persist the record-level minimum in the sole K3/EventLog transaction. Every
  `pruneEventsBefore` path and its SQL predicate must join/recheck that bound;
  a caller-supplied cutoff, aggregate `maxAgeSec`, checkpoint state, or
  maintenance policy cannot bypass it. Clock rollback/reboot ambiguity chooses
  the conservative later bound and fails closed when ordering cannot be
  proven. At minimum expiry, one governed disposition wins: purge, promote to
  explicit `userDurable`, finite authorized extension, or finite quarantine;
  an `eligibleLearning72Hours` row may additionally enter a governed dataset
  only through its independent learning gates. Time passage alone chooses none
  of them.

  The W1 `BASRetentionDispositionRequest/Receipt` wire is a monotonic successor
  chain over the original admission row; both predecessor fields are nil only
  at revision zero; every later request names the immediately preceding
  disposition receipt and its digest. K3 requires
  `newDecisionRevision == priorDecisionRevision + 1`, exact head/row/admission/
  content/purpose/erasure-domain and privacy/consent/policy/deletion/revocation
  epoch equality, then historically materializes the content-free receipt.
  purge and privacyFence are terminal, and no later disposition can
  resurrect a fenced body, key, capability or eligibility. Finite extension
  and quarantine preserve the immutable admitted minimum and may only narrow
  rights; promotion to `userDurable` changes the horizon, never content identity.

  Each 72-hour minimum protects its admitted body from routine early pruning;
  recovery eligibility never becomes learning eligibility. Neither minimum
  overrides explicit/legal deletion, consent withdrawal, secret detection, or
  privacy/security reclassification. Any of those events synchronously
  advances the deletion/invalidation epoch, fences all
  reads and downstream use, revokes/destroys the erasure-domain key or makes
  the encrypted body unreachable, and starts the existing deletion closure
  immediately. K3 retains only bounded content-free tombstone/disposition and
  causal audit facts for its governed audit lifetime. Transforming the row to
  that tombstone is not an early-prune loophole, and keeping ciphertext or a
  usable key until `minimumRetainUntilMs` is a privacy failure.

  A checkpoint references the one `recovery72Hours` admission receipt; it does
  not own `recoveryExpiresAtTrustedWallMs` or another clock. Terminal
  completion before `trustedStart + 259200000` cannot delete the admitted
  bytes. After the finite maximum, continued work requires fresh
  materialization/revalidation, but that does not imply that an
  `eligibleLearning72Hours` row may be pruned or that a `userDurable`
  authorization has ended. Budget leases, capability grants, and Phase-C
  evidence retention are likewise orthogonal and cannot substitute for either
  minimum.

  `userDurable` uses the strict `.untilExplicitDeletion` horizon. Routine
  pruning and time passage do not select a disposition. Disk pressure first
  removes rebuildable caches/projections; if capacity still cannot honor an
  existing finite minimum or durable horizon, admission of new heavy work
  fails closed.

### Payload 4G — Implement deletion closure

  The synchronous transaction advances deletion/invalidation epochs and fences source plus known descendants before cleanup. Asynchronous owners then prove:

  - Artifact body/key fate;
  - EventLog eligible-range/checkpoint fate;
  - SQLite WAL/SHM/freelist fate;
  - atom/index/vector/cache/projection fate;
  - dataset/training/evaluation/export/canary lineage fate;
  - learning/evolution candidate, certified profile, installed profile, and
    rollback-profile lineage fate;
  - backup and external-destination fate.

  Terminal results are exactly `completed`, `residualExternalCopies`, or `indeterminateBlocked`. Only `completed` may claim complete erasure.

`semanticSnapshotArtifactID` reopens the canonical
`BASStateReadSnapshot`. Its compound currentness identity binds Workspace,
selected App Agent, Session, WorkUnit, Attempt, every lane watermark, the
active K3 head, policy/consent/deletion/revocation/share epochs, purpose,
destination, field mask, byte/token/row/time/resource limits, and trusted
logical/evidence time. The lane-watermark vector is necessary but is not the
only boundary; a single-session `BASEventLogHead`, caller-restated epoch tuple,
or omitted hierarchy/time field is not accepted.
The public authorized reader reopens and verifies the exact capability-use
receipt, caller-authentication receipt, snapshot Artifact, caller/App-Agent
scope, purpose, destination,
field mask, all row/byte/token/time limits, and every currentness epoch before
and after projection through the same Artifact store and currentness reader.
It must construct the bounded transient
`BASErasureDomainKeyUseAuthorization` from those incumbent receipts and call
`BASArtifactStorePort.readAuthorized`; calling bare `read(_:)` for snapshot
plaintext is a compile/source-gate failure.
Production visibility keeps `BASSpaceProjector` internal; a source/call-graph
test proves every production projection call enters
`BASAuthorizedSpaceProjectionReader` and no `@testable` or wrapper escape
reaches the raw projector. Only the authorized reader may call it.
Projectors are pure, rebuildable, and have no writer/store/grant port.
`projectWork` always queries `.workspace(request.workspaceRef)`.
`projectAutomation` maps `(sourceWorkspaceRef, automationRef)` exactly as
`(nil,nil) -> .host`, `(workspace,nil) -> .workspace(workspace)`, and
`(_,automation) -> .automation(sourceWorkspaceRef,automation)`. No other
combination, synthetic Workspace, implicit currentness scope, or widening from
automation detail to Host summary is legal. Both the pre-projection and
post-projection currentness queries must use the same exact scope value.

**Approved-history semantic closure in this Wave:** the already listed
`BASSemanticStateMarket.swift` and incumbent
`BASKunlunLayerProjections.swift`/LayerCell paths implement pure producers,
never new authorities. L7/L10 `produceInformationSufficiencyCandidate`
constructs only W1-valid preflight/presentation cases; L14 still authorizes the
final reopen. L5/L6 `projectHumanFit` emits the minimum transient authorized
identity/preference projection. L12 `projectNextQuestion` runs only after the
final authorized result and performs no pre-tap work. L10
`deriveClaimSupportMap` preserves exact spool spans and conflicts; L4
`authorWorldClaimSet` alone versions qualified world relations; L12 derives
the replayable explanation. R5 accepts a model receipt only for the frozen
`smallGroundingProposal` specialist role, while deterministic/human/tool/
not-required branches remain distinct. Experience projectors emit immutable
dataset/reward/credit candidates for later certification only. Every producer
reopens the same snapshot/currentness roots, and an ordinary Artifact put that
loses the K3 cursor/root CAS is inert.

The W3 candidate also closes attention re-entry and evidence-bound Persona
presentation without creating another context, memory, or identity owner.
Before the next Attempt may compile, the incumbent
`BASSemanticSnapshotCoordinator` advances one bounded deterministic
maintenance pass for the just-committed turn, reopens the resulting K3 head,
snapshot root, mission-graph root, retention/deletion/revocation epochs and
pending obligations, and emits an ordinary content-free receipt. A crash,
archive, foreground/background transition, or apparent “attention lapse” may
recompute `BASAttentionReentryProjection` only from those reopened receipts;
it never reads hidden reasoning, transient Provider state, caller-restated
progress, or an uncommitted plan. Changed currentness discards the projection
and recompiles it rather than patching stale fields.

`BASKunlunLayerProjections.swift` is the sole W3 consumer of the W1-contained
`BASPersonaSourceCard`. W3 accepts only already-admitted, untrusted source
Artifacts under the current snapshot; it performs no network request. Its
validating factory canonicalizes a sorted, unique allowlist of bounded
presentation traits (tone, warmth, directness, structure and ornament only)
and rejects instruction, factual-claim, tool, capability, authority,
permission, secret and citation-like content. L12 may project those traits
onto presentation, while L10 rechecks the exact post-style bytes and verified
facts. Missing, expired, contradictory or weakly sourced evidence yields the
neutral Persona, never a guessed imitation or a mutation of
`BASAgentPersonaSpec`. The contained subject/trait/card values receive no
independent schema row, Artifact kind, retention admission, store or Owner
Ledger object; only an incumbent parent Proposal/Persona payload may carry
them.

### Payload 5A — Write RED tests for requirement planning and snapshot barriers

  Preserve three non-overlapping responsibilities. The planner emits only a
  bounded typed `StateRequirementPlan`; the coordinator only freezes the
  immutable compound snapshot, lane high-water marks, barrier, and currentness;
  the original `state.snapshot-market` owner
  `BASSemanticStateMarket` alone performs global hard eligibility, validated
  grounding, conflict/coverage, the seven-field market, and deterministic
  selection. If its approved-missing file is absent, realize the original
  Semantic Task-6 non-empty CreateGate; otherwise extend it. Never move Market
  policy into the planner, coordinator, a lane, Rust, or a projection.

  Prove:

  - captures exact per-lane high-water marks;
  - fails closed on stale or incomparable watermarks;
  - applies eligibility before scoring;
  - freezes exactly `relevance`, `authority`, `freshness`, `utility`,
    `diversityContribution`, `tokenCost`, and `conflictRisk`; no eighth scalar,
    opaque aggregate score, or omitted field is allowed;
  - derives pre-election `tokenCost` only as the checked one-byte/one-unit plus
    section/resource formula in `BASModelNeutralMarketCost` under
    `qinao.market-token-units.v1`; post-election Provider-exact token accounting
    is observation only and cannot feed eligibility, ranking, or re-election;
  - handles hard floors and `.unresolvedMaterial` before sorting, keeps every
    material conflict visible, and reports required-lane coverage gaps;
  - sorts admitted candidates only by descending utility, authority,
    freshness, relevance, then ascending UTF-8 candidate key;
  - applies exact byte, token, source, lane, and entity concentration budgets
    and records every rejection/truncation in the one budget receipt;
  - prevents correlated duplicates from manufacturing independent authority
    or diversity;
  - never treats an index hit as read authority;
  - returns deterministic results for the same snapshot.

  A high-scoring hard-ineligible candidate never enters RRF or Market. Rust
  receives only the already-eligible bounded reservoir, cannot authorize or
  resolve truth, and its byte-identical output is revalidated before use.

  Add a race mutation proving a Host-wide Automation request with both refs
  `nil` performs matching `.host` currentness reads before and after projection
  and fails closed on any intervening epoch change; it must never invent a
  Workspace ref.

### Payload 5B — Normalize exact/FTS/dense/temporal/entity lanes

  Reuse existing retrievers and indexes as rebuildable mechanisms. Add scope,
  purpose, caller, field-mask, snapshot, consent, deletion, revocation, and
  share-epoch checks at the generic read membrane and physical partition
  before touching a row, byte, FTS term, vector, episode, or relation. The
  parent runner owns this exact progressive state machine and durably records
  one current phase receipt before advancing:

  1. `R0 compiled_pre_physical_eligibility` freezes/reopens the compound
     snapshot and lowers the complete eligibility predicate before any lookup;
  2. `R1 sql_metadata_exact_fts_bm25` performs mandatory cheap SQL, metadata,
     grep/exact, FTS5, and default SQLite-BM25 work when state is required;
  3. `R2 temporal_episode` runs or emits a deterministic `notRequired` receipt;
  4. `R3 entity_relation` runs or emits a deterministic `notRequired` receipt;
  5. `R4 dense_semantic` runs only for an explicit frozen requirement or a
     still-open required-coverage deficit. It may overlap R2/R3 only when that
     requirement was explicit at freeze and a certified process-memory
     profile proves positive marginal value. It must durably commit and reopen
     the current `BASR4DenseLaneAvailabilityReceipt` before advancing;
  6. `R5 dedupe_fusion_bounded_grounding_proposal` reapplies hard eligibility,
     calls the existing Rust owner once for bounded dedupe/RRF/source-lane-
     entity caps, truncates the reservoir, then emits exactly one closed
     `model|deterministic|humanOrTool|notRequired` tagged proposal and its
     branch-exact evidence plus current `BASR5ProducerAvailabilityReceipt`
     under the survival delta above; model unavailability cannot select
     `notRequired` or another branch, and coverage deficit cannot be encoded as
     omission;
  7. `R6 grounding_validation_hard_revalidation_conflict_market` validates the
     exact R5 tag/proposal/domain/order/schema/bounds and matching typed
     grounding receipt, rejects missing/extra/foreign/cross-tag evidence,
     requires Provider allocation/execution evidence only for `model` and
     forbids it for the other tags, reopens current epochs and the same
     snapshot, repeats global hard eligibility, resolves conflict/coverage,
     then invokes State Market.

  R4 and R5 each use the exact four evidence-bearing dispositions `available`,
  `unavailable`, `notRequired`, and `coverageDeficit`; the phase cannot advance
  until its current operation/snapshot/profile/epoch-bound receipt is durably
  committed and reopened. Within an activated phase only, physically independent lane queries may run
  concurrently. Children cannot put/accept results or advance a phase; the
  parent sorts by lane identity and seals the receipt. A late result, missing
  `notRequired` receipt, stale phase epoch, search-all-then-filter path, or
  skipped phase fails. Context candidate construction and
  `BASContextCompiler.compilePacket` are unreachable until the current durable
  R6 receipt and selection reopen under the same `BASTurnOperationRef`.

  Rust RRF may rank only already eligible candidates. It cannot admit,
  authorize, resolve truth, hide coverage gaps, or supply a Swift fallback.
  Canonical Swift/Rust input/output parity, finite positive `k`, output-domain
  membership, dedupe, caps, bounds, and UTF-8 tie-breaks are mutation-tested.

### Payload 5C — Project normalized interaction evidence

  Consume only the W2-admitted, content-free semantic event kinds. Raw
  touch/key/pointer/scroll/focus/render signals remain process-local `ephemeral` data and
  never enter projection, EventLog, or learning examples. The W3 exit reruns
  the append-boundary and producer-manifest gates; W3 cannot weaken, defer, or
  duplicate the W2 normalizer or L5 profile.

  Extend the incumbent StateLake contract with optional, strictly typed views
  over the same Event/Artifact truth: source bytes plus Unicode spans;
  utterances; clauses and speech acts; predicates/arguments; propositions and
  claims; entities/coreference/relations; discourse/pragmatic links; temporal
  episodes; tasks/actions; evidence/support/conflict; user-approved facts; and
  projection lineage. Every transformation binds producer/profile/version,
  input Artifact/root/spans, output root, provenance, confidence/currentness,
  and an explicit information-loss disposition. Missing analysis is typed
  `unavailable`; it is never guessed. These views are not a universal parser,
  token-ID truth, new store, or authority, and Provider tokenizer IDs are
  never persisted as linguistic identity.

### Payload 5D — Implement Work Space projection

  Rebuild Sessions, current user-directed work, projects, missions, objectives,

  refs, active/warm/cold context refs, checkpoints, and current/day/week/month
  views from one snapshot.

  The four horizons are query parameters, not tables or stores.

### Payload 5E — Implement Automation Space projection

  Rebuild immutable definitions, active version, operational state, next
  eligible proposal, current/waiting runs, checkpoints, outcomes, receipts,
  retention/deletion status, and exactly these user-facing module families:
  Today/Upcoming, skills, templates, running work, awaiting confirmation,
  failures/recovery, data/permissions, learning insights, and causal history.
  Module order, size, grouping, visibility, and user composition are preference
  projections only and cannot change schedule eligibility, execution,
  capability, data scope, retention, learning, or authority.

  The Host-wide summary may list safe summaries for all user-owned Automation scopes. Detail requires an exact per-scope attenuated read. Projection code cannot run, retry, cancel, pause, edit, delete, grant, share, or export.

  A signed structured Automation definition may be submitted directly by an
  authenticated human, UI, or importer without a natural-language producer.
  Natural-language authoring is optional and may emit only the same inert
  structured Proposal for validation. AI-authored skills are signed declarative
  compositions of already admitted capabilities. Neither Space may download,
  generate for execution, JIT, or
  dynamically run Swift, Rust, C, C++, Metal, Python, shell, JavaScript, or
  another executable payload on iOS.

### Payload 5F — Implement model/user analytics as orthogonal projections

  `BASModelRuntimeProfileProjection` consumes a canonical profile reference
  from `BASOrgan/BASModelCapabilityManifest.swift` and adds only observed
  latency, memory, energy, thermal, quality, failure, and fallback evidence.
  It cannot redeclare model/material/profile truth in BASMemory.

  `BASUserExperienceProfileProjection` contains consented interaction preferences, accessibility needs, correction patterns, explicit feedback, and task outcomes. It excludes engagement/dependence objectives, silence-as-consent, HealthKit/general-sensitive data, hidden reasoning, and another App Agent's private scope.

  Neither projection selects a model or mutates user/App-Agent state.

### Payload 5G — Implement the experience gate

  Every `experienceSource` either yields a bounded eligible envelope or an
  explicit ineligible/quarantine receipt after exactly seven ordered gates:

  1. structural and closed-schema cleaning;
  2. instruction/prompt-injection neutralization;
  3. provenance and integrity verification;
  4. epistemic status and calibration;
  5. semantic fidelity and contradiction handling;
  6. privacy, secret, and consent enforcement;
  7. Self/App-Agent/Workspace contamination and scope enforcement.

  Every gate emits a bounded typed receipt. No gate may be skipped, merged,
  defaulted, or repaired by later model agreement. Mutation tests change each
  field independently, including source class/compartment, hierarchy/share
  lineage, owner sequence, epochs, before/after roots, model/plan/context,
  resource evidence, and result receipts.
  `derivedOutcomeFeature` is ineligible by default and needs its own independent
  source, lineage, current authorization, and anti-self-corroboration rule.
  `governanceControl`, `auditProof`, and `projectionOnly` never produce ordinary
  learning examples.

  Causal or off-policy use additionally requires a pre-exposure
  `BASExperienceExposureContract` frozen in W1. Its canonical bytes bind:

  - candidate action set, including a singleton set when no choice existed;
  - selected action and behavior-policy ID/digest;
  - logged propensity or an explicit deterministic-policy marker;
  - exposure/cohort/time identity;
  - generator, evaluator, root-model, and shared-training correlation classes;
  - outcome window, censoring/missingness rules, and independent outcome-source
    contract.

  If any required pre-exposure field is missing, late-filled, or
  self-evaluated without an independent source, the event remains diagnostic
  only and is excluded from reward, ranking, training, and policy improvement.

  Dataset construction is one seven-stage candidate pipeline over only
  eligible envelopes: (1) provenance/consent/purpose/retention; (2) secret and
  sensitivity classification/redaction; (3) schema/bounds/encoding/integrity;
  (4) duplicate and causal-root grouping; (5) source fidelity/span lineage/
  label quality/conflict; (6) leakage-resistant group splitting; (7) immutable
  generation manifest, erasure lineage, and reproducible build. Generations
  are immutable; a correction creates a linked successor and never rewrites
  the predecessor.

  Reward is a vector over independently evidenced user correction/approval,
  deterministic task checks, source fidelity/claim support, recovery honesty/
  no-duplicate behavior, calibrated uncertainty, and efficiency above fixed
  quality/safety floors. Clicks, dwell, dependency, praise, silence, model
  confidence, and absence of complaint cannot independently promote anything.
  Causal adoption additionally requires the complete pre-exposure contract,
  holdout, guardrails, distribution-shift checks, counterfactual/OPE evidence,
  side-effect analysis, shadow/canary evidence, rollback, and deletion
  closure. Field-by-field post-exposure mutation tests must remain association-
  only even when every digest is recomputed.

  Cadence is exact: current Attempt performs no learning/self-modification;
  post-Attempt emits cleaned observations/candidates only; day/week/month runs
  replay, consolidation, OPE, shadow, drift, and data quality; certification/
  release alone may train, sign manifests, canary, cut over, roll back, and
  close deletion. An external trainer is isolated and untrusted. Qinao never
  trains AFM system weights or evaluates new prompt/context/tool/profile
  candidates around AFM; that retired mechanism is migration/recovery evidence
  only.

### Payload 5H — Shadow and replay

  Run new projectors beside incumbent paths, compare deterministic roots,
  inject malformed payloads, and fail closed instead of silently skipping
  corrupt rows. Do not cut over reads in W3.

  Adapt the incumbent sleep pass/driver/checkpoint as an L13
  snapshot-to-candidate mechanism only. It reads one immutable authorized
  snapshot and writes one ordinary Artifact candidate plus audit/replay
  receipts; it cannot directly change a memory tier, tracker ledger, persona,
  policy, State head, route, dataset, or model. Full learned EventLog bodies,
  raw prompts, secrets, and Provider-private state are never checkpointed;
  only minimized references, roots, loss/provenance, and candidate bytes cross
  the boundary. Interruption, wall-clock rollback/forward jump, reboot, stale
  snapshot, deletion/revocation, duplicate proposal, and changed bytes under
  one idempotency identity yield an inert retry/reopen or typed block, never a
  partial mutation. `BASMemorySleepConsolidationPassTests` and
  `BASSleepConsolidationDriverTests` prove zero direct authoritative sinks.

  Convert `BASBiomimeticTurnObserver`, checkpoint payload/snapshot, and the
  incumbent runtime hook to `observationShadow`: bounded observations and
  minimized EventLog references may feed replay/certification only. Any full
  learned body is stored, if independently eligible, as encrypted Artifact
  content and EventLog carries only its ref/digest; no mutable biomimetic state,
  prompt body, model state, reward, policy, route, or direct runtime decision
  is persisted or applied. The three existing biomimetic suites prove default-
  off posture, Artifact-only body handling, deterministic replay, and zero
  state/effect/publication/learning authority.

The contained model-neutral classifier ABI introduced in W4 is exactly:

```swift
public enum BASContextClassifierContract {
    public static let orderedLabels: [String] = [
        "chat", "task", "choice", "conflict", "highPressure",
        "manipulationRisk", "highConsequence"
    ]
}

public enum BASContextClassifierContractViolation:
    Error, Equatable, Sendable {
    case invalidResult
}

public struct BASContextClassification: Sendable, Equatable {
    public let label: String
    public let confidence: Double
    public let logits: [Float]

    public init(
        label: String,
        confidence: Double,
        logits: [Float]
    ) throws {
        guard confidence.isFinite,
              (0.0...1.0).contains(confidence),
              logits.count == BASContextClassifierContract.orderedLabels.count,
              logits.allSatisfy({ $0.isFinite })
        else {
            throw BASContextClassifierContractViolation.invalidResult
        }
        self.label = label
        self.confidence = confidence
        self.logits = logits
    }
}

public protocol BASContextClassifying: Sendable {
    func classify(text: String) throws -> BASContextClassification
}
```

The HostKit-only, runtime-only pilot selection value and its typed construction

```swift
public enum BASCognitiveBrainFactoryError: Error, Equatable, Sendable {
```

it accepts no already-created classifier, context service, second closure or
other classifier source. No convenience
overload may omit the preset, discard an incumbent customization, or create a
third public composition path.

For `.defaults`, all thirteen arguments retain the incumbent
`makeWithDefaults` semantics, including every explicit SQL/Rust/C++/Metal
injection and memory embed/persistence customization. For `.allNative`, the
common routine creates exactly the incumbent five-pilot composition (internal C
clock plus SQL, Rust, C++ and Metal mechanisms), carries every non-pilot setting
and all memory embed/dimension/persistence arguments through unchanged, and
requires the four explicit pilot-override arguments
`sqlHistoryStore|rustHistoryStore|cxxSummaryCache|metalLibraryLoader` all to be
`nil`. Any non-`nil` override throws exactly
`BASCognitiveBrainFactoryError.explicitPilotOverrideConflictsWithAllNative`
before constructing a pilot, classifier, service or brain; it is never ignored,
merged or allowed to shadow the preset. The machine-derived call-site migration
must prove each old 13-argument `makeWithDefaults` call and each old six-argument
`makeWithAllPilots` call retains every explicitly supplied value under the new
factory, and targeted fixtures cover all thirteen labels, both presets, the
typed conflict and byte-equivalent customization forwarding.

`BASContextClassification` is ephemeral and deliberately not `Codable`; its
initializer validates finite confidence, the closed probability range, exact
seven-logit shape and finite logits. It deliberately permits an unknown label
so the incumbent HostKit unknown-label audit path remains testable and
fail-visible rather than being collapsed into a generic adapter error. The
moved `BASContextClassifierMLAdapter` explicitly conforms, preserves its
public `labels` compatibility alias as
`BASContextClassifierContract.orderedLabels`, and returns this result value.
The asynchronous Core AI shadow adapter is not forced into this synchronous
port; it reuses only the encoder and ordered-label contract and retains its
separate async Provider-facing surface.

`BASMLContextService` stores `any BASContextClassifying`, accepts it through a
public `classifier:` initializer, and consumes only `BASContextClassification`
plus `BASContextClassifierContract.orderedLabels`. `BASCognitiveBrain.swift`
stores `contextClassifier: (any BASContextClassifying)?`, never the concrete
Core ML class; its full-default designated initializer receives the classifier
from its caller and preserves every other incumbent default service. The
probability extension in `BASCognitiveBrain+Pilots.swift` consumes the same
existential and ordered-label contract. The old ambiguous no-argument
`makeWithDefaults`/`makeWithAllPilots` construction is not allowed to silently
change meaning. HostKit introduces one contained, non-Codable runtime enum
`BASCognitiveBrainPilotPreset: String, Sendable, Equatable` with exactly
`defaults|allNative`, and exposes only the full closed
`makeModelNeutral(pilotPreset:...)` surface above for the zero-learned path. The new file in the
incumbent `BASAppleEdgeWiring` composition ring exposes the one learned
`makeWithAppleContextClassifier(pilotPreset:...)` surface with the same thirteen
customization arguments and supplies one lazy closure that can construct the
moved Core ML adapter. The common routine validates the preset and all four
override values before invoking that closure, invokes it at most once per
successful brain, then constructs `BASMLContextService` and the probability
side channel from that same returned existential instance. Thus it constructs exactly one
moved Core ML adapter per learned brain and injects that same instance into
`BASMLContextService` and the probability side channel, and preserves the old
learned default/all-pilots behavior according to the closed preset.
Both public factories delegate one `package`-scoped common HostKit construction
routine (visible to the same-package EdgeWiring target but not exported as a
third factory): the
model-neutral factory selects the incumbent
`BASPlaceholderContextService` only at L0 and retains the same incumbent power,
host-profile, decomposition, memory, risk, Tri-Self, evolution, action and
selected pilot composition as its learned counterpart. It must not reuse the
current explicit-services initializer that replaces the other services with
placeholders, and must not invent a deterministic fake classifier. The Apple
factory differs only by passing the lazy moved-classifier factory; the common
routine alone creates the service and shares the result. The model-neutral
factory passes `nil`, so pilot selection remains orthogonal and a
classifier/service pair can never be supplied from different sources.
Every predecessor call site is atomically rewritten to one of those two named
factories with an explicit preset and byte-equivalent forwarding of every
supplied argument; a remaining no-argument `BASCognitiveBrain.makeWithDefaults`
or `makeWithAllPilots`, direct HostKit concrete-adapter construction, hidden

composition factory fails W4. `BASJournalCLI` adds/imports the existing

learned governance behavior does not silently degrade.

The W1-admitted immutable closure runner establishes the capability-profile
physical-closure gate when W4 invokes it against the exact W4 candidate tree. The
W1 manifest is a policy/taxonomy trust anchor, not a prediction of any W4
candidate digest; candidate `reachableMechanismRows` are independently derived
by the runner and compared bidirectionally with candidate declarations.
The W1-admitted runner blob and profile-manifest trust anchor are reopened
before W4; neither the W4 candidate tree nor caller CLI may replace them.
The verified W1 terminal receipt transitively commits the fixed runner and
profile-manifest policy rows through its unchanged installed tree and protected
roots; the external broker derives `QINAO_MODEL_ERASED_RUNNER_SHA256` and
`QINAO_MODEL_ERASED_PROFILE_MANIFEST_SHA256` and materializes
read-only `QINAO_W1_ADMITTED_MODEL_ERASED_RUNNER` and
`QINAO_W1_ADMITTED_MODEL_ERASED_PROFILE_MANIFEST` paths from that exact W1 tree
only after both digests match, and missing or mismatched bindings block W4 and
W6. The manifest freezes only the admitted policy/taxonomy; each later runner
derives the candidate-tree mechanism and symbol closure before comparing it
bidirectionally with candidate declarations.
The runner projects both `no-language-inference` and `no-learned-inference`
from the exact candidate tree, physically excludes the named language-model targets,
tokenizer/model-weight packages/resources and network/model Provider
registrations, then clean-resolves, builds and tests the nonempty model-neutral
closure for `BASHostKit`, `BASAppleLifecycleKit`, `QinaoRuntime`, `QinaoHost`
and `QinaoDefaults`. Positive source, resolved-target, object, link-input and
test counts plus the existing `BASModelBoundaryPinTests` sentinel reject a
zero-match or prose-only claim. `CoreAI`, `MLX`, and `NaturalLanguage` are not
categorically banned because they can expose non-language mechanisms; the
W1-admitted policy/taxonomy plus the runner-derived bidirectional mechanism and
symbol closure is the gate, never a framework name or missing weight alone.
`reachableMechanismRows` is a bidirectional equality over every
reachable source, target, compiler dependency, object symbol, link-map input,
resource, Provider registration, dynamic-loader edge, and network edge; an
unlisted or manifest-only row fails. The runner recomputes dependency,
compiler-d, object-symbol, link-map, resource, registration, dynamic-loader,
and network inventories from the exact candidate tree after clean resolve,
build, and test. No reachable dynamic URL, downloaded or cached model,
system-opaque language service, or unclassified symbol can be justified by the
absence of a bundled weight; an unknown capability fails both profiles. W6
reruns this same admitted gate against the final certification candidate tree
rather than trusting W4 evidence.

The admitted closure runner requires
`qinao.proposal-mechanism-certification.v1` for every reachable mechanism row.
For each row it reopens the signed, digest-bound incumbent
`BASArtifactAttestationPayload`, verifies issuer/key/custody/purpose/currentness,
recomputes the profile-independent proof-kind-plus-first-nine-fields preimage,
then checks the candidate declaration, resource-closure root and physical
source/resource/object/link/registration facts bidirectionally. An unsigned,
expired, wrong-purpose, wrong-target, digest-only, tag-only or
manifest-only mechanism fails before candidate execution. Profile inheritance
is exact: `fullProvider` is the base; `noGenerativeProvider` removes
`openGenerativeProvider`; `noLanguageInference` inherits that row and removes
every language-marked proof/resource; `noLearnedInference` inherits that row
and removes every learned-marked proof/resource, including the world-model
composite. Runner expansion of inherited rows must byte-equal the manifest's
declared expanded forbidden-capability and forbidden-resource sets.

`no-learned-inference` classifies the classifier itself: every classifier
resource and adapter is present in the recomputed bidirectional reachability
closure; a learned, unknown, manifest-only, or unreachable classifier
dependency fails before candidate execution. RuntimeCore retains the pure
encoder and the newly frozen contained label/result/protocol ABI above, so the
neutral closure can still construct and validate classifier inputs without a
learned implementation. The concrete Core ML adapter and its
`.mlmodel` move together into the existing `BASAppleAdapters` target;
`BASHostKit` receives only `any BASContextClassifying`, its named
model-neutral factory never constructs an adapter, and the existing
`BASAppleEdgeWiring` target is the sole learned full-profile composition
point. The
`fullProvider` projection retains that composition. The
`noLearnedInference` projection must have zero reachable classifier-adapter
source, `.mlmodel` resource, compiler dependency, object symbol, link-map
input, registration or dynamic-loader row; an indirect HostKit construction
or a resource copied into another bundle fails the same bidirectional check.
The profile inheritance is subtractive: `noLanguageInference` inherits all
`noGenerativeProvider` prohibitions, and `noLearnedInference` inherits all
`noLanguageInference` prohibitions before also forbidding learned mechanisms.
Consequently its inherited resource closure forbids
`language-model-weight`, `tokenizer`, and `prompt-template` as well as its own
`learned-weight`; the manifest expresses that inheritance once and the runner
expands it before comparing the physical inventory.

| physical profile | forbidden capabilities |
|---|---|
| `no-language-inference` | `boundedLanguageLearned,languageHuman,languageTool,openGenerativeProvider` |
| `no-learned-inference` | `boundedNonLanguageLearned,boundedLanguageLearned,languageHuman,languageTool,openGenerativeProvider,boundedNonLanguageWorldModelSearch` |

**Canonical compiler interface:**

```swift
public enum BASContextCompiler {
    public static func compilePacket(
        _ request: BASStructuredContextCompilationRequest
    ) throws -> BASStructuredContextPacket
}
```

`BASStructuredContextCompilationRequest` binds caller Agent identity, exact
Session-selection-evidence Artifact, reopened `BASAppAgentRootRef`, current
Self/composite source roots, recomputed `sessionMainAgentID`, Main-or-Sub
capsule-owner identity, required Sub slot-claim receipt,
Task/Attempt/branch, snapshot roots, purpose/rights, exact output schema,
eligible structured candidates and source spans, byte/section/concentration
ceilings, memory/energy/time budgets, monotonic deadline, cancellation
generation, and all currentness epochs. It contains no Provider/model/material,
tokenizer/template, token limit, prompt partition, or KV field.

`BASStructuredContextPacket` binds retained/dropped structured blocks with
reasons, canonical byte accounting, stable/volatile semantic section roots,
snapshot roots, source/authority coverage, disclosure plan, exact output schema,
current R6 receipt, and a continuity manifest. It never contains a prompt,
token IDs, a Provider/material identity, or a shared/private KV handle. The W4
model path reuses the already-approved runtime-only, tokenize-once
`BASExactCompiledContext` after exact model plan selection; it does not create
a second compiled-context aggregate.

### Payload 6A (W3) — Write RED tests for the single compiler

  Tests fail if:

  - any second production type/function performs packing, drop, render, or fingerprint ownership;
  - prompt, tokenizer, token ID, Provider/model/material or private-KV state
    enters the canonical packet;
  - the compiler exceeds any structured byte/section/concentration ceiling;
  - a block crosses Agent/App-Agent/purpose/epoch scope;
  - stable-prefix identity changes without its fingerprint changing;
  - a dropped required-authority block is omitted without a coverage failure;
  - hidden reasoning or Provider KV becomes a context block.

### Payload 6B (W3) — Implement the exact canonical Context Packet

  Normalize and canonicalize each retained structured candidate once without a
  model, Provider, tokenizer, or prompt. Cache identity is exact over Agent,
  stable App-Agent scope/root,
  selection-evidence Artifact, current Self/composite roots, derived Main/Sub
  and slot-claim receipt, Session incarnation, WorkUnit,
  Attempt, snapshot, State ABI, policy/consent/deletion/revocation/share epochs,
  purpose, output schema, and content fingerprint. A cache hit grants no read
  authority and must reopen current epochs, deadline, cancellation generation,
  and scope. Provider/model/material/tokenizer/template values are absent and
  therefore cannot alias two packet identities.

  Remove or delegate duplicate packing behavior in `CognitionKernelCore.swift`
  to the sole compiler. `SemanticCompilerCore.swift`,
  `ScopedContextCore.swift`, and `EBrainTurnContextCompiler.swift` may only
  project typed inputs and invoke `BASContextCompiler.compilePacket` exactly
  once. Source-ownership tests reject local sorting, dropping, rendering,
  packet budgeting, packing, or fingerprint logic; byte-identity tests prove
  every wrapper returns the compiler's exact bytes and receipt.

  After every committed turn, a bounded deterministic maintainer advances the
  mission/continuity projection, exact evidence/constraint/conflict deltas and
  source lineage under the same snapshot owner. It never waits for a context
  window to fill and never rewrites source truth into a recursive summary.
  Optional dense embedding, KaLM reranking, learned extraction and deeper
  ontology projections run as separately admitted asynchronous work; the next
  Attempt reopens the latest committed snapshot and calls the sole compiler.
  A late projection may help only a successor Attempt and cannot mutate the
  response or evidence that caused it.

### Payload 6C (W3) — Bind Main/Sub/Provider isolation and admit the W3 slice

  This context slice reopens, but does not duplicate, the W3 state-slice
  receipts selected by
  `testEveryCommittedTurnAdvancesBoundedMaintenanceBeforeNextAttemptCompilation`,
  `testAttentionReentryReconstructsCurrentWorkFromReopenedEvidenceOnly`, and
  `testWebPersonaCardFallsBackNeutralOnConflictAndCannotChangeVerifiedFacts`.
  Their exact selectors remain owned by the earlier W3 nonempty command; this
  slice checks receipt continuity only, so the plan-wide selector bijection
  stays one-to-one.

  One Session has one K3-selected stable `BASAppAgentRootRef`, exact winning
  `BASAppAgentSessionSelectionEvidence` Artifact, and one deterministically
  derived logical Main identity. The W1-frozen request/binding/evidence/result
  family is written/reopened only through W2's
  `selectAppAgentForSession`/`reopenAppAgentSessionSelection` K3 seam. Reopen
  its exact Artifact and current Self/composite heads at every snapshot,
  capsule, context compile and join; an ambient UI choice or bare string cannot
  select identity. Provider/model replacement changes neither root nor Main.
  Each
  Sub Agent receives one role-minimal independent `BASContextCapsule` and
  returns a typed `BASDelegationProposal`, `BASReasoningArtifact`, and terminal
  receipt. It cannot see sibling KV, broader memory, another App Agent's Self,
  or the Main's hidden reasoning.

  The frozen DAG predeclares a finite, canonically ordered slot set, complete
  role/purpose/schema/capability/budget/deadline ceilings, and depth one. Main
  may propose a slot; runtime alone deterministically binds the first matching
  unoccupied slot through K3 CAS. Sub Agents cannot delegate. A typed
  reasoning artifact binds operation/Attempt/branch/slot, claims or
  disposition, evidence and exact source spans, assumptions, uncertainty,
  counterexamples, correlation/common-mode and shared-training lineage,
  resource receipts, and completion receipt. No generic Agent bus, free-form
  hidden transcript, or mutable mailbox is introduced.

  Main may synthesize only from verified typed results and source receipts.
  The join uses the frozen source order and correlation/common-mode classes,
  retains conflicts and missing required children, and checks current terminal
  Attempt refs. Majority vote cannot outrank authority or evidence; correlated
  siblings cannot manufacture independent support.

  Multiple persistent App Agents may exist, but the Session's K3 selection binds
  exactly one. Each App Agent has a separate Self/relationship/preference scope.
  Another App Agent may read only an exact immutable share and cannot mutate,
  declassify, train on, cache-reuse, export, or cut over from the source without
  separately compatible grants.

  User-selectable persona presets affect only companion expression, approved
  values, relationship continuity, and presentation structure. A “呆呆的”
  voice may alter wording or ornament, but never facts, constraints, risk,
  citations, tool parameters, state, permissions, verification, or audit.
  The release order is exact: neutral verified content → L12 persona/
  presentation projection → L10 post-style invariant verification → the
  ordinary L11/L14/publication path. If style changes a fact, number,
  uncertainty, warning, permission, citation, verifier result, or exact spool
  constraint, release fails. Provider replacement does not replace the App
  Agent or logical Main identity.

  When the user explicitly requests a public or fictional persona whose style
  is unknown, authorized web retrieval may propose one source-bound Persona
  Card containing citations, public/fictional subject classification,
  presentation traits, uncertainty, scope, expiry and non-deception policy.
  It remains untrusted content until the ordinary R0-R6/provenance gates pass,
  affects presentation only after neutral verification, and cannot infer or
  impersonate a private person. Missing/conflicting sources select the neutral
  safe style rather than model improvisation.

  Admit and controller-install this W3 context slice before touching any W4 model/provider
  file:


### Payload 6D (W4) — Adapt context geometry to local and API models

  Implement the one `BASProposalEngineAdapter` first wire only after W3 has
  admitted the canonical `BASStructuredContextPacket`. The adapter consumes the
  same structured packet, elects/returns one contained plan through the
  incumbent `BASExecutionPlanElector`, then the same atomic W4 candidate asks
  the sole compiler extension for a validated runtime-only materialization and
  emits the same `BASStructuredProposal` for all six candidate kinds.
  Rule/search/classic-ML adapters execute admitted bounded
  mechanisms; human/tool adapters validate their authenticated signed
  structured input. Those five paths create no `providerStep`, Provider
  allocation/call, prompt, token stream, or private KV.

  `ContextCompilerCore.swift`, under the incumbent
  `state.context-compiler`, is extended in this same W4 candidate after the
  BASOrgan plan declaration and owns the post-compile
  `BASProposalInputMaterialization` ABI tagged
  `rule|search|classicML|human|tool|model`. The first five carry
  `BASNonModelProposalInput`, exactly one of
  `structuredPacketDirect|tensorState|constraintGraph|programIR|policyState`,
  one canonical packet digest and one contained `BASNonModelProposalPlan` with
  the exact candidate, mechanism proof, plan digest, mechanism/resource/output
  Artifacts and ordered causal parents;
  they contain no prompt, tokenizer, token IDs, Provider ref/step or private KV.
  `classicML` is certified bounded non-open-generative inference. A certified
  world-model-plus-search composite reopens
  `BASWorldModelSearchCausalProof`, keeps prediction evidence then search-plan
  evidence as two ordered causal producer edges before the adapter joins them;
  it does not erase lineage or mint a second plan/compiler.
  The already-admitted W3 tree contains only the canonical packet and incumbent
  `BASExactCompiledContext`; it neither declares nor references the three W4
  input/materialization types or `BASNonModelProposalPlan`. The W4 candidate
  must compile after adding both sides atomically, so no wave consumes a symbol
  from a future candidate.
  The existing W4 sentinel
  `BASProposalEngineAdapterTests.testPostCompileInputsAreKindTaggedAndNonModelMaterializationIsTokenless`
  therefore has two non-vacuous compile fixtures: it first builds the exact W3
  candidate and proves all four future type names absent from its dependency
  closure, then builds the W4 candidate with both the BASOrgan plan declaration
  and `ContextCompilerCore` materialization extension present. Swapping either
  half across the Wave boundary or compiling only the final combined tree must
  fail the sentinel.

  Only the `model` branch, after exact plan/binding selection and immediately
  before allocation, asks that sole compiler to reuse one ephemeral
  `BASExactCompiledContext`
  from the canonical packet and the selected tokenizer/template. It tokenizes
  each retained section once, enforces `maximumInputTokens -
  reservedOutputTokens`, binds the derived prompt/token fingerprint into the
  plan and allocation receipts, and never writes prompt/token/KV bytes as
  canonical State. A model materializer cannot change packet facts, order,
  source spans, conflict state, output schema, rights, or budgets. BASOrgan
  never imports `BASExactCompiledContext` or declares an input/materialization
  type; BASOrchestration already depends on BASOrgan and consumes the returned
  selection, so no reverse target edge is introduced. The adapter owns no
  separate selection policy or fallback; `BASExecutionPlanElector` and the
  incumbent Provider branch policy remain the only routed plan owners.

  W4 also adds the continuation behavior without creating a recovery manager
  or letting an ML adapter write evidence. The shared route/observation values
  are declared in `BASRuntimeCore/ProviderExecutionCore.swift`; the narrow
  protocol is declared in `BASOrgan/BASOrganAdapter.swift`; route selection
  stays in `BASOrgan/BASExecutionPlan.swift`; and the only concrete local
  conformance stays in `BASMLXAdapter/MLXOrganAdapter+SessionPersist.swift`:

```swift
public enum BASContinuationRoute: Codable, Sendable, Equatable {
    case recompileFromAcceptedPrefix(
        checkpointRefArtifactID: BASArtifactID,
        checkpointRefDigest: String
    )
    case accelerateWithVerifiedKV(
        checkpointRefArtifactID: BASArtifactID,
        checkpointRefDigest: String,
        providerCheckpointReceiptArtifactID: BASArtifactID,
        providerCheckpointReceiptDigest: String,
        cacheCheckpointIdentityArtifactID: BASArtifactID,
        cacheCheckpointIdentityDigest: String,
        verificationReceiptArtifactID: BASArtifactID,
        verificationReceiptDigest: String
    )
}

public struct BASProviderCheckpointMaterializationObservation:
    Sendable, Equatable {
    public let cacheBodyArtifactID: BASArtifactID
    public let cacheBodyDigest: String
    public let acceptedTokenPrefixDigest: String
    public let acceptedTokenCount: UInt64
    public let acceptedOutputPrefixDigest: String
    public let representationDigest: String
    public let exactnessDisposition: BASProviderCheckpointExactnessDisposition
    public let cacheScopeContractDigest: String
}

public protocol BASProviderCheckpointMaterializer: Sendable {
    associatedtype CacheCheckpointIdentity: Codable & Sendable & Equatable

    func materializeCheckpoint(
        _ ref: BASContinuationCheckpointRef,
        cacheIdentity: CacheCheckpointIdentity,
        authorizedCacheBody: BASAuthorizedArtifactRead
    ) async throws -> BASProviderCheckpointMaterializationObservation
}
```

  The authorized cache read is a one-shot, already capability-receipted
  projection. The MLX conformer returns only a non-`Codable`, non-authoritative
  observation and cannot put an Artifact, mint a verification receipt, or
  choose a route. The incumbent Provider verifier canonicalizes that
  observation and ordinary-puts one generic `BASArtifactAttestationPayload`.
  The pure RuntimeCore factory constructs the self-ID-free
  `BASProviderCheckpointReceipt` and performs no I/O. The incumbent upper
  Artifact facet ordinary-puts the factory result and reopens that receipt.
  BASOrgan reopens the Ref, Identity, three
  retention rows/receipts, body, attestation and Provider receipt before it
  chooses a route. Only `.exactNative` plus
  `.verifiedExactAcceleration` and a byte-exact accepted-prefix reproduction
  may accelerate; `.lossyHint`, a mismatch or missing evidence always
  recompiles from the accepted prefix. No Artifact/K3/retention authority is
  delegated to MLX and PCC has no checkpoint materializer.

  The selected W1 `BASCapabilityExecutionProfile` is exactly one of
  `fullProvider|noGenerativeProvider|noLanguageInference|noLearnedInference`
  and is immutable for the whole Attempt. Loss or gain of capability returns
  the typed unavailable disposition or starts a new Attempt; it never replaces
  the profile, candidate matrix, grounding branches, or plan inside the same
  Attempt. After a model wins, `BASProviderExactAccounting` records its exact
  candidate kind, tokenizer and input/output counts through a strict decoder,
  but that observation cannot alter the pre-election market.

  Each compiled Attempt uses the Section-G identity tuple
  `workspace × conversation × logicalAgent × role × workUnit × attempt ×
  capsuleKind × capabilityProfile` and a hard usable budget of
  `min(advertised, empiricallyCertified) - reserves`. Cache/KV identity also
  includes model material, tokenizer, prompt template, State ABI, sampler/RNG,
  accepted token-history digest, policy/currentness epochs and deletion scope.
  Missing any component is a cache miss; no profile or window borrows another
  profile's capacity or private state.

  Model profiles express:

  - maximum context and output;
  - tokenizer/material identity;
  - streaming/cancellation/tool/vision capabilities, exact supported tool/
    interface/output schemas, and measured structured-output reliability;
  - prefix-cache, suffix-continuation, prompt-lookup, MTP, and fallback support;
  - local/API transport, egress, retention, deletion, training, disclosure, and
    safety eligibility;
  - for API profiles, endpoint/account/region policy, cost revision and
    conservative maximum cost, quota/rate-limit state, request idempotency,
    authenticated terminal-query/reconciliation support, and unavailable/
    unknown transport behavior;
  - measured latency/memory/energy/thermal/quality evidence;
  - unsupported and degraded modes.

  The selectable roster is exactly the signed five-role manifest frozen in
  Section G: Qwen3.5-4B local Main, MiniCPM5-1B text specialist/Sub-Agent,
  Granite Embedding 311M Multilingual R2 dense encoder, KaLM Reranker V1 Nano
  bounded reranker, and PCC remote opaque consultant. Qwen3.5-4B is the
  initial user-visible local preference, not an unconditional execution
  choice: explicit user selection, exact material availability, current
  device measurements, privacy/quality/resource eligibility, and admission
  still decide the plan. MiniCPM5-1B may become a depth-one specialist only
  after exact conversion/runtime/device evidence. Granite and KaLM receive no
  Agent identity, delegation slot, Context Capsule, vote, truth/eligibility
  authority, or independent completion claim. PCC is enabled only by its
  exact public API/entitlement/device/profile evidence and otherwise remains
  typed unavailable. The incumbent AFM peer-Main, MiniCPM-V, and Granite-97M
  entries are retired compatibility/migration inputs and cannot be selected.
  Future API models use the same schema and stronger capability measurements;
  they do not receive wider state authority by being more capable.

  A signed roster row is not runtime reachability. The new
  `BASCoreAIRosterAdapters.swift` is a thin mechanism set over the incumbent
  `BASCoreAIModelRunner`: Qwen3.5-4B and MiniCPM5-1B each implement the existing
  `BASOrganAdapter`; Granite Embedding 311M Multilingual R2 implements the
  canonical storage-facing `BASMemory.BASEmbeddingProvider`; and KaLM Reranker
  V1 Nano implements `BASMemory.BASVectorReranker`. The wrappers own no
  selection, State, cache authority, Agent identity or fallback. Each one
  reopens the exact manifest/material/certification row and binds its emitted
  observation to that row. The one
  `BASCoreAIRosterComposition.swift` entry verifies a bijection
  `manifest role -> asset -> certified tensor/tokenizer ABI -> adapter protocol
  -> composition -> intended consumer` before injecting the four mechanisms;
  an extra, missing, cross-role or unreachable row fails closed. For Qwen and
  MiniCPM, the certified ABI includes tokenizer, iterative decode/state, KV,
  sampler and stop/output-schema behavior: the runner's existing generic
  named-tensor `run` call alone is never treated as a language-model adapter.
  If the converted Core AI asset/runtime cannot satisfy that whole ABI on the
  admitted device, the role stays typed unavailable instead of falling back
  to a different model. Granite and KaLM cannot be used through either of the
  two unrelated legacy protocol names or as an implicit Apple
  `NLEmbedding`/identity fallback.

  The existing roster sentinel
  `BASLocalAPIProviderParityTests.testAdmittedCompositionRosterIsClosedPerManifestAndCoreRemainsModelNeutral`
  derives and compares both sides of that chain for all four local roles and
  proves the core/Qinao products remain model-neutral. It also decodes the
  historical AFM `SystemOpaqueEnvelope`/`AFMAccountingShape`/`afmFreshSession`
  fixtures but rejects them at producer registration, election,
  materialization, allocation and new-Attempt admission. Cross-substituting
  those historical shapes for PCC's `SystemManagedRemoteOpaqueEnvelope`, or
  leaving an AFM/Qinao endpoint or host registration reachable, fails the same
  sentinel.

  Keep stable Qinao semantic targets free of concrete Qwen, MiniCPM, Granite,
  KaLM, PCC, AFM, Core AI, MLX, Core ML, Metal, and remote-API product
  dependencies.
  Concrete adapters remain host composition. Source, dependency-graph, symbol,
  and link-image tests reject a leaked import/type/material/default; the host's
  Qwen3.5-4B preference is a versioned composition choice, not an SDK constant.

  Build one canonical K1 lifecycle composition from the incumbent
  `QinaoLifecycle -> BASLeaseLifeCoordinator -> BASLungStateAccumulator ->
  BASThermalTwin` path. It alone writes the live resource envelope. Use
  `ContinuousClock`/monotonic phase receipts in-process; wall clock is governed
  evidence time only. Restart, clock rollback/forward jump, stale or negative
  thermal age, missing sample, and unresolved debt choose the conservative
  lower capacity and never decay debt silently. Freeze reservation plus
  certified in-flight worst case plus non-borrowable recovery reserve within
  the conservative lower bound. Hysteresis, minimum dwell, cooldown, and
  anti-windup are exact tested contract values. Move the DeviceTest caller to
  this composition and delete `BASThermalTwinFeed`; a second feed/composition
  or constructor is a release failure.

  `AdaptiveRuntimeCore`, effort/surprise, SSM neuromodulation, and the Apple
  adaptive adapter consume only the canonical K1 snapshot. After Attempt
  freeze they may request `min(currentEnvelope, tighterEnvelope)`, pause,
  checkpoint, cancel, or defer; they cannot increase budget, clear debt,
  select/reselect a Provider, change plan/context, authorize an effect, or
  invent a new action. Thermal hazard and mutable predictive/plasticity/BCM/
  hierarchical/Mamba behavior remain lab/shadow candidates. All dispositions
  equal the W0 census root.

### Payload 6E (W4) — Elect an admitted Pareto path

  `BASExecutionPlanElector` chooses only among fully compatible, already
  verified plans under quality, latency, memory, energy, thermal, network,
  monetary, privacy/egress, retention, and safety budgets. Binding is staged
  and monotonic rather than guessed at admission:

  1. admission freezes only facts already known; it does not predict a future
     snapshot, context descriptor, or plan;
  2. K3 attaches exactly one semantic snapshot after it exists;
  3. W4 atomically attaches one Provider branch policy plus the one execution
     binding that references it—never a half pair;
  4. each causal branch materializes a plan only after its inputs exist; the
     terminal-decode plan is impossible before durable current R6 and compiled
     context;
  5. immediately before allocation, freeze Provider/model/material,
     checkpoint/quant/MTP, tokenizer/template/State ABI, exact context
     fingerprint, load/prefill/cache/decode/memory projections, device/runtime,
     and quality/safety/egress/retention facts.

  Pre-allocation fallback requires a signed exact-compatible edge and renewed
  resource feasibility. Once K3 allocates a branch, route and plan are
  immutable. Preserve one complete physical chain:
  capability evidence → plan election → frozen Plan/Binding → K1 reservation
  → K3 allocate/claim → `executeAtMostOnce` →
  `BASOrganAdapter.executePlanned` → typed load/prefill/cache/decode receipts →
  K3 terminal seal → L10/L11/L14 release. Retire the Provider-array execution
  path, decode-only actuation, and descriptive load/prefill/cache axes through
  the original Silicon Task-7 owners/gates. The Prefill Router has only
  certified full prefill, suffix continuation, exact prefix cache, and context
  rebuild modes. Plain decode, prompt lookup/suffix continuation, certified
  draft/speculation, and native MTP are separate certified decode candidates;
  no name/marketing match proves support.

  An unavailable or failed Provider ends the current Attempt with a typed
  disposition. A fallback never swaps Qwen/PCC/API/model material inside that
  Attempt; it creates a successor Attempt with fresh admission, currentness,
  capability-use, profile, context compilation, budget, and lineage receipts.
  The successor records why the prior path became ineligible while preserving
  only immutable Task and source lineage.

  Before that successor, every old Provider, recovery, effect, visibility,
  publication, and related boundary for the same WorkUnit must carry its
  canonical owner-typed terminal/denial evidence or reopened K3 proof that it
  authoritatively never crossed possible-start. Any possible-start, unknown,
  indeterminate, or reconciliation-required state permits only resume/query/
  reconcile/quarantine under the original identity and blocks replacement.
  Same-Attempt multi-Provider fallback is forbidden.

  MTP is enabled only when the exact loaded model material and provider implementation prove compatibility; model marketing/name matching is insufficient.

  W4 also implements the W1 checkpoint values through the incumbent owners.
  `BASContinuationRoute` is exactly `recompileFromAcceptedPrefix` or
  `accelerateWithVerifiedKV`; the latter is eligible only when
  `BASProviderCheckpointMaterializer` reopens exact model/profile/material,
  tokenizer/template/StateABI, sampler/RNG, Attempt, accepted-token/output
  prefix and `recovery72Hours` receipt. FP16 KV is a verified acceleration
  image. Q4/lossy KV, MTP drafts, hidden reasoning and unaccepted generated
  tokens are never truth. PCC has no checkpoint materializer because its
  hidden state is unavailable.

  “Full-blood” means the exact selected material identity. Quantized, pruned,
  distilled, speculative, and MTP-enabled variants are separate profiles with
  separate quality/safety/device evidence; none may silently replace another
  to preserve latency or throughput.

### Payload 6F (W4) — Stress independent windows and interruption manifests

  Run at least eight logical windows with different model context limits and concurrent Sub-Agent branches. Verify:

  - no KV/context/cache identity crossing;
  - bounded memory and fair resource admission;
  - independent cancellation;
  - deterministic snapshot roots;
  - interruption produces a continuity manifest, not a serialized live stack;
  - resume recompiles against current state.

  PCC pre-handoff stress uses distinct Attempts, Capsules, accounting,
  idempotency identities and sessions. Default concurrency is one; an
  evidence-bound experimental maximum of two remains a resource-profile
  choice, never a fixed swarm or voting quorum. This W4 slice cannot reference
  W5 handoff/respond markers; it tests only profile/context/accounting and
  private-state isolation before possible-start.

  W4 may instantiate `PrivateCloudComputeLanguageModel` only as a typed,
  no-respond preflight mechanism. It records exact `availability` including
  `.available` or `.unavailable(.deviceNotEligible|.systemNotReady)`, exact
  `quotaUsage.status(.belowLimit|.limitReached)`, asynchronous `contextSize`,
  `supportedLanguages`, `supportsLocale`, and advertised vision,
  guided-generation, reasoning and tool-calling capabilities under the
  current iPhone/OS/profile evidence, then derives a conservative remote
  envelope. The production invocation remains disabled until W5. No session,
  response call, handoff marker or possible-start edge is legal in W4, and
  AFM remains only a negative compatibility fixture.

  In the same W4 slice, fault the canonical K1 composition across monotonic
  phase changes, process death, wall-clock rollback/forward jump, reboot,
  stale/negative-age thermal samples, hysteresis/dwell/cooldown, cancellation,
  and anti-windup. Prove object identity through QinaoLifecycle, LeaseLife,
  Lung, and ThermalTwin; one conservative envelope; no debt decay on restart;
  no second feed; and every adaptive/effort/SSM request is monotonic
  tightening after freeze. Mutation tests attempt budget increase, Provider
  reselection, plan/context change, direct state/effect authorization, and a
  lab-only mechanism activation and require rejection.

  Reuse the W1-frozen `BASNextQuestionProjection` path: it is computed
  only after final authorization, is transient and non-learning, performs no
  retrieval/model/tool/effect work before a tap, and a tap starts a distinct
  Attempt through current admission rather than mutating the completed Attempt.

  The approved-history W4 path list additionally modifies
  `BehavioralAISubstrate/Sources/BASRuntimeCore/BASCoreMLConversionContract.swift`,
  `BehavioralAISubstrate/Sources/BASAppleAdapters/BASCoreAIContextClassifierAdapter.swift`,
  `BehavioralAISubstrate/Package.swift`, and the hermetic development-host
  conversion/certification recipe; it creates `BASPCCContextAccountingTests.swift`
  and `BASCoreAIConversionContractTests.swift`. These suites are a distinct
  non-vacuous gate:

  `validateCertifiedContextGeometry` checks the tagged Provider profile,
  topology, accounting proof, reserves and hard per-field caps before plan

### Payload 6G (W4) — Admit and install the exact W4 candidate commit

Before admission, the W4 controller reopens the unchanged W0-admitted
`run_nonempty_xcode_test.py` Git blob and its W1-tested dual-mode contract, plus
the signed Xcode-27/iOS-27 SDK and the exact installed W1 rows
`w1.tool.xcodebuild27`, `w1.tool.xcresulttool27`, and
`w1.input.ios27-simulator`. Their stable-opened/current broker projections are
exactly `$QINAO_BOUND_XCODEBUILD_EXECUTABLE`,
`$QINAO_BOUND_XCRESULTTOOL_EXECUTABLE`, and
`$QINAO_W4_IOS27_SIMULATOR_DESTINATION`; the Wave CLI may supply none of them.
The broker also
creates fresh unique repository-external DerivedData/result-bundle roots.
After staging the exact W4 path list, the controller requires the tracked
working bytes to equal the index, requires zero untracked row beneath the
project/package source roots, and records the index tree before the project
test. Project mode must build the `BASDeviceTestApp` host while executing
exactly the required non-skipped `BASDeviceTests/BASCognitiveBrainProbabilityDistributionTests/testAppleClassifierFactoryUsesOneClassifierForBothPresetsAndProbabilitySideChannel`
case and no extra case, so an import, nominal-result, factory ABI,
package-product or Endurance caller error cannot enter W4 merely because the
SwiftPM packages passed. The same equality is rechecked after the runner; an
Xcode project/source mutation, repository-local output, tree change, zero-test
result or second test target blocks admission. This simulator compile/test is
the W4 caller-integrity gate, not a substitute for W6's governed physical-device

**Attempt-rebase K4 lifecycle:** the existing
`sovereign.k4-durable-lifecycle` owner extends only
`BehavioralAISubstrate/Sources/BASSovereign/BASSovereignTokenAuthority.swift`
and its incumbent ledger storage. No rebase-specific authority, store, helper
process, or grant family is introduced:

```swift
extension BASSovereignTokenAuthority {
    public func reserveAttemptRebaseGrant(
        _ request: BASAttemptRebaseGrantReservationRequest
    ) async throws -> BASAttemptRebaseGrantReservationReceipt

    public func activateAttemptRebaseGrant(
        _ request: BASAttemptRebaseGrantActivationRequest
    ) async throws -> BASAttemptRebaseGrantActivationOutcome

    public func reopenAttemptRebaseGrantStatus(
        _ request: BASAttemptRebaseGrantStatusRequest
    ) async throws -> BASAttemptRebaseGrantActivationOutcome
}
```

The strict W5 values bind the W1 request digest, predecessor/successor
Attempts and generations, expected old head, W2 pending root/watermark,
authorization basis and warrant, predecessor and fresh grant Artifact IDs,
rights subset, reduced ceiling vector, same boot, non-extended deadline, and
all key/warrant/policy/deletion/revocation epochs. The reservation receipt is
self-ID-free and its helper-private row is reserved-inactive and
non-consumable. Activation requires the signed winning
`BASAttemptRebaseReceipt` and covered K3 root. The closed
`BASAttemptRebaseGrantActivationOutcome` is exactly `usable` with an activation
receipt and status evidence, `activationPending` with current status evidence,
or `terminalDenied` with a durable denial fence; every case binds the same
reservation receipt Artifact ID. The same request ID with changed canonical
bytes is corruption. `BASK4AuthorizationLedgerTests.swift` faults reservation,
reply, K3-CAS coverage, activation, status reopen, revocation, expiry,
quarantine and denial-fence boundaries and proves one fresh grant, no
pre-activation use, no replacement after denial, and byte-identical recovery.

All five values use explicit `CodingKeys`, reject unknown/missing/duplicate or
