**Inspection interface:**

The exact values were frozen by the one W1 literal declaration above. W5
implements behavior against that imported value and MUST NOT copy, typealias,
redeclare, widen, or shadow it. Its compile sentinel is intentionally only a
consumer:

```swift
package func requireFrozenW1InspectionWire(
    _ request: BASAutomationInspectionRequest
) -> BASAutomationInspectionOperation {
    request.operation
}
```

No mutation operation exists in this enum.
The request and operation values live in
`BASLowEntropyPrimitives.swift`; K4 reuses the existing
`BASCapabilityGrant` and capability-use lifecycle rather than defining an
inspection-specific grant.

**Apple effect adapter reuse:**

The original Sovereign Task 5 first-governs the sole concrete Apple edge as
`BehavioralAISubstrate/Sources/BASAppleEdgeWiring/BASToolEffectAdapter.swift`.
This W5 slice reopens and extends that exact adapter; it does not redeclare its
shape, create a `ZoneCAppleEffectExecutor`, or add an Apple-framework
dependency to the generic `BASEffectBroker` target. `BASEffectBroker` may call
the incumbent `BASEffectAdapter` seam only after reopening the exact K3 outbox
claim, K4 permit/use, L13 prepare, L14 authorization, boundary anchor/arm,
operation-group identity, parameters digest, currentness epochs and
idempotency key. `BASToolEffectAdapter` translates and queries the existing
`BASToolDispatcher`; it owns no store, policy, retry, permit, receipt factory
or semantic state and is unreachable from UI, App Intents, ingress, read
adapters, models and projections. Source/dependency/call-graph tests reject a
second adapter/executor and any direct production dispatcher call. The
incumbent `BASToolCallingPlanner` and `BASLLMExtractionEngine` become
proposal/defer-only: neither retains a dispatcher nor calls `dispatch`,
`dispatchBatch`, a registered handler or a compatibility wrapper. The
Swift-aware inventory rejects every production reference to
`BASToolDispatcher` outside `BASToolEffectAdapter.swift` and the dispatcher
implementation itself, including batch calls and aliased/member-reference
forms.
The same atomic manifest edit applies the original direct dependency closure:
`BASEffectBroker` depends only on `BASRuntimeCore` plus `BASOrgan`, while
`BASAppleEdgeWiring` depends directly on `BASEffectBroker` plus `BASOrgan` in
addition to its incumbent edges. The bounded web handler and tool adapter
import `BASOrgan` through that direct edge; a transitive HostKit/AppleAdapters
import or a reverse broker-to-Apple dependency fails the gate.

The adapter exposes only an immutable implementation descriptor and bounded
capabilities. It never owns or reports an operation-specific
`BASEffectAdapterProfile`: `BASEffectBroker` derives and persists that profile
from the reopened effect request, invocation and signed Release map. Production
composition builds one startup-time, duplicate-rejecting immutable
`BASToolDispatcher` handler map and binds its canonical implementation digest
into that Release map. Late `register`/`unregister` exists only in a
compile-isolated test fixture. The incumbent handler/dispatcher seam is
extended in place with typed `query`, `compensate` and `unsupported`
observations keyed by the same reopened invocation, tool identity, frozen
profile and idempotency identity; a naked idempotency key is insufficient.
Unsupported query maps to `indeterminate` under that same effect identity and
never calls `handle`, `dispatch` or `dispatchBatch`. Each member of a proposed
batch obtains its own K3 ordinal, L14/K4 proof and boundary arm; `dispatchBatch`
is not a production effect shortcut.

Explicit Persona research uses one narrow
`BASBoundedWebSourceToolHandler` in the same Apple edge ring, not a Provider or

allowlists host plus port before connect and after DNS resolution, rejects
literal/private/link-local/loopback/reserved addresses and rebinding, disables

It returns only untrusted source bytes plus URL/transport/content provenance
through the existing governed `BASPersistedToolResultPayload`; its canonical

The persisted tool-result parent is the source Artifact—no new source payload
or Store is created. The transport verifies the actually connected endpoint,

active Attempt or release an answer. The one W4-created
`BASCoreAIRosterComposition` factory is reopened as the sole Apple-edge

binds the map's implementation digest into the existing signed Release map;
no second composition seam is allowed. The existing Persona effect sentinel exercises
redirect, DNS/IP, timeout, truncation, content-type, cancellation and crash-cut
faults and proves a non-empty production registration/call graph before its
output can feed a later Attempt.

### Payload 7A — Write RED tests for the inspection membrane

  Prove:

  - Host-level listing reveals only safe user-owned scope summaries;
  - opening details requires an exact per-scope grant;
  - wrong caller, App Agent, destination, purpose, field mask, budget, snapshot, or epoch fails;
  - currentness is checked before and after materialization;
  - an A→B read share does not authorize B learning, embedding/cache retrieval, model selection, export, re-share, or cutover;
  - derived grants are the intersection of source grants;
  - untrusted retrieved/tool/model content remains data and cannot restate a
    grant, capability-use receipt, caller identity, permit, or publication/
    effect command;
  - prompts, inspection outputs, spools, errors, and boundary receipts contain
    no raw credential or live secret handle;
  - there is no run/retry/cancel/pause/edit/delete/grant/share/export operation.

### Payload 7D — Implement the broker-to-Zone-C boundary

  Reopen and extend the original Sovereign Tasks 1/4/5 machines; do not
  generalize them into one “side-effect pipeline.” The three sibling terminal
  paths retain distinct identities, receipts, writers, and possible-start
  boundaries. First prove the exact state path:

  ```text
  verified proposal
  -> L10 verification
  -> L11 risk/disclosure/confirmation
  -> L13 exact prepare + read set
  -> K3 prepare + invisible stage
  -> L14 terminal-seal authorization
  -> K4 claim/use + signature/attestation
  -> K3 seal
  -> K3 activate
  ```

  Then implement the exact effect path:

  ```text
  tool/effect proposal
  -> L10 claim and argument verification
  -> L11 risk/disclosure/confirmation
  -> L13 causal predecessor + exact prepare
  -> K3 prepareAndEnqueue + durable outbox
  -> L14 exact authorization
  -> K3 handed_to_zone_c
  -> Zone-C dispatch_pending
  -> K4 claim/use
  -> Zone-C dispatch_ready
  -> K3 effect_permit_pending
  -> K4 anchor
  -> K3 effect_boundary_possible arm
  -> one Zone-C dispatch_boundary_armed winner
  -> exactly one existing BASToolEffectAdapter/BASToolDispatcher call
  -> terminal observation or owner-typed indeterminate
  -> query/reconcile under the same effect identity
  -> optional separately admitted State Commit
  ```

  The broker/adapter edge owns no policy, retry authority, independent store, semantic
  state, or state-commit shortcut. A lost reply, owner death, cancellation, or
  any possibly crossed boundary enters query/reconciliation for the same
  effect identity. `dispatch_pending`, `dispatch_ready`,
  `effect_permit_pending`, `effect_boundary_possible`, and
  `dispatch_boundary_armed` are non-interchangeable; no later Attempt may
  replace the operation until its owner proves terminal/denied/never-start.

### Payload 7E — Add publication protection

  Automation and interactive output use this exact publication path:

  ```text
  neutral verified content
  -> L12 persona/presentation + exact spool
  -> L10 verifies the same spooled bytes, including post-style invariants
  -> L11 risk/disclosure/currentness
  -> L14 exact grant + authorization context
  -> L12 release preparation
  -> K3 local prepared + pre-publication manifest
  -> publication journal reserved
  -> K3 publication_permit_pending
  -> K4 claim/use/anchor
  -> K3 sink_boundary_armed
  -> exactly one sink query/release
  -> final receipt or publication_indeterminate
  ```

  A run cannot publish twice, publish after invalidation/deletion, treat
  Provider completion as release, regenerate bytes after spool, or substitute
  an effect/state identity. Possible-start/unknown publication remains under
  the original publication identity for query/reconcile and blocks successor
  replacement.

  with `BASChatCompletionsGovernanceTests.swift` proving that it has no raw-
  credential, caller-budget, optimistic-accounting, redirect, resend or direct-
  publication path. Its safety-critical suite is independently required:

  The one `release.spool-publication` parent extends only
  `BASExactOutputVerificationPayload.claimSupportMap`; it does not register a
  second ClaimSupport payload or transfer L10 authority. The existing adapter's

  tool execution and direct publication are denied; unknown completion enters

  second PCC session, or swap to Qwen/API. Rate limit, quota exhaustion and

  `ProviderExecutionCore.swift` arms the one possible-start boundary before

  ```bash
    --repository "$PWD" \
    --candidate-tree "$QINAO_CURRENT_CANDIDATE_TREE" \
    --candidate-commit "$QINAO_CURRENT_CANDIDATE_COMMIT" \
    --target-ref-name "$QINAO_CURRENT_TARGET_REF" \
    --prepared-ref-name "$QINAO_CURRENT_PREPARED_REF" \
    --trust-root "$QINAO_ADMISSION_TRUST_ROOT" \
    --external-prerequisite "k4-ios27-platform-spike=$QINAO_K4_IOS27_PLATFORM_SPIKE" \
    --signing-provider "$QINAO_WAVE_ADMISSION_SIGNING_PROVIDER" \
    --signing-provider-sha256 "$QINAO_WAVE_ADMISSION_SIGNING_PROVIDER_SHA256" \
    --receipt "$QINAO_CURRENT_ADMISSION_RECEIPT"
  python3 scripts/run_qinao_wave_admission.py verify-receipt \
    --git-executable "$QINAO_GIT_EXECUTABLE" \
    --root "$PWD" \
    --bundle "$QINAO_CURRENT_WAVE_BUNDLE" \
    --source-selection "$QINAO_SOURCE_SELECTION" \
    --trust-root "$QINAO_ADMISSION_TRUST_ROOT" \
    --previous-receipt "$QINAO_PREVIOUS_ADMISSION_RECEIPT" \
    --candidate-tree "$QINAO_CURRENT_CANDIDATE_TREE" \
    --candidate-commit "$QINAO_CURRENT_CANDIDATE_COMMIT" \
    --target-ref-name "$QINAO_CURRENT_TARGET_REF" \
    --prepared-ref-name "$QINAO_CURRENT_PREPARED_REF" \
    --external-prerequisite "k4-ios27-platform-spike=$QINAO_K4_IOS27_PLATFORM_SPIKE" \
    --receipt "$QINAO_CURRENT_ADMISSION_RECEIPT"
  "$QINAO_GIT_EXECUTABLE" diff --check
  test "$("$QINAO_GIT_EXECUTABLE" rev-parse "$QINAO_CURRENT_TARGET_REF^{commit}")" = \
    "$QINAO_CURRENT_CANDIDATE_COMMIT"
  test "$("$QINAO_GIT_EXECUTABLE" rev-parse "$QINAO_CURRENT_TARGET_REF^{tree}")" = \
    "$QINAO_CURRENT_CANDIDATE_TREE"
  test "$("$QINAO_GIT_EXECUTABLE" rev-parse HEAD)" = "$QINAO_CURRENT_CANDIDATE_COMMIT"
  test -z "$("$QINAO_GIT_EXECUTABLE" for-each-ref --format='%(refname)' "$QINAO_CURRENT_PREPARED_REF")"
  "$QINAO_GIT_EXECUTABLE" diff --cached --check
  test -z "$("$QINAO_GIT_EXECUTABLE" status --porcelain)"
  ```

**Runtime composition seam:**

```swift
public enum BASAutomationRecurrenceEvaluator {
    public static func nextLogicalFires(
        _ request: BASAutomationRecurrenceRequest
    ) throws -> [BASAutomationLogicalFireProposal]
}

extension BASTurnRuntimeEngine {
    public func runAutomation(
        _ request: BASAutomationRunRequest
    ) async -> BASAutomationRunOutcome

    public func resumeAutomation(
        _ request: BASAutomationResumeRequest
    ) async -> BASAutomationRunOutcome

    package func requestBackgroundOpportunity(
        _ request: BASGovernedBackgroundOpportunityRequest
    ) async -> BASBackgroundOpportunityReceipt
}
```

The recurrence evaluator is pure, bounded, deterministic, and clock-input driven. It cannot commit a cursor, allocate a WorkUnit, schedule a BGTask, or grant execution. `runAutomation` and `resumeAutomation` reuse the existing turn operation, semantic DAG, Provider, state, publication, effect, and receipt paths.

Both methods and their package-scoped
`BASGovernedAutomationOperationDependencies` seam live in
`BASTurnRuntimeEngine.swift`, where the incumbent engine state is available.
No cross-file extension reaches `private` engine members, no new engine object
is created, and the dependency bundle contains the same class-bound K3
instance, Artifact ports, sole context compiler, publication/effect ports, and
ordinary turn admission seam already used by interactive work.
`BASGovernedBackgroundOpportunityRequest` binds run/Attempt, exact K3/L14
admission receipt, purpose, `regularProcessing|continuedProcessing`,
`submit|cancel`, signed target-capability-profile digest, the exact registered
identifier family and concrete identifier, requested resource class, expiry,
and all currentness epochs. In the W6 lab profile, regular-processing
identifiers must equal `bas.sleep.consolidation` and continued-processing
submit identifiers must be concrete members of
`com.changgeng.basdevicetest.consolidation.*`; no production profile is
inferred from those lab values. Cancel must bind the exact previously accepted
platform request identity. A target/profile/kind/operation/identifier mismatch
fails closed before touching `BGTaskScheduler`.
`BASBackgroundOpportunityReceipt` records accepted/rejected/unavailable,
platform request identity, observation time, and the explicit fact that
acceptance proves no start/completion timing.

Before behavior is added, preserve the controlled W6 receipt order exactly:

1. Runtime Task 2 observation-value-only prelude.
2. Semantic Task 8 audit-value/schema-only prelude, including the first
   governed `BASRuntimeAuditProjectionsBundle` `1.0.0`; no behavior or `put`.
3. Runtime Task 1B freezes the sole `BASSameRunAuditOutcome` and final
   `BASTurnRuntimeAuditEnvelope` `1.0.0`.
4. Semantic Task 8 adds coordinator outcome behavior.
5. Runtime Tasks 2/3/4/5 populate the already frozen values.
6. Runtime Task 7 performs the authoritative engine same-run outcome cutover.

The external chain's schema discriminator is exactly
`QinaoW6RuntimeReceiptChainV2`; both `sign-runtime-chain` and
`verify-runtime-chain` reject V1, unknown, mixed-entry, or digest-only input.
`verify-runtime-chain` requires both `--expected-head-commit` and
`--expected-head-tree`; neither may be inferred from the other or omitted.
It binds six ordered entries
with exact slice IDs and sequence ordinals:

1. `w6.runtime.observation-values`, `sequenceOrdinal = 1`;
2. `w6.semantic.audit-schema`, `sequenceOrdinal = 2`;
3. `w6.runtime.audit-envelope-freeze`, `sequenceOrdinal = 3`;
4. `w6.semantic.coordinator-behavior`, `sequenceOrdinal = 4`;
5. `w6.runtime.integration-population`, `sequenceOrdinal = 5`;
6. `w6.runtime.engine-cutover`, `sequenceOrdinal = 6`.

Each entry binds its own signed wave-admission receipt blob, base/candidate
commits and trees, target-ref installation terminal, required predecessor
receipt, path-list/category blobs, and frozen schema digests. More precisely,
each entry contains the complete canonical
signed `QinaoWaveAdmissionReceiptV2` object as `receipt`, plus
`receiptDigest = SHA256(RFC8785(receipt))`; the digest, embedded object,
sequence fields, and signed fields must agree. `sign-runtime-chain` opens,
canonicalizes, signature-verifies, and embeds the six supplied receipt files;
it never emits digest-only entries. Each slice prepares its candidate commit
before bundle review; the controller then installs that exact commit, and the
next slice's base commit/tree is the prior installation terminal. The sixth bundle
binds and verifies the first five receipts plus its own expected
slice/schema/path roots. After its installed target-ref commit/tree equals
receipt six, the pinned
external verifier independently verifies all six receipts and asks only the protected
`runtime-chain-signer` provider to sign the six-entry
`$QINAO_W6_RUNTIME_RECEIPT_CHAIN`. The following Apple bundle uses receipt 06
as its immediate predecessor and additionally binds the verified chain digest.
The chain verifies the exact `1.0.0`
`BASRuntimeAuditProjectionsBundle`, `BASSameRunAuditOutcome`, and
`BASTurnRuntimeAuditEnvelope` schema digests. No later slice may reorder,
skip, refreeze, or silently widen those wire values. W3-state/W3-context and
the W6 runtime/Apple/certification macro slices use the same
`waveSliceID`/`sequenceOrdinal` predecessor rule. The Apple lab slice is W6
ordinal 7 and final certification is W6 ordinal 8.

For every adjacent pair, verification requires both:

```text
receipt[i].targetRefInstallation.installedCommit
  == receipt[i + 1].baseCommit
receipt[i].targetRefInstallation.installedTree
  == receipt[i + 1].baseTree
```

The chain head is receipt 06's installed commit/tree. Same-tree/different-
commit substitution, a receipt candidate tree without a passing installation
terminal, or a target ref that no longer names the head commit fails.

**Approved-history atomic-rebase runtime seam:** W1 owns only the immutable
`BASContextRebaseRequest`/continuity references; W2 owns `rebase_pending`, the
active-head CAS and `BASAttemptRebaseReceipt`; W5 owns the reserved-inactive
grant row, `BASAttemptRebaseGrantReservationReceipt`, activation/status lookup
and denial fence. Only after all three predecessors are admitted does W6
compose them. The composition remains in existing owner
`runtime.semantic-executor`, declaration path
`BehavioralAISubstrate/Sources/BASHostKit/BASTurnRuntimeEngine.swift`, and
owning actor `BASTurnRuntimeEngine`:

```swift
public enum BASAtomicContextRebaseActivation: Sendable, Equatable {
    case usable(
        reservationReceiptArtifactID: BASArtifactID,
        activationReceiptArtifactID: BASArtifactID,
        grantStatusArtifactID: BASArtifactID
    )
    case activationPending(
        reservationReceiptArtifactID: BASArtifactID,
        statusEvidenceArtifactID: BASArtifactID
    )
    case terminalDenied(
        reservationReceiptArtifactID: BASArtifactID,
        denialFenceArtifactID: BASArtifactID
    )
}

public struct BASAtomicContextRebaseResult: Sendable, Equatable {
    public let k3Receipt: BASAttemptRebaseReceipt
    public let activation: BASAtomicContextRebaseActivation
}

extension BASTurnRuntimeEngine {
    func performAtomicContextRebase(
        _ request: BASContextRebaseRequest
    ) async throws -> BASAtomicContextRebaseResult
}
```

The result is an ephemeral, non-Codable projection over existing K3/K4
receipts, not a fifth authority or durable wire. The actor's already-injected
K3/K4 facets are its only mechanisms; the request carries no store, broker,
closure or ambient capability. “Atomic” names the single active-head invariant,
not a fictional cross-store transaction: K3 pending → K4 reserve-inactive → K3
active-head CAS → K4 activation/status is a crash-recoverable saga. Replay submits only the
byte-identical reservation/CAS/activation request, returns all three honest
outcomes `usable | activationPending | terminalDenied`, never rolls the head
back and never permits two active Attempts or usable successor grants.

The K3 pending → K4 reservation → K3 CAS → K4 activation evidence matrix is exact:
`usable` carries reservation, winning K3, activation and usable-status
evidence; `activationPending` carries reservation, winning K3 and current
unknown-status evidence; `terminalDenied` carries reservation, winning K3 and
the irreversible denial fence. No outcome may omit or substitute the
reservation or winning K3 receipt, and no pending/denied outcome exposes a
usable grant.

### Payload 8A — Verify the W1-frozen run reducer contracts

  Re-run the W1 wire fixture for the exact state inventory:

  ```text
  observed, admitted, denied, allocated, executing,
  waitingForConfirmation, waitingForNetwork, waitingForModel, waitingForTool,
  checkpointed, cancelRequested, reconciling, degraded,
  succeeded, failed, cancelled, quarantined, indeterminate
  ```

  `denied`, `succeeded`, `failed`, `cancelled`, `quarantined`, and
  `indeterminate` are terminal. Context compilation is an
  Artifact/subreceipt, not a reducer state. Illegal transitions and any
  terminal outgoing edge fail. W6 implements the frozen reducer; it does not
  add, remove, rename, or recode a state.

  Compose bounded RSI only through the incumbent
  `BASTurnRuntimeEngine.executeSemanticTopology`,
  `BASNativeStageExecutor.executeSemanticInvocation`, and
  `BASParallelStageDispatchExecutor.dispatchSemanticBatch` seams. Each remand
  is one predeclared acyclic child whose immutable DAG node references the W1
  obligation/envelope/progress/terminal Artifacts. Before continuing, runtime
  reopens the current Attempt and calls the one W2 K3 `claimBudgetUse`; it
  cannot maintain a local counter or visited set. A newly won/recovered use
  receipt, new canonical digest, and phase-valid strict witness are all
  required. Replay proves identical termination for repeated digest,
  A↔B cycle, missing/false witness, stale epoch, illegal remand, no progress,
  deadline, and budget exhaustion. Only the exact adoptable converged pair may
  feed downstream state/publication/effect; every other pair remains typed
  proposal/remand/disclosure evidence.

### Payload 8B — Implement pure recurrence evaluation

  Cover fixed and follow-device time zones, exact calendars, DST gaps/folds, travel, clock correction, shutdown/offline windows, `skip`, `runLatest`, and bounded backfill.

  The result is a proposal only. General scheduled execution remains feature-disabled until Payload 8C and all device-affinity tests pass.

### Payload 8C — Claim each logical fire through K3 then L14

  The bound execution device/authority domain performs expected-cursor CAS once. The winning cursor disposition still grants no execution; ordinary L14 admission must create the WorkUnit/Attempt.

  V1 binds each Automation version to the one admitted local device identity.
  Concurrent duplicate delivery returns the prior disposition and any other or
  offline device cannot win. Affinity transfer returns
  `disabledMissingOwner`; no lease, move, expiry, or multi-device active
  execution algorithm is implemented until a separate controlled design and
  non-empty CreateGate admit a linearizable owner.

### Payload 8D — Implement overlap and bounded concurrency

  Enforce `skipWhileRunning`, `queueOne`, and `boundedParallel(n)` through K3 rows and ordinary resource admission. No in-memory queue becomes recovery truth.

### Payload 8E — Implement checkpoint and resume

  A checkpoint contains immutable references to:

  - Workspace/Automation/version/WorkUnit/Attempt/branch;
  - the whole-task → large-task → small-task → solution decomposition through
    Mission/Objective/WorkUnit/Attempt/SolutionArtifact identities;
  - semantic DAG and completed node receipts;
  - accepted evidence and the still-unresolved obligation set, with exact
    completion predicates and child terminal heads;
  - K3 head and invalidation/policy/consent/deletion/revocation epochs;
  - exact context/snapshot/material/profile refs;
  - remaining budget and rights;
  - the four independently typed Provider, effect, publication, and state
    boundary states/receipt refs; no collapsed generic “in flight” bit;
  - current/day/week/month projection references as views, never copied state;
  - one `contextContinuityManifestArtifactID` and its nested
    `WorkUnitRecoveryCursor` digest.

  `ContextContinuityManifest` remains the W1 first-governed
  `state.snapshot-contracts` value whose exact wire is frozen above from the
  controlled 2026-07-19 semantics. Its cursor references each
  nonterminal Provider/effect/publication boundary owner and the W1-bound
  L11/L14 `ContinuationPolicy` receipt; the automation checkpoint does not
  copy those mutable states or invent a recovery policy. Resume reopens the
  manifest and each owner receipt, then applies the exact
  `BASWorkUnitRecoveryDisposition` matrix.

  Resume reopens all references and currentness, reconciles any possibly crossed boundary, and recompiles context. It never restores a Swift task stack, closure, thread, raw prompt, shared KV, or ambient handle.

  Durable command recovery composes incumbent identities rather than adding a
  `CommandStore`: stable `BASToolInvocation.invocationID`, exact argument and
  material digest, capability-use receipt, checkpoint generation and
  `BASWorkUnitRecoveryDisposition`, plus the mapped
  `BASEffectAdapter.query` result.
  `notStarted` may create a fresh authorized invocation only when the owner
  proves possible-start was never crossed; `startedOrUnknown` permits query/
  reconcile only; terminal reopens the exact result. Changed arguments under
  one invocation ID, a copied “retryable” flag, or missing query support cannot
  start another command.

  Reopen also verifies the W2 checkpoint-install receipt's exact
  `recovery72Hours` admission receipt, trusted commit, finite minimum/maximum,
  current authorization and erasure domain. Before the minimum, routine or
  terminal pruning is forbidden. At or after the finite maximum, structured
  receipts remain replayable but exact content returns `contentExpired`; the
  runtime starts a successor Attempt, rematerializes, recompiles and
  revalidates rather than stretching the window. This recovery horizon cannot
  authorize `eligibleLearning72Hours` learning/pruning or create long-term
  memory.

### Payload 8F — Implement cancellation, steering, and reconciliation

  Pre-boundary cancellation closes only after every child acknowledges and no boundary may have crossed. Otherwise it enters `reconciling`; only authenticated terminal evidence may decide continuation or a terminal result. A successor is a new Attempt after the prior Attempt becomes terminal.

  User steering is a new normalized Input Event with its own identity,
  currentness, purpose, and causal links. It requests cancellation or
  supersession of affected branches, waits for their legal terminal or
  reconciliation state, and then allocates a successor Attempt. It never edits
  the old prompt, hidden reasoning, Provider Attempt, checkpoint, or committed
  event bytes in place.

  Fault tests interrupt before and after Artifact put, K3 checkpoint CAS,
  Provider claim/handoff/observation, tool/effect/publication prepare and
  terminal receipt, process termination, device restart, network loss, and
  signer unavailability. Each result is all-old, complete all-new, query-only
  reconciliation, or a fresh successor Attempt; no test may observe duplicate
  Provider dispatch, state write, effect, publication, budget debit, or
  terminal outcome.

### Payload 8G — Prove zero-effect recipe validation

  Human-, UI-, importer-, tool-, rule-, search-, classic-ML-, and model-authored
  Automation recipes all enter as the same signed structured Proposal and use
  canonicalization, schema/capability/data-flow/injection checks, bounded
  fixtures, dry-run, shadow comparison, user-visible semantic/permission diff,
  and approval. Natural language is an optional upstream producer only; its
  absence cannot block direct structured-definition submission.

  A skill is a signed declarative composition of preinstalled capabilities.
  It cannot contain, download, generate for execution, JIT, or invoke dynamic
  Swift, Rust, C, C++, Metal, Python, shell, JavaScript, or another executable
  payload on iOS. Script/code text may be inert user content only and cannot
  become executable authority through a model proposal.

  Pre-approval runs use synthetic/recorded inputs and inert effect simulators. The receipt must prove zero production K3 mutation, zero Zone-C dispatch, zero network/Apple mutation, and zero final publication. A new skill/prompt/schema/package goes through runtime certification and production cutover, never runtime-state activation.

  Run the same proof over every one of the exact ten W0 adaptive/biomimetic

  ```bash
  "$QINAO_EXTERNAL_ADMISSION_VERIFIER" verify-runtime-chain \
    --chain "$QINAO_W6_RUNTIME_RECEIPT_CHAIN" \
    --repository "$PWD" \
    --trust-root "$QINAO_ADMISSION_TRUST_ROOT" \
    --expected-head-commit "$QINAO_W6_COMMIT_06" \
    --expected-head-tree "$QINAO_W6_TREE_06"
  ```

  Update to the iOS 27 API shape proven by the installed SDK, including async
  submission where required. Preserve the incumbent regular-processing
  identifier `bas.sleep.consolidation`; it is not a continued-processing
  wildcard and must not be renamed or silently removed. In
  `BASDeviceTestApp.init`, before launch completion, register both the regular
  launch handler for `bas.sleep.consolidation` and the exact continued-
  processing lab identifier family produced for bundle
  `com.changgeng.basdevicetest` and context `consolidation`. The exact
  `BGTaskSchedulerPermittedIdentifiers` set in both `project.yml` and the
  checked-in `Resources/Info.plist` is:

  1. `bas.sleep.consolidation`;
  2. `com.changgeng.basdevicetest.consolidation.*`.

  The exact `UIBackgroundModes` array in both `project.yml` and the checked-in

  `disabledMissingConfiguration`; a permitted identifier alone is

### Payload 9C — Write RED tests for thin ingress, read gateways, and snapshots

  `AppleSurfaceIngressAdapter` may parse/minimize/validate platform values and build the incumbent `BASEntryIntentEnvelope`. It cannot rank, authorize, persist, retry, schedule semantic work, call a Provider, or execute an effect.

  All surface policy decisions come from the exact L5 Host Constitution value
  or its signed decision reference. No `AppleSurfaceIngressPolicy` type/file
  exists. `AppleReadGateway` accepts only an authorized typed read request,
  reopens its grant and current epochs, minimizes the result, and returns a
  signed snapshot/reference. It owns no cache, projection, policy, write,
  CloudKit callback, Provider, or effect port.

  `AppleSurfaceSnapshot` contains only signed, minimized, purpose-specific fields suitable for a separate/locked process. It cannot contain raw K3/memory/Artifact/Provider ports, private App Agent Self, prompt bytes, secrets, or unrestricted receipts.

  Add the Apple speech front end only as a typed source for the W1 inquiry
  message envelope. `SpeechAnalyzer`/`SpeechTranscriber` output, confidence,
  timing and locale are untrusted observations; raw audio enters only the
  encrypted Artifact path with its own scope/retention/provenance. The adapter
  cannot treat a transcript as an instruction, permission, fact, memory or
  effect. Whisper may display or submit it to its own bounded Provider capsule,
  but has zero authoritative/effect reachability and cannot auto-promote.

  The same architecture gate inventories Vision/VisionKit, SoundAnalysis,
  NaturalLanguage/Translation and CoreSpotlight as optional typed read/
  preprocessing/index adapters. Each remains disabled unless exact target,
  API availability, entitlement/configuration, device, privacy/disclosure,
  recovery and owner receipts pass; framework availability alone is never a
  capability grant.

  | Borrowed Apple capability | Existing typed edge | Mutation posture | Enablement proof |
  |---|---|---|---|
  | Vision/VisionKit | `AppleSurfaceIngressAdapter` typed perception input | untrusted minimized observation; zero mutation | exact owner + target/configuration + API availability + entitlement or independently proved none + iPhone/OS + privacy/disclosure + recovery/cutover receipt |
  | SpeechAnalyzer/SpeechTranscriber | `AppleSurfaceIngressAdapter` typed speech input | untrusted transcript/audio reference; zero mutation | exact owner + target/configuration + API availability + entitlement or independently proved none + iPhone/OS + privacy/disclosure + recovery/cutover receipt |
  | SoundAnalysis | `AppleSurfaceIngressAdapter` typed preprocessing input | untrusted classification observation; zero mutation | exact owner + target/configuration + API availability + entitlement or independently proved none + iPhone/OS + privacy/disclosure + recovery/cutover receipt |
  | NaturalLanguage/Translation | `AppleSurfaceIngressAdapter` typed preprocessing input; incumbent `BASNLEmbeddingProvider` is lab-only/retired unless separately admitted for the Granite role | untrusted annotation/translation; zero mutation; no implicit dense fallback | exact owner + target/configuration + API availability + entitlement or independently proved none + iPhone/OS + privacy/disclosure + recovery/cutover receipt + Release-reachability proof |
  | CoreSpotlight query | `AppleReadGateway.read` | authorized minimized read only | exact owner + target/configuration + API availability + entitlement or independently proved none + iPhone/OS + privacy/disclosure + recovery/cutover receipt |
  | CoreSpotlight index/delete | existing Zone-C `BASEffectBroker` → `BASToolEffectAdapter`/`BASToolDispatcher` | external mutation under one effect identity | exact owner + target/configuration + API availability + entitlement or independently proved none + iPhone/OS + privacy/disclosure + effect reconciliation + recovery/cutover receipt + exact concrete handler symbol + immutable handler-map/implementation digest + signed Release binding |

  No row creates an Agent, Provider, Store, policy owner, hidden framework
  fallback or direct App/ingress mutation path. CoreSpotlight query and
  index/delete deliberately occupy different authority edges.

  | open Work Space | `.foreground(.immediate)` | `[.main]` | `.requiresLocalDeviceAuthentication`; locked rejects/requests unlock | `true` | no/no |
  | open Automation Space | `.foreground(.immediate)` | `[.main]` | `.requiresLocalDeviceAuthentication`; locked rejects/requests unlock | `true` | no/no |

  | show next question | `.foreground(.immediate)` | `[.main]` | `.requiresLocalDeviceAuthentication`; locked rejects/requests unlock | `true` | no/no |

  Every Intent explicitly sets the installed iOS 27 equivalents of
  `supportedModes`, `allowedExecutionTargets = [.main]`,
  `authenticationPolicy`, `isDiscoverable`, and cancellation/undo

  `UndoableIntent`; a later controlled slice may add either only with an exact

  `openAppWhenRun`; there is no App Intent extension target in this slice.

  Because every Intent executes in `.main`,

  runtime payload passes, continuation is foreground navigation plus Input

### Payload 9G — Freeze Watch/Handoff and HealthKit exclusions

  Static fixtures reject:

  - importing archived Watch code;
  - Watch direct confirm/reject/effect/state write;
  - durable Watch queue, `transferUserInfo`, application-context, or file transfer in the initial profile;
  - broad Handoff content/KV transfer;
  - HealthKit-origin or health-derived data entering general analytics, general learning, general API Providers, CloudKit/iCloud, or cross-App-Agent sharing.

  Initial Watch request fixtures bind request identity, Workspace/App-Agent
  scope, expiry, deletion/revocation epochs, phone-side dedupe, and an
  acknowledgement. The bounded phone receipt is exactly
  `accepted|denied|status`, contains the request identity and terminal K3
  receipt reference, and `accepted` may be sent only after the iPhone
  completes `L13 prepare → K3 invisible stage → L14/K4 seal → K3 activation`.
  The Watch shows “not saved” until that phone ack arrives;
  offline loss is explicit and nonrecoverable. When a real target eventually
  exists, semantics are redacted status, process-local `ephemeral` capture over
  immediate reachability, and open-pending-review on a foreground unlocked
  iPhone.

  Every Health read fixture also binds one exact user-facing health purpose,
  the exact data-type set, destination, time/scope limits, current L5/L11/L14
  decision, and a current system-authorization observation. Purpose mismatch,
  absent/revoked/undetermined system authorization, broader type/scope, stale
  epoch, or missing disclosure fails before query. The fixtures distinguish
  `unknown/no-authorized-samples`, bind the earliest authorized date, and fail
  every write closed. No empty result is interpreted as “healthy” or “zero,”
  and the profile remains disabled.
  Handoff may carry only a Workspace/Task recovery reference; no content,
  prompt, KV, grant, or state payload crosses it.

  `assert_xcode_test_evidence.py` reopens the extracted canonical PCC
  observation and the device-lifecycle receipt and requires exact equality for
  test identity, device/profile, result-bundle root, observation digest,
  availability/quota/context/locale/capability facts, explicit PCC model,
  physical-call count and no-resend disposition. The reviewed lifecycle
  receipt cannot be handwritten independently of xcresult evidence. Its tests
  fault a missing/extra attachment, foreign case/device/profile, wrong digest,
  two physical calls, default-system-model substitution and an independently
  fabricated receipt.

  The signed device profile must identify a physical, non-simulator iPhone on
  iOS 27 and bind the destination, device-class/build, expiry, nonce, and
  signer; its device identifier stays outside Git. All evidence paths are
  unique and preflighted absent. Before the first build/test, verify active
  Xcode project/scheme/device defaults through XcodeBuildMCP. Review and commit
  the generated project diff; `project.yml` alone is not target membership or
  compile evidence.

  Required device/lab evidence:

  - build settings and deployment target;
  - compiled App Intent metadata;
  - all four named device suites discovered and nonzero;
  - actual Info/entitlements from the built product;
  - locked/unlocked behavior;
  - foreground in-process navigation behavior;
  - cancellation/expiration;
  - zero direct mutation paths;
  - no zero-test suite.

### Payload 9I — Derive the lab privacy and entitlement inventory

  Review all privacy-manifest dimensions: collected-data types and purposes,
  tracking boolean, tracking domains, and accessed API categories with exact
  Apple-listed reason codes. Create or modify
  `DeviceTestApp/Resources/PrivacyInfo.xcprivacy` only from that complete
  review; add target membership and verify the file in the built bundle. Do
  not infer reason codes from prose.

  When the signed lab archive profile is available, return to the repository
  root and run:

  ```bash
  "$QINAO_W6_PROTECTED_PYTHON" scripts/run_governed_xcode_project.py archive \
    --xcodebuild-executable "$QINAO_BOUND_XCODEBUILD_EXECUTABLE" \
  ```

  Reopen the archive only through that manifest; inspect its built privacy
  manifest, `Info.plist`, and signed entitlements and bind their digests in the
  lab inventory. Xcode 27 exposes no
  standalone command-line privacy-report generator in this environment, so
  this plan does not claim an Organizer Privacy Report from `build-for-testing`.
  If a reviewed Organizer/export report is later supplied, bind it as
  additional lab evidence; absence keeps the profile `labOnly`, never
  production-ready.

  Record an exact inventory for continued-processing GPU, App Group, APNs and
  `UIBackgroundModes`, CloudKit/iCloud, EventKit usage strings, HealthKit,
  HomeKit, and Live Activity. The admitted lab posture is: the exact two-entry
  BackgroundTasks Info set (`bas.sleep.consolidation` plus the continued-
  processing wildcard), exact `UIBackgroundModes == [processing]`, and the
  already existing increased-memory entitlement only; GPU, App Group, APNs,
  iCloud/CloudKit, EventKit,
  HealthKit, HomeKit, and Live Activity remain absent/false unless separately
  proved by a later controlled profile. The artifact is named a lab
  privacy/entitlement inventory and states `not production release evidence`.

  Locked-device App Intent behavior and continued-processing
  launch/expiration/cancellation are recorded in the signed
  `qinao-w6-apple-device-lifecycle-receipt.json` from a physical device. Fakes,
  a simulator, or unit tests cannot fill those fields. A missing or failed
  observation yields `disabledMissingDeviceProof` for that capability while
  leaving unrelated lab contracts valid.

### Payload 9J — Admit and controller-install the exact candidate commit

  The Apple wave bundle binds the exact path-list, Xcode evidence-manifest,
  build receipt, xcresult and enumeration digests, compiled App Intents
  metadata digest, built Info/entitlement digests, privacy/entitlement
  inventory, exact `[processing]` built-background-mode proof,
  device-lifecycle receipt, K4 status where applicable, and optional
  built privacy-manifest/archive digests. It names
  `$QINAO_W6_RECEIPT_06` as the immediate predecessor. Its sole
  `externalPrerequisites[]` row is named `runtime-receipt-chain`, declares
  schema `QinaoW6RuntimeReceiptChainV2`, binds the verified
  `$QINAO_W6_RUNTIME_RECEIPT_CHAIN` digest, and requires outcome `accepted`.
  All five consuming commands additionally require byte-level cross-object
  continuity: the chain's entry 06 embedded receipt and digest equal the
  canonical bytes and SHA-256 of
  `--previous-receipt "$QINAO_W6_RECEIPT_06"`; the chain head installed
  commit/tree equals that
  receipt's `targetRefInstallation`; and those same values equal the Apple
  bundle base commit/tree and current target-ref commit/tree. A different
  internally valid W6 chain fails.
  Missing physical lifecycle proof may
  produce an explicit disabled capability row, but never an `enabled` row.

  ```bash

  QINAO_CURRENT_CANDIDATE_TREE="$QINAO_W6_APPLE_CANDIDATE_TREE"
  QINAO_PREPARATION_RESULT=$(

"$QINAO_CURRENT_BASE_TREE"$'\t'"$QINAO_W6_APPLE_CANDIDATE_COMMIT"$'\t'\
"$QINAO_CURRENT_PREPARED_REF"
  test "$QINAO_CURRENT_BASE_COMMIT" = "$QINAO_W6_COMMIT_06"

    --repository "$PWD" \
    --trust-root "$QINAO_ADMISSION_TRUST_ROOT" \
  ```

**Internal-SDK certification interfaces to freeze in the incumbent owner:**

Extend the planned `BASCertificationEvidenceReference` with one closed optional
controller-retention branch. Every SDK-specific reference defined below
carries the exact Artifact ID, schema ID, stored byte length, stored SHA-256,
semantic object root, candidate-tree ID, producer owner, and currentness epoch
needed for stable reopen; an ID or digest alone is invalid. On either reference
type, the retention branch is wholly absent for ordinary evidence or contains
all of:

```text
controllerReceiptCommittedAtWallClockMillis
challengeExpiresAtWallClockMillis
retainedThroughWallClockMillis
retentionProofArtifactID
evidenceAccessGrantArtifactID?  // access only, never retention proof
```

For the present branch,
`retainedThroughWallClockMillis >= challengeExpiresAtWallClockMillis +
259200000`. The retention proof Artifact reopens the incumbent controller's
receipt and external-store identity. A capability grant may authorize bounded
read access but cannot satisfy or shorten this inequality.

Freeze one self-ID-free SDK reference value; it is an Artifact/reopen
coordinate, not a store, registry, owner, or authority:

```swift
public struct BASInternalSDKControllerRetentionReference: Codable, Sendable, Equatable {
    public let controllerReceiptCommittedAtWallClockMillis: UInt64
    public let challengeExpiresAtWallClockMillis: UInt64
    public let retainedThroughWallClockMillis: UInt64
    public let retentionProofArtifactID: BASArtifactID
    public let evidenceAccessGrantArtifactID: BASArtifactID?
}

public struct BASInternalSDKEvidenceReference: Codable, Sendable, Equatable {
    public let evidenceRole: String
    public let artifactID: BASArtifactID
    public let schemaID: String
    public let storedByteLength: UInt64
    public let storedSHA256: String
    public let semanticObjectRoot: String
    public let candidateTreeID: String
    public let producerOwnerID: String
    public let currentnessEpoch: UInt64
    public let controllerRetention: BASInternalSDKControllerRetentionReference?
}
```

The existing `BASCertificationEvidenceReference` adds exactly
`controllerRetention: BASInternalSDKControllerRetentionReference?`; every
other existing field and ten-gate meaning remains unchanged.

Declare the following self-ID-free governed payloads beside the one planned
`BASAppleSiliconCertification` evaluator and register them in the incumbent
schema governance registry; do not add another evaluator, SDK controller,
manifest store, or release authority:

```swift
    public let compatibilityManifest: BASInternalSDKEvidenceReference
    public let cold40Claim: BASPerformanceClaimDecision
    public let sustained30Claim: BASPerformanceClaimDecision
    public let formatSignaturePolicy: BASInternalSDKFormatSignaturePolicy
    public let formatSignature: BASInternalSDKEvidenceReference?
    public let rollbackTarget: BASInternalSDKRollbackTarget
}

public struct BASInternalSDKCertificationInput:
    BASSchemaVersioned, Codable, Sendable, Equatable {
    public static let currentSchemaVersion = "1.0.0"
    public let schemaVersion: String
    public let candidateTreeID: String
    public let finalWaveAdmissionReceipt: BASInternalSDKEvidenceReference
    public let appleWaveAdmissionReceipt: BASInternalSDKEvidenceReference
    public let runtimeReceiptChain: BASInternalSDKEvidenceReference
    public let artifactManifestReference: BASInternalSDKEvidenceReference
    public let artifactManifest: BASInternalSDKArtifactManifestPayload
    public let sbomReference: BASInternalSDKEvidenceReference
    public let sbom: BASInternalSDKSBOMPayload
    public let compatibilityReference: BASInternalSDKEvidenceReference
    public let compatibility: BASInternalSDKCompatibilityManifestPayload
    public let rollbackTarget: BASInternalSDKRollbackTarget
    public let rollbackCompatibilityReference: BASInternalSDKEvidenceReference?
    public let rollbackCompatibility: BASInternalSDKRollbackCompatibilityPayload?
    public let formatSignaturePolicy: BASInternalSDKFormatSignaturePolicy
    public let formatSignature: BASInternalSDKEvidenceReference?
}
```

Exactly those six top-level types—artifact manifest, SBOM, compatibility
manifest, rollback compatibility, release manifest, and certification
input—are independently ordinary-put governed payloads. Each has exactly one
incumbent schema-registry object row, current-version decode coverage and
future-version rejection coverage. They are new `1.0.0` wires and therefore
have no invented backward fixture. Package archives, shipping assets, SBOM
components, references, policies, targets, modes and enums are nested values;
they are validated through their containing top-level payload and are never
independently ordinary-put or registered.

Extend the already planned `BASAppleSiliconCertificationInput` with exactly
`internalSDKRelease: BASInternalSDKCertificationInput?`. The incumbent
`BASArchitectureCertVerifier` stable-opens every reference, decodes the exact
registered payload, proves reference/payload/tree/root equality, and passes
the materialized value to the existing
`BASAppleSiliconCertification.evaluate(_:)`. Add
`validateInternalSDKRelease(_:)` and its denial-reason projection as private
static helpers on that same evaluator; do not create a second evaluator. The
`runtime.certification` command requires the field to be present for an
internal-SDK verdict. `production.cutover` accepts only an allow verdict whose
candidate and complete SDK input roots equal the release manifest it reopens.
The compatibility reference and payload are both absent exactly for
`initialInstall`, whose nested uninstall/fault references are mandatory; they
are both present and byte/root-equal exactly for `previousCertifiedRelease`.

The package-archive row set is exactly two ordered entries,
`BehavioralAISubstrate` then `QinaoRuntimeSDK`, each binding package-manifest,
resolved-dependency-graph, archive, and archive digest. Shipping only the
Qinao archive is invalid because its current package manifest has a
`../BehavioralAISubstrate` path dependency. Reproducibility means two clean
builds from the same admitted candidate produce identical normalized source,
manifest, dependency, SBOM, compatibility, and output digests.

`orderedShippingAssets` is a closed, duplicate-free inventory of every byte
that can affect shipped execution or model behavior: each executable, model,
checkpoint, quantization/MTP artifact, tokenizer, prompt/template,
declarative skill, schema/tool contract, Metal library, XCFramework, and
package archive. Every row must stable-reopen and match its digest, signer and
issuer, signer role/purpose/epoch and signature evidence, ABI or data-contract
digest, per-asset OS/device/runtime/framework/entitlement compatibility and
evidence, expiry/revocation epoch, provenance, SBOM component, license,
cutover capability, and independently certified rollback evidence. Expired,
revoked, wrong-role, wrong-purpose, incompatible, or unopenable rows fail.
The set is derived bidirectionally from the candidate package graph, bundle,
link map, resource manifests, model/material registry, and schema/tool/skill
registries; an unlisted discovered asset or a listed absent asset fails.
Generated or downloaded executable Swift, Rust, C/C++, Metal, Python, shell,
or JavaScript is forbidden on iOS. iOS executable rows are AOT-only; Python
and server-side trainers/tools are development-host-only, excluded from the
shipping set, and their output remains untrusted input until independently
validated and certified.

The final-Wave and Apple-Wave references must each decode as complete
`QinaoWaveAdmissionReceiptV2` objects; the runtime-chain reference decodes as
the complete six-entry `QinaoW6RuntimeReceiptChainV2`. The chain's entry 06 is
the Apple receipt's immediate predecessor, the Apple receipt is the final
certification Wave receipt's immediate predecessor, and both Apple/final
receipts reopen the same chain prerequisite digest and head tree at their
respective edges, while their V2 installation terminals bind the exact head
commit/tree. Candidate-tree IDs, object roots, stored bytes, signatures,
predecessor continuity, and current trust scope are all reverified. Neither a
copied digest nor a valid chain from another run can satisfy certification or
cutover.

All governed payloads and enums above have explicit validating initializers, frozen coding
keys, strict lowercase digests, normalized nonempty IDs, duplicate-free
canonical ordering, and no default/unknown-field branch. The release manifest
must stable-reopen every typed reference, verify its schema/stored/object roots
and currentness, and prove candidate-tree equality; a
path string, copied digest, self-reported model result, or caller-selected
subset is insufficient.

`formatSignaturePolicy` is always present and binds the selected artifact
format, required/not-required decision, exact verifier identity, signer role,
and policy root. `formatSignature` is present if and only if that policy says
`required`, and its complete typed reference must reopen under the configured
Apple/package verifier. It proves artifact authenticity only. It cannot admit
a tree, certify behavior, sign the runtime chain, authorize
`production.cutover`, or expand a trust-root role. A missing required identity
or a signature supplied under `notRequired` blocks that release format.

Rollback reuses the same `production.cutover` owner. A first installation must
bind a tested uninstall plan, exact pre-install host-state digest, and
install/write/interruption/uninstall fault proof. Every later release must
select the manifest's distinct previous tree that independently passed the
complete certification and release-manifest chain **and** a rollback-
compatibility Artifact. That Artifact must either prove the prior SDK can
reopen the post-upgrade governed schema/state after real writes, or declare
typed `noDirectRollbackWithCompensatingMigration` and bind a separately
admitted compensating migration plus recovery fault proof. Forward-only K3 or
Artifact migrations make “previous tree was certified” insufficient. A
rollback target cannot be a runtime flag, an in-process incumbent fallback,
the same tree, an uncertified archive, or an untested data-loss path.

```bash
swift package --package-path "$CANDIDATE_ROOT/BehavioralAISubstrate" show-dependencies --format json
swift package --package-path "$CANDIDATE_ROOT/QinaoRuntimeSDK" dump-package
swift package --package-path "$CANDIDATE_ROOT/QinaoRuntimeSDK" show-dependencies --format json
swift package --package-path "$CANDIDATE_ROOT/BehavioralAISubstrate" archive-source \
  --output "$OUT/BehavioralAISubstrate.zip"
swift package --package-path "$CANDIDATE_ROOT/QinaoRuntimeSDK" archive-source \
  --output "$OUT/QinaoRuntimeSDK.zip"
```

### Payload 10D — Measure performance under a preregistered protocol

  Record exact:

  - iPhone model, silicon, device hardware revision, OS, build, battery state,
    ambient/device temperature;
  - Xcode/toolchain, runtime/framework, Metal-library, and entitlement identity;
  - model/material/tokenizer/quantization/context/output;
  - cold/warm definition and run count;
  - prefill, first-token, accepted decode, end-to-end task latency;
  - p50/p95/p99;
  - memory high-water, energy, and thermal state;
  - quality/constraint/source-faithfulness score;
  - enabled cache/prompt-lookup/MTP/fallback path.

  Before collecting a sample, seal the workload, output/quality floor,
  retrieval and grounding policy, model/material/tokenizer/template,
  measurement code, device eligibility, thermal-state definition, rejection
  rules, and aggregation query. The requested `cold40` protocol uses two
  distinct eligible physical devices. Each device runs exactly 100 turns;
  every turn begins only after the public OS thermal state has remained exactly
  `.nominal` continuously for at least 300 seconds under the sealed battery,
  ambient-temperature, workload, and runtime preconditions. The evidence binds
  the public thermal-state API/value, sample clock, 300-second interval, and
  device identity; a private proxy, inferred temperature, or copied nominal
  label is invalid. Each device independently requires accepted-decode p10 >=
  40 tok/s. Fifty-turn subblocks, cross-device averaging, selective reruns, or
  aggregation that hides a failing device are invalid. The
  requested `sustained30` protocol uses two distinct eligible physical
  devices, one uninterrupted 1,800-second cohort on each, and each device
  independently requires final-quarter accepted-decode p10 >= 30 tok/s.
  Cohorts cannot be spliced across launches or devices. Neither claim may
  lower output length, quality, constraint fidelity, retrieval/grounding,
  verifier, safety/policy work, or memory-pressure posture relative to its
  sealed profile.

  Any device revision, OS identity, Xcode/toolchain, runtime/framework,
  Metal-library, entitlement, model/material, tokenizer/template,
  quantization/MTP, ABI, policy, workload, quality floor, or measurement-code
  identity change
  invalidates the affected claim evidence and requires full recertification;
  no compatibility inference or partial sample reuse is allowed.

  Internal-SDK certification defaults both existing request enums to
  `.notRequested`; those results do not block mandatory certification or
  release. If explicitly requested, Cold 40 tok/s and sustained 30 tok/s are
  reported as met/not-met against this protocol. A miss blocks only the performance target/cutover profile it governs; it does not falsify structural completion or invite benchmark cheating. Interruption of a sustained
  1,800-second cohort invalidates that cohort and starts a fresh one; samples
  from different launches or devices are never spliced.
  Concretely, a requested claim that evaluates `.denied` leaves the mandatory
  internal-SDK structural certification eligible for `.allow` when every
  non-claim gate passes, while the corresponding capability row becomes
  `disabledPerformance`. `deriveCanonicalDenialReasons` must not promote that
  scoped claim denial into a global certification denial.

  The protocol suite must be discovered nonempty before any device run:

  ```bash
  "$QINAO_ADMITTED_PROTECTED_PYTHON" scripts/run_nonempty_swift_filter.py \
    --swift-executable "$QINAO_BOUND_SWIFT_EXECUTABLE" \
    --package-path BehavioralAISubstrate \
    --filter 'BASDualSpacePerformanceProtocolTests' \
    --require-suite BehavioralAISubstrateTests.BASDualSpacePerformanceProtocolTests \
    --require-test BehavioralAISubstrateTests.BASDualSpacePerformanceProtocolTests/testCold40RequiresTwoDevicesAndExactlyOneHundredTurnsAfterPublicNominalThermalState \
    --require-test BehavioralAISubstrateTests.BASDualSpacePerformanceProtocolTests/testCold40UsesPerDeviceAcceptedDecodeP10WithoutSubblocksOrAveraging \
    --require-test BehavioralAISubstrateTests.BASDualSpacePerformanceProtocolTests/testSustained30RequiresTwoUnsplicedEighteenHundredSecondCohortsAndFinalQuarterP10 \
    --require-test BehavioralAISubstrateTests.BASDualSpacePerformanceProtocolTests/testPerformanceClaimsCannotLowerSealedQualityWorkloadRetrievalOrPolicy \
    --require-test BehavioralAISubstrateTests.BASDualSpacePerformanceProtocolTests/testAnyOSOrSealedIdentityChangeInvalidatesFullClaimEvidence \
    --require-test BehavioralAISubstrateTests.BASDualSpacePerformanceProtocolTests/testNotRequestedAndDeniedClaimsRemainCapabilityScoped
  ```

  The suite freezes at least these cases:

  ```text

  BASDualSpacePerformanceProtocolTests.testCold40UsesPerDeviceAcceptedDecodeP10WithoutSubblocksOrAveraging
  BASDualSpacePerformanceProtocolTests.testSustained30RequiresTwoUnsplicedEighteenHundredSecondCohortsAndFinalQuarterP10
  BASDualSpacePerformanceProtocolTests.testPerformanceClaimsCannotLowerSealedQualityWorkloadRetrievalOrPolicy
  BASDualSpacePerformanceProtocolTests.testAnyOSOrSealedIdentityChangeInvalidatesFullClaimEvidence
  BASDualSpacePerformanceProtocolTests.testNotRequestedAndDeniedClaimsRemainCapabilityScoped
  ```

  “Full evidence closure” means every `enabled` profile has complete

### Payload 10I — Admit and controller-install certification evidence

  Only after device evidence, independent reviews, finding fixes, and all
  reruns are complete, stage the exact path list, prepare the final commit,
  review its external bundle, and let the controller install only that exact
  commit. The certification bundle names
  `$QINAO_W6_APPLE_ADMISSION_RECEIPT` as its immediate predecessor and binds
  the Apple evidence roots. It also directly reopens the runtime chain through
  the same sole `externalPrerequisites[]` row
  (`runtime-receipt-chain`, `QinaoW6RuntimeReceiptChainV2`, exact digest,
  `accepted`) rather than trusting a copied digest. At all five stages, the
  canonical chain digest must equal the runtime-chain prerequisite digest
  signed into
  `--previous-receipt "$QINAO_W6_APPLE_ADMISSION_RECEIPT"`; the chain entry
  06 receipt digest must
  equal that Apple receipt's signed immediate-predecessor digest; the chain
  head candidate commit/tree must equal the Apple receipt base commit/tree;
  and the Apple receipt installed commit/tree must equal the certification
  bundle base commit/tree and current target-ref commit/tree. A valid chain
  from another run cannot be substituted:

  Raw device logs, account paths, provisioning identities, UDIDs, certificates, profiles, prompts, user content, and secrets stay outside Git.

  Installing the ordinal-8 certification commit still does not install the SDK.
  The managed controller next asks the existing `runtime.certification` owner
  to reopen the controller-installed commit/tree, final-Wave receipt,
  Apple-Wave receipt, runtime
  chain, two-package artifact, SBOM, compatibility, optional-claim,
  format-signature-policy/signature, and rollback evidence and materialize the
  immutable verdict Artifact. Only an `allow`
  verdict can be embedded in the one `production.cutover` release manifest.
  The cutover owner independently reopens every reference and currentness fact,
  then requests confirmation only for the irreversible controlled-project
  installation. Missing confirmation leaves the certified release queued; it
  does not downgrade, auto-approve, or create a parallel install path.

  Recovery before cutover resumes pure artifact/replay work from immutable
  receipts. Recovery after a possibly crossed installation boundary first
  queries the controlled project's incumbent installation authority and
  reconciles the exact release-manifest identity. It never blindly reinstalls.
  Rollback is a new governed cutover to the separately certified previous tree,
  not restoration of a process snapshot or hidden fallback flag.

## Required Assertions to Transplant into the Master and Domain Exit Gates

The annex does not declare completion. Task 2 must transplant the following
